findings.text_ko: 벌크 의약품·반제품·원료 또는 포장재에 필요한 정보가 모두 표시되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: Bulk drugs, in-process drugs, raw materials, or packaging materials were not labelled with all the required information.

findings.text_ko: 컴퓨터화 시스템을 포함한 설비의 교정·점검·적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 문서화된 기준서(specifications)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The written specifications were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 의약품 품질에 관해 접수된 불만 및/또는 정보에 대한 품질관리부서(quality control department)의 처리가 미흡했다.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고·후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_orig: There was a lack of or inadequate evidence to demonstrate that all buildings involved in the production, distribution and/or importation of APIs met good manufacturing practices requirements.

findings.text_ko: 데이터 거버넌스(data governance) 계획의 수립 및/또는 유지가 미흡했다. 기록의 추적성·판독성·문서화·서식 및/또는 정확성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The establishment and/or the maintenance of a data governance plan was inadequate. The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 온도 및/또는 습도 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The temperature and/or humidity control was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 비위생적 상태를 방지하기 위한 위생관리 프로그램의 실행 및 효과성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation and/or the effectiveness of the sanitation program in preventing unsanitary conditions was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control unit) 책임자의 학력·경력 및 감독이 미흡했다. 작업자의 직무기술서, 부여된 권한 및 업무 위임이 미흡하거나 문서화되어 있지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The education, experience, and/or oversight of the individual in charge of the quality control department was inadequate. The job descriptions for personnel, the authority given to personnel, and/or the delegation of duties was inadequate and/or undocumented.

findings.text_ko: 변경이 적절히 문서화·평가·승인되도록 보장하는 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 의약품 안정성시험에 대한 변경이 과학적으로 정당화되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The changes made to the stability study of a drug were not scientifically justified.

findings.text_ko: 연간제품품질평가(APQR) 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The annual product quality review procedure was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 공급자·제조원·시험기관·포장업체·표시업체·유통업체·수입업체·도매업체 간 품질계약서(quality agreement)의 구비·내용·유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 중요 제조공정에 대한 밸리데이션(validation)이 실시되지 않았다. 포장 제품의 마스터 포뮬러(master formula)에 요구되는 정보가 포함되어 있지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: Critical production processes were not validated. The master formula for packaged products did not include the required information.

findings.text_ko: 온도 및 습도 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The temperature and/or humidity control was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 수입업체가 의약품의 제조·포장/표시 또는 시험에 사용한 해외 제조소가 Guidance on Evidence to Demonstrate Drug GMP Compliance of Foreign Sites (GUI-0080)에 규정된 요건을 충족하는지 확인하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The importer did not ensure that the foreign sites use to fabricate, package/label, or test drug products met the requirements described in Guidance on Evidence to Demonstrate Drug GMP Compliance of Foreign Sites (GUI-0080).

findings.text_ko: 원료 공급업체와 의약품 제조원 간 서면 계약서의 구비 및 내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability and/or the content of the written agreement between the raw material vendor and the drug fabricator was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 불만 및 결함 가능성이 있는 제품에 관한 정보의 평가·기록·후속조치·조사가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment, recording, follow-up, and/or investigation of complaints and/or other information about potentially defective products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고·후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 보관 및 운송 조건이 의약품의 품질과 안전한 유통을 유지하도록 보장하는 지침 및 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The guidelines and/or procedures were inadequate in ensuring storage and/or transportation conditions would maintain the quality and safe distribution of the drug.

findings.text_orig: The importer did not ensure that the foreign sites use to fabricate, package/label, or test drug products met the requirements described in Guidance on Evidence to Demonstrate Drug GMP Compliance of Foreign Sites (GUI-0080).

findings.text_orig: A preventative maintenance system had not been established for the equipment used in significant processing and/or testing operations

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control unit)가 기능하고 있거나 독립적이라는 증거가 없었다. 품질관리부서(quality control unit)가 독립적으로 기능하고 다른 어떤 부서와도 독립적으로 경영진에 보고하는 별도의 조직이 아니었다.
findings.text_orig: There was no evidence of a functioning and/or independent quality control department. The quality control department was not a distinct unit that functioned independently and reported to management independent of any other unit.

findings.text_ko: 의약품의 지속적 안정성시험 프로그램이 미흡했다. 회사는 기준일탈(OOS)·경계값(borderline)·경향이탈(out-of-trend)에 해당하는 안정성시험 결과에 대해 결과를 평가하거나 시정조치(CAPA)를 취하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The ongoing stability program for a drug was inadequate. The company did not assess the results and/or take corrective actions for stability testing results that were out-of-specification, borderline, or out-of-trend .

findings.text_ko: 회사는 해당 의약품을 시판하기 전 또는 처방·제조절차·포장재료에 중대한 변경이 이루어지기 전에 의약품의 안정성을 확인하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The company did not determine the stability of the drug before it was marketed or before significant changes were made to the drug formulations, fabrication procedures, or packaging materials.

findings.text_ko: 시험방법에 대한 밸리데이션(validation)이 실시되지 않았거나 시험방법 이관(method transfer) 연구가 수행되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: Test methods were not validated or the method transfer studies were not conducted.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고·후속조치가 미흡했다. 기준일탈(OOS) 시험결과의 조사·처리·보고가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate. The investigation, handling, and/or reporting of test results that were out-of-specification was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 공급자·제조원·시험기관·포장업체·표시업체·유통업체·수입업체·도매업체 간 품질계약서(quality agreement)의 구비·내용·유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 중요 제조공정에 대한 밸리데이션(validation)이 실시되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: Critical production processes were not validated.

findings.text_ko: 변경이 적절히 문서화·평가·승인되도록 보장하는 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 변경이 적절히 문서화·평가·승인되도록 보장하는 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 작업자에 대한 GMP 교육훈련 및 기록의 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The training of personnel in good manufacturing practices and/or the maintenance of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 전자시스템이 의도된 용도에 대해 밸리데이션(validation)되지 않았다. 기록의 생성·수정·검토·보관·검색에 대한 통제가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The electronic system was not validated for its intended use. The controls were inadequate for creating, modifying, reviewing, storing, and/or retrieving records.

findings.text_ko: 기록된 정보 또는 세부내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The recorded information or details were inadequate.

findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 생성·수정·검토·보관·검색에 대한 통제가 미흡했다. 전자시스템이 의도된 용도에 대해 밸리데이션(validation)되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The controls were inadequate for creating, modifying, reviewing, storing, and/or retrieving records. The electronic system was not validated for its intended use.

findings.text_ko: 기준일탈(OOS) 시험결과의 조사·처리·보고가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The investigation, handling, and/or reporting of test results that were out-of-specification was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 컴퓨터화시스템을 포함한 설비의 교정·점검·적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 공급자·제조원·시험기관·포장업체·표시업체·유통업체·수입업체·도매업체 간 품질계약서(quality agreement)의 구비·내용·유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록된 정보 또는 세부내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The recorded information or details were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 수입업자는 의약품의 제조·포장/표시 또는 시험에 사용하는 해외 제조소가 Guidance on Evidence to Demonstrate Drug GMP Compliance of Foreign Sites (GUI-0080) 에 규정된 요건을 충족하는지 확인하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The importer did not ensure that the foreign sites use to fabricate, package/label, or test drug products met the requirements described in Guidance on Evidence to Demonstrate Drug GMP Compliance of Foreign Sites (GUI-0080).

findings.text_ko: 완제품 출하를 위한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment to release finished products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 유틸리티 및/또는 지원 시스템의 적격성평가(qualification) 및/또는 검증이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The qualification and/or verification of utilities and/or support systems was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: GMP 관련 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 직원에 대한 GMP 교육훈련 및/또는 그 기록의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The training of personnel in good manufacturing practices and/or the maintenance of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 결함 가능성이 있는 제품에 관한 불만 및/또는 기타 정보의 평가·기록·후속조치 및/또는 조사가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment, recording, follow-up, and/or investigation of complaints and/or other information about potentially defective products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 수입업자는 의약품의 제조·포장/표시 또는 시험에 사용하는 해외 제조소가 Guidance on Evidence to Demonstrate Drug GMP Compliance of Foreign Sites (GUI-0080) 에 규정된 요건을 충족하는지 확인하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The importer did not ensure that the foreign sites use to fabricate, package/label, or test drug products met the requirements described in Guidance on Evidence to Demonstrate Drug GMP Compliance of Foreign Sites (GUI-0080).

findings.text_orig: The availability and/or the content of the written agreement between the raw material vendor and the drug fabricator was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 보관 및/또는 운송 조건이 의약품의 품질과 안전한 유통을 유지하도록 보장하는 지침 및/또는 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The guidelines and/or procedures were inadequate in ensuring storage and/or transportation conditions would maintain the quality and safe distribution of the drug.

findings.text_ko: 컴퓨터화시스템을 포함한 설비의 교정·점검 및/또는 적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 추적성·가독성·문서화·서식 및/또는 정확성이 미흡했다. 기록의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate. The maintenance of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기준일탈(OOS) 시험결과의 조사·처리 및/또는 보고가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The investigation, handling, and/or reporting of test results that were out-of-specification was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 시험실의 설계·장비 및/또는 유지관리가 미흡했다.

findings.text_orig: The identity testing of primary packaging materials once they were received on the premises by a person that packages the drugs was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 시약 및 배지의 입고·조제 및/또는 취급이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The receipt, preparation, and/or handling of reagents and culture media was inadequate.

findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 자체점검(self-inspection) 프로그램의 실행이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation of a self-inspection program was inadequate.

findings.text_orig: Validation studies were not conducted in keeping with the predefined protocols.

findings.text_orig: The investigation, handling, and/or reporting of test results that were out-of-specification was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 위생관리 프로그램이 오염 위험을 식별하고 저감하도록 적절히 설계되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The sanitation programs were not adequately designed to identify and/or reduce the risks of contamination.

findings.text_ko: 열멸균(heat sterilization) 사이클에 대한 회사의 모니터링 및 문서화가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The company's monitoring and documentation of heat sterilization cycles was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 무균공정(aseptic processing)의 밸리데이션(validation)이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The validation of aseptic processing was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 효과적인 세척, 위생적 조건, 의약품 오염 방지가 가능하도록 설계·시공·유지관리되지 않은 시설에서 의약품이 제조·포장·표시·보관되었다. 원료 및 의약품이 오염 위험에 더 크게 노출되는 구역이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The drug was fabricated, packaged, labelled, and/or stored in premises that were not designed, constructed, and/or maintained to allow for effective cleaning, sanitary conditions, and/or the prevention of drug contamination. The areas where raw materials and/or drugs were exposed to an increased risk of contamination were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 데이터 거버넌스(data governance) 계획의 수립 및 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The establishment and/or the maintenance of a data governance plan was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 작업자의 무균조작(aseptic practice)이 무균성을 유지하기에 미흡했다. 특히 무균작업 중 청정구역 내 인원의 이동이 과도했다. 무균제제 생산에 사용되는 청정구역의 상태가 미흡했다. 아이솔레이터(isolator) 내외로 자재를 이송하는 공정이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The operators'aseptic practices were inadequate to maintain sterility. There was excessive movement of personnel in the clean areas especially during aseptic operations. The condition of the clean area used to produce sterile products was inadequate. The process to transfer materials in and out of the isolator was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 충전된 용기에 대한 회사의 외관검사(visual inspection)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The company's visual inspection of filled containers was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 아이솔레이터 및 글러브·슬리브 시스템의 누출 시험이 미흡했다. 무균(aseptic) 구역의 시설과 설비에 대한 회사의 청소가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The testing of the isolator and the glove or sleeve system for leaks was inadequate. The company's cleaning of the premises and the equipment in aseptic areas was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 변경관리 시스템이 변경사항의 적절한 문서화·평가·승인을 보장하기에 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 제조공정·설비·원자재에 대한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Evaluation of production processes, equipment, and/or materials was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고·후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 무균시험을 위해 채취한 검체가 배치 전체를 대표하지 못했다.
findings.text_orig: The samples taken for sterility testing were not representative of the whole batch.

findings.text_ko: 무균(aseptic) 구역 또는 청정구역의 환경 등급 설정 절차가 미흡했다. 환경모니터링을 위해 채취한 검체 수가 부족했다. 회사는 오염 가능성이나 시스템 성능 저하를 방지하기에 충분한 빈도로 무균 충전구역을 모니터링하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The process was inadequate for the environmental classification of aseptic or clean areas. The number of samples taken for environmental monitoring was insufficient. The company did not monitor the aseptic filling area frequently enough to avoid possible contamination or system deterioration.

findings.text_ko: 컴퓨터화 시스템을 포함한 설비의 교정·점검·적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다. 기록의 생성·수정·검토·보관·검색에 대한 통제가 미흡했다. 전자시스템이 의도된 용도에 대해 밸리데이션(validation)되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate. The controls were inadequate for creating, modifying, reviewing, storing, and/or retrieving records. The electronic system was not validated for its intended use.

findings.text_ko: 회사는 기류 패턴이 오염 위험을 초래하지 않음을 충분히 입증하지 못했다. 회사는 청정구역의 미생물 오염과 부유입자 수를 최소화하도록 시설과 설비를 설계하거나 유지관리하지 않았다. 회사는 무균제품 제조의 덜 중요한 단계에 사용되는 청정구역을 충분히 모니터링하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The company did not adequately demonstrate that air-flow patterns did not pose a risk of contamination. The company did not design or maintain the premises and equipment to minimize microbial contamination and the number of airborne particles in clean areas. The company did not adequately monitor the clean areas used for the less critical stages of manufacturing sterile products.

findings.text_ko: 제균필터의 완전성시험(integrity test)에 대한 문서화가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The documentation for the integrity testing of sterilizing filters was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control unit) 책임자의 학력·경력·감독이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The education, experience, and/or oversight of the individual in charge of the quality control department was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 회수를 지원하기 위해 제품 재고 및 유통기록을 관리하는 데 사용된 컴퓨터화시스템이 밸리데이션(validation)되지 않았다. 전자서명에 대해 마련된 통제가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The computerized system used to manage product inventory and distribution records to support recalls was not validated. The controls put in place for electronic signatures were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 반품 의약품의 재판매 검토를 위한 평가·문서화·절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment, documentation, and/or procedures for considering the resale of returned drugs were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 온도 및 습도 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The temperature and/or humidity control was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 회수(recall)에 대한 문서화된 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The written procedures for recalls were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 건물 내로 해충·이물이 유입되는 것을 방지하도록 시설이 설계·시공·유지관리되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The premises were not designed, constructed, and/or maintained to prevent the entry of pests and/or foreign material into the building.

findings.text_ko: 회수(recall)를 지원하기 위해 제품 재고 및 유통 기록을 관리하는 데 사용된 전산화 시스템이 밸리데이션(validation)되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The computerized system used to manage product inventory and distribution records to support recalls was not validated.

findings.text_ko: 자체점검(self-inspection) 프로그램의 실행이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation of a self-inspection program was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 작업자의 직무기술서, 작업자에게 부여된 권한 및/또는 업무 위임이 미흡했거나 문서화되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The job descriptions for personnel, the authority given to personnel, and/or the delegation of duties was inadequate and/or undocumented.

findings.text_ko: 제조공정·설비 및/또는 원자재에 대한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Evaluation of production processes, equipment, and/or materials was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control unit)가 GMP 문서 및/또는 표준작업지침서(SOP)를 승인·서명 및/또는 날짜 기재하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department did not approve, sign, and/or date the good manufacturing practices documents and/or the standard operating procedures.

findings.text_ko: 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 검토·개정·승인 체계가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The system for reviewing, revising, and approving standard operating procedures was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 의약품에 대한 지속적 안정성시험(stability) 프로그램이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The ongoing stability program for a drug was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기준서(specification)가 문서화되지 않았거나 품질관리부서(quality control unit) 책임자 또는 지정된 대리인의 승인을 받지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The specifications were not in writing and/or approved by the person in charge of the quality control department or the designated alternative.

findings.text_ko: 변경관리 시스템이 변경사항의 적절한 문서화·평가 및/또는 승인을 보장하기에 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)·보고 및/또는 후속조치에 대한 조사가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 보관 및/또는 운송 조건이 의약품의 품질과 안전한 유통을 유지하도록 보장하는 데 있어 지침 및/또는 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The guidelines and/or procedures were inadequate in ensuring storage and/or transportation conditions would maintain the quality and safe distribution of the drug.

findings.text_ko: 연간 제품품질평가(annual product quality review) 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The annual product quality review procedure was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 반품된 의약품의 재판매 검토에 대한 평가·문서화 및/또는 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment, documentation, and/or procedures for considering the resale of returned drugs were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서가 로트 또는 배치의 재처리(reprocessing)·재작업(rework)을 적절히 승인·평가·문서화하지 않았다. 사용 전 원료 및 포장재의 격리보관·검체채취·시험·출고 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department did not appropriately approve, assess, and/or document the reprocessing and/or reworking of a lot and/or batch. The quarantine, sampling, testing, release of raw material, and/or the packaging materials prior to use were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 위생관리(sanitation) 프로그램의 세척절차·세척주기·폐기물 처리절차·방충방서 대책이 미흡했다. 비위생적 상태를 방지하기 위한 위생관리(sanitation) 프로그램의 실행·효과성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The sanitation program was inadequate in its cleaning procedures, frequency of cleaning, procedures for waste disposal, and/or pest control measures. The implementation and/or the effectiveness of the sanitation program in preventing unsanitary conditions was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 설비가 다른 의약품 또는 이물에 의한 의약품 오염 가능성을 방지하도록 설치·설계·운전·보관·유지관리되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The equipment was not set-up, designed, operated, stored, and/or maintained to prevent potential contamination of drugs by other drugs and/or by foreign material.

findings.text_ko: 시험실 데이터의 생성·유지관리·처리·검토가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The creation, maintenance, processing, and/or review of laboratory data was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 결함 가능성이 있는 제품에 관한 불만 및 기타 정보의 평가·기록·후속조치·조사가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment, recording, follow-up, and/or investigation of complaints and/or other information about potentially defective products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 컴퓨터화시스템을 포함한 설비의 교정·점검·적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조, 포장 또는 표시, 시험 업무의 위탁에 관한 서면 계약이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The written agreement for outsourcing fabrication, packaging or labelling, and/or testing activities was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 신규 또는 개정된 표준작업지침서(SOP) 시행 전 작업자 교육이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The training of personnel before new or revised standard operating procedures were implemented was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 생성·수정·검토·보관·검색에 대한 통제가 미흡했다. 컴퓨터화시스템을 포함한 설비의 교정·점검·적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The controls were inadequate for creating, modifying, reviewing, storing, and/or retrieving records. The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사, 보고 및 후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 변경사항이 적절히 문서화·평가·승인되도록 보장하는 데 있어 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 비위생적 상태를 방지하기 위한 위생관리 프로그램(sanitation program)의 실행 및 실효성이 미흡했다. 문서화된 위생관리 프로그램의 구비·실행·수준이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation and/or the effectiveness of the sanitation program in preventing unsanitary conditions was inadequate. The availability, implementation, and/or quality of the written sanitation program was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기준일탈(OOS) 시험결과의 조사·처리·보고가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The investigation, handling, and/or reporting of test results that were out-of-specification was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조공정을 관리하기 위한 마스터 포뮬러(master formula)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The master formulas to control the manufacturing process were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 의약품 제조에 사용되는 원료의 기준규격이 약전 기준에 부합하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The specifications for raw materials used to produce drugs did not meet pharmacopoeial standards.

findings.text_ko: GMP 관련 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기준서(specification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The written specifications were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 작업자에 대한 지속적인 교육훈련이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The ongoing training of personnel was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control unit) 또는 지정된 대리인이 품질관리 판정에 서명하거나 날짜를 기재하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department or the designated alternate did not sign and/or date quality control decisions.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 추적성·가독성·문서화·서식·정확성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 자체점검(self-inspection) 프로그램의 실행이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation of a self-inspection program was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 보관·운송 조건이 의약품의 품질과 안전한 유통을 유지하도록 보장하는 지침·절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The guidelines and/or procedures were inadequate in ensuring storage and/or transportation conditions would maintain the quality and safe distribution of the drug.

findings.text_ko: 직원의 직무기술서, 직원에게 부여된 권한, 업무 위임이 미흡하거나 문서화되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The job descriptions for personnel, the authority given to personnel, and/or the delegation of duties was inadequate and/or undocumented.

findings.text_ko: GMP 관련 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 공급자·제조업자·시험자·포장업자·표시업자·유통업자·수입업자·도매업자 간 품질계약서(quality agreement)의 구비·내용·유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 작업소가 오염을 방지하도록 설계·건축·운영·유지관리되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The premises were not designed, constructed, operated, and/or maintained to prevent contamination.

findings.text_ko: 시험방법 밸리데이션(validation)이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The validation of test methods was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 작업자의 무균조작(aseptic) 관행이 무균성을 유지하기에 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The operators'aseptic practices were inadequate to maintain sterility.

findings.text_ko: 비위생적 상태를 방지하기 위한 위생관리 프로그램의 실행 및/또는 그 유효성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation and/or the effectiveness of the sanitation program in preventing unsanitary conditions was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 전산화 시스템을 포함한 설비의 교정(calibration)·점검 및/또는 적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기준일탈(OOS) 시험결과의 조사·처리 및/또는 보고가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The investigation, handling, and/or reporting of test results that were out-of-specification was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: "Water for Injection"(주사용수)이 미생물 증식을 방지하도록 제조·보관 또는 공급되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The "Water for Injection" was not produced, stored or distributed to prevent microbial growth.

findings.text_ko: 청정구역(clean area)에 대한 문서화된 위생관리 프로그램이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The written sanitation program for clean areas was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 원료 공급업체와 의약품 제조업자 간 문서화된 계약서의 구비 및 내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability and/or the content of the written agreement between the raw material vendor and the drug fabricator was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control unit) 책임자의 학력·경력 및 감독 수행이 미흡했다. 직원의 직무기술서, 직원에게 부여된 권한, 업무 위임이 미흡하거나 문서화되지 않았다. 직원에 대한 지속적인 교육훈련이 미흡했다. 직원에 대한 GMP 교육 및 관련 기록의 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The education, experience, and/or oversight of the individual in charge of the quality control department was inadequate. The job descriptions for personnel, the authority given to personnel, and/or the delegation of duties was inadequate and/or undocumented. The ongoing training of personnel was inadequate. The training of personnel in good manufacturing practices and/or the maintenance of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조구역이 적절히 격리·구획되도록 시설이 배치·설계되지 않았다. 제품 간 교차오염과 혼동을 방지하기 위한 최적의 인원·자재 동선이 되도록 시설이 배치·설계되지 않았다. 시설의 유지관리가 미흡했다. 건물 내로 해충·이물이 유입되는 것을 방지하도록 시설이 설계·시공·유지관리되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The premises were not laid out and/or designed to ensure that production areas were adequately isolated and segregated. The premises were not laid out and/or designed for an optimal flow of personnel and/or materials to prevent cross-contamination and/or mix-ups between products. The maintenance of the premises was inadequate. The premises were not designed, constructed, and/or maintained to prevent the entry of pests and/or foreign material into the building.

findings.text_ko: 온도·습도 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The temperature and/or humidity control was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리 요건에 대해 판정하는 책임자가 해당 직위의 책임을 수행하기에 충분한 현장 운영 지식을 갖추지 못했다.
findings.text_orig: The person responsible for making decisions about quality control requirements did not have adequate knowledge of on-site operations to fulfill the responsibilities of this position.

findings.text_ko: 시험방법의 밸리데이션(validation) 및 문서화가 미흡했다. 다른 의약품이나 이물에 의한 의약품 오염 가능성을 방지하도록 장비가 설치·설계·운영·보관·유지관리되지 않았다. 위생관리 프로그램이 오염 위험을 파악하고 저감하도록 적절히 설계되지 않았다. 문서화된 위생관리 프로그램의 구비·실행·수준이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The validation and/or the documentation of test methods was inadequate. The equipment was not set-up, designed, operated, stored, and/or maintained to prevent potential contamination of drugs by other drugs and/or by foreign material. The sanitation programs were not adequately designed to identify and/or reduce the risks of contamination. The availability, implementation, and/or quality of the written sanitation program was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제품 및 자재의 오염 방지 조치가 미흡했다. 문서화된 위생관리 프로그램에 직원 및 방문자의 복장 요건과 위생 절차가 명확히 규정되어 있지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The protection of products and/or materials from contamination was inadequate. The written hygiene program did not clearly define clothing requirements and/or hygiene procedures for personnel and/or visitors.

findings.text_ko: 회수(recall)를 지원하기 위해 제품 재고 및 유통 기록을 관리하는 데 사용된 전산화 시스템이 밸리데이션(validation)되지 않았다. 회수(recall)에 대한 문서화된 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The computerized system used to manage product inventory and distribution records to support recalls was not validated. The written procedures for recalls were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: GMP 관련 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 완제품 출하 판정을 위한 평가가 미흡했다. 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고·후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment to release finished products was inadequate. Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 전산화 시스템을 포함한 장비의 교정·점검·적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 전산화 시스템을 포함한 장비의 교정·점검·적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다. 주요 제조 및 시험 작업에 사용되는 장비에 대한 예방정비 프로그램이 미흡했다. 다른 의약품이나 이물에 의한 의약품 오염 가능성을 방지하도록 장비가 설치·설계·운영·보관·유지관리되지 않았다. 측정기기의 정확성 및 정밀성을 정기적으로 점검하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate. The preventative maintenance program was inadequate for the equipment used in significant processing and/or testing operations. The equipment was not set-up, designed, operated, stored, and/or maintained to prevent potential contamination of drugs by other drugs and/or by foreign material. Measuring devices were not regularly checked for accuracy and precision.

findings.text_ko: 자체점검(self-inspection) 프로그램의 실행이 미흡했다.

findings.text_orig: The verification and dispensing of raw materials by qualified staff was inadequate. The master production documents were inadequate. The usage logs for the equipment used for significant processing and/or testing operations were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 오염을 방지하도록 시설이 설계·시공·운영·유지관리되지 않았다.

findings.text_orig: The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조, 포장 또는 표시, 시험에 대한 책임을 규정한 품질계약서(quality agreement)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The quality agreement outlining the responsibilities for fabricating, packaging or labelling, and/or testing was inadequate.

findings.text_orig: The sanitation program was inadequate in its cleaning procedures, frequency of cleaning, procedures for waste disposal, and/or pest control measures.

findings.text_ko: 전자서명에 대해 마련된 통제가 미흡했다.

findings.text_ko: 중요 제조공정에 대한 밸리데이션(validation)이 수행되지 않았다.

findings.text_ko: 회수(recall)에 대한 문서화된 절차가 미흡했다.

findings.text_orig: The ongoing stability program for a drug was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 작업자의 직무기술서, 부여된 권한 및/또는 업무 위임이 미흡했거나 문서화되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The job descriptions for personnel, the authority given to personnel, and/or the delegation of duties was inadequate and/or undocumented.

findings.text_ko: 완제품 기준규격 적합성을 입증하는 데 필요한 증거가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The evidence required to demonstrate compliance with finished product specifications was inadequate.

findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_orig: The positive identification of each batch of drug after the packaging and/or after it was received on the importer's premises was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 데이터 거버넌스(data governance) 계획의 수립 및/또는 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The establishment and/or the maintenance of a data governance plan was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 유틸리티 및/또는 지원 설비에 대한 적격성평가(qualification) 및/또는 검증이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The qualification and/or verification of utilities and/or support systems was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 용수 시험에 대한 회사의 모니터링이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The company's monitoring of water testing was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 보관 및/또는 운송 조건이 의약품의 품질과 안전한 유통을 유지하도록 보장하는 지침 및/또는 절차가 미흡했다.

findings.text_orig: Evaluation of production processes, equipment, and/or materials was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조부서 책임자의 학력, 경력 및/또는 관리감독이 미흡했다. 작업자의 직무기술서, 부여된 권한 및/또는 업무 위임이 미흡했거나 문서화되지 않았다. 신규 또는 개정된 표준작업지침서(SOP) 시행 전 작업자 교육이 미흡했다. 인사기록의 관리가 미흡했다.

findings.text_orig: The assessment, recording, follow-up, and/or investigation of complaints and/or other information about potentially defective products was inadequate.

findings.text_orig: The premises and/or the manufacturing process were inadequate for minimizing contamination of the drugs and/or materials during fabrication and/or packaging. The temperature and/or humidity control was inadequate.

findings.text_orig: The quality control department did not appropriately approve, assess, and/or document the reprocessing and/or reworking of a lot and/or batch.

findings.text_orig: Water treatment plants and distribution systems were not designed, constructed, or maintained to ensure a reliable and adequate source of water. The preventative maintenance and repair of the equipment was inadequate.

findings.text_orig: The implementation of a self-inspection program was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 변경이 적절히 문서화·평가 및/또는 승인되도록 보장하는 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 미흡했다. GMP 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved. The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.

findings.text_orig: The company did not assess the results and/or take corrective actions for stability testing results that were out-of-specification, borderline, or out-of-trend .

findings.text_ko: 마스터 제조문서(master production document)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The master production documents were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 데이터 거버넌스(data governance) 계획의 수립 및/또는 유지관리가 미흡했다.

findings.text_orig: The annual product quality review procedure was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 의약품 제조자의 원료 기준규격이 미흡했다. 의약품 제조에 사용되는 원료의 기준규격이 공정서(pharmacopoeia) 기준에 부합하지 않았다.

findings.text_orig: The establishment of specifications was inadequate for packaging materials approved by the quality control department.

findings.text_ko: 의약품에 대한 지속적 안정성 프로그램(ongoing stability program)이 미흡했다.

findings.text_ko: 전자시스템이 사용 목적에 맞게 밸리데이션(validation)되지 않았다.

findings.text_ko: 변경이 적절히 문서화·평가 및/또는 승인되도록 보장하는 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 보관용 검체(retention sample)에 관한 문서화된 절차와 기록이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The written procedures and records for retaining samples were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리 요건에 관한 결정을 책임지는 자가 현장에 없었거나 품질관리부서(quality control unit)가 충분히 활용할 수 없었다. 품질경영시스템의 효과성을 이행·유지 및/또는 개선하기 위해 적절하고 충분한 자원을 결정 및/또는 제공하는 경영진의 역량이 미흡했다. 품질관리 요건에 관한 결정을 책임지는 자가 해당 직위의 책임을 수행하기에 충분한 현장 운영 지식을 갖추지 못했다.
findings.text_orig: There was no person on site and/or fully available to the quality control department who was responsible for making decisions for the quality control requirements. The person responsible for making decisions about quality control requirements did not have adequate knowledge of on-site operations to fulfill the responsibilities of this position.

findings.text_ko: 공급자, 제조자, 시험자, 포장자, 표시자, 유통업자, 수입자 및/또는 도매상 간 품질계약서(quality agreement)의 구비, 내용 및/또는 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control unit)의 승인 없이 제품이 판매 가능한 상태로 제공되었다. 완제품 출하판정을 위한 평가가 미흡했다. 품질관리부서 책임자의 품질관리 결정사항을 문서화하는 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The product was made available for sale without the approval of the quality control department. The assessment to release finished products was inadequate. The procedure was inadequate for documenting quality control decisions by the person in charge of the quality control department.

findings.text_ko: 제조공정, 시스템, 설비, 자재 및/또는 공급자에 대한 변경을 시행 전에 밸리데이션(validation)하지 않았다. 품질관리부서(quality control unit)가 연간 제품품질평가(annual product quality review) 결과를 평가하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: Changes to production processes, systems, equipment, materials, and/or suppliers were not validated before they were implemented. The quality control department did not evaluate the results of the annual product quality review.

findings.text_ko: 회수(recall)에 관한 문서화된 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The written procedures for recalls were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 시험법을 밸리데이션(validation)하지 않았거나 시험법 이관(method transfer) 연구를 실시하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: Test methods were not validated or the method transfer studies were not conducted.

findings.text_ko: 기준일탈(OOS) 시험결과의 조사·처리·보고가 미흡했다. 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사, 보고, 후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The investigation, handling, and/or reporting of test results that were out-of-specification was inadequate. Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 작업자의 무균조작(aseptic) 관행이 무균성을 유지하기에 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The operators'aseptic practices were inadequate to maintain sterility.

findings.text_ko: 작업자에 대한 GMP 교육 및 관련 기록의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The training of personnel in good manufacturing practices and/or the maintenance of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 충전 용기에 대한 회사의 외관검사(visual inspection)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The company's visual inspection of filled containers was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 시약 및 배지의 입고·조제·취급이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The receipt, preparation, and/or handling of reagents and culture media was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 설비의 예방정비 및 수리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The preventative maintenance and repair of the equipment was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 부유입자 모니터링 시스템이 미흡했다. 청정구역(critical area) 내 미생물 오염에 대한 회사의 조사가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The airborne particle monitoring system was inadequate. The company's investigations of microbial contamination in critical areas were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The maintenance of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 생성·수정·검토·보관·검색에 대한 통제가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The controls were inadequate for creating, modifying, reviewing, storing, and/or retrieving records.

findings.text_ko: 연간 제품품질평가(annual product quality review) 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The annual product quality review procedure was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 작업자의 직무기술서, 작업자에게 부여된 권한 및/또는 업무 위임이 미흡했거나 문서화되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The job descriptions for personnel, the authority given to personnel, and/or the delegation of duties was inadequate and/or undocumented.

findings.text_ko: 변경이 적절히 문서화·평가 및/또는 승인되도록 보장하는 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 제조공정, 시스템, 설비, 자재, 공급업체의 변경사항을 실행 전에 밸리데이션(validation)하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: Changes to production processes, systems, equipment, materials, and/or suppliers were not validated before they were implemented.

findings.text_ko: 작업자에 대한 GMP 교육 및 관련 기록의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The training of personnel in good manufacturing practices and/or the maintenance of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질경영시스템의 실행·유지·효과성 개선에 필요한 적절한 자원을 결정하고 제공하는 경영진의 역량이 미흡했다. 품질관리부서(quality control department)가 요구되는 모든 업무를 수행하지 않았다. 품질관리부서는 독립적으로 기능하고 다른 어떤 부서와도 독립적으로 경영진에게 보고하는 별도의 조직이 아니었다.
findings.text_orig: Senior management's ability to determine and/or provide adequate and/or appropriate resources to implement, maintain and/or improve the effectiveness of the quality management system was inadequate. The quality control department did not undertake all of the required activities. The quality control department was not a distinct unit that functioned independently and reported to management independent of any other unit.

findings.text_ko: 회수(recall)에 관한 문서화된 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The written procedures for recalls were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 문서화된 기준(specification)이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The written specifications were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 연간 제품품질평가(annual product quality review) 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The annual product quality review procedure was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 회사는 기준일탈(OOS)·경계값·경향이탈(out-of-trend)에 해당하는 안정성시험 결과에 대해 결과를 평가하거나 시정조치를 취하지 않았다. 의약품 안정성시험 프로그램에 해당 의약품이 제조된 각 연도별로 모든 함량에 대해 최소 1개 배치가 포함되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The company did not assess the results and/or take corrective actions for stability testing results that were out-of-specification, borderline, or out-of-trend . The stability program for a drug did not include a minimum of one batch of every strength of the drug for every year the drug was fabricated.

findings.text_ko: 수입자는 의약품의 제조, 포장/표시 또는 시험에 사용되는 해외 사업장이 Guidance on Evidence to Demonstrate Drug GMP Compliance of Foreign Sites (GUI-0080)에 규정된 요구사항을 충족하는지 보증하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The importer did not ensure that the foreign sites use to fabricate, package/label, or test drug products met the requirements described in Guidance on Evidence to Demonstrate Drug GMP Compliance of Foreign Sites (GUI-0080).

findings.text_ko: 원료 공급업체와 의약품 제조업자 간 문서화된 계약의 구비 및 내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability and/or the content of the written agreement between the raw material vendor and the drug fabricator was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조, 포장, 표시, 요구되는 시험, 보관, 유통 및 각각의 조건에 관한 근거자료의 관리가 미흡했다. 기록된 정보 또는 세부 내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The maintenance of evidence was inadequate for manufacturing, packaging, labelling, required testing, storage, and/or distribution, including the respective conditions. The recorded information or details were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 불만 및 결함 가능성이 있는 제품에 관한 그 밖의 정보에 대한 평가·기록·후속조치·조사가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment, recording, follow-up, and/or investigation of complaints and/or other information about potentially defective products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사, 보고, 후속조치가 미흡했다. 기준에서 벗어난 경우 및 제품이 허용범위 경계값에 있는 경우에 대한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate. The evaluation was inadequate for cases where there was a deviation from the norm and/or where products were on the borderline of the acceptable range.

findings.text_ko: 보관 및 운송 조건이 의약품의 품질과 안전한 유통을 유지하도록 보증하는 지침 및 절차가 미흡했다. 온도 및 습도 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The guidelines and/or procedures were inadequate in ensuring storage and/or transportation conditions would maintain the quality and safe distribution of the drug. The temperature and/or humidity control was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 자체점검(self-inspection) 프로그램의 운영이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation of a self-inspection program was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 보관 및 운송 조건이 의약품의 품질과 안전한 유통을 유지하도록 보증하는 지침 및 절차가 미흡했다. 공급자, 제조업자, 시험기관, 포장업자, 표시업자, 유통업자, 수입자, 도매업자 간 품질계약서(quality agreement)의 구비·내용·관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The guidelines and/or procedures were inadequate in ensuring storage and/or transportation conditions would maintain the quality and safe distribution of the drug. The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 문서화된 기준(specification)이 미흡했다. 사용 전 원료 및 포장재의 격리보관·검체채취·시험·출고 승인이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The written specifications were inadequate. The quarantine, sampling, testing, release of raw material, and/or the packaging materials prior to use were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기준일탈(OOS) 시험결과의 조사·처리·보고가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The investigation, handling, and/or reporting of test results that were out-of-specification was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 전자서명에 대해 마련된 통제가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The controls put in place for electronic signatures were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The maintenance of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 의약품에 대한 지속적 안정성시험 프로그램이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The ongoing stability program for a drug was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록된 정보 또는 세부 내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The recorded information or details were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 온도 및 습도 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The temperature and/or humidity control was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 작업자에 대한 GMP 교육 및 관련 기록의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The training of personnel in good manufacturing practices and/or the maintenance of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 포장 후 및 수입자 사업장 입고 후 각 의약품 배치에 대한 확인 표시(positive identification)가 미흡했다. 주기적 확인시험(confirmatory testing)을 실시하지 않았다. 완제품 기준(specification) 적합성을 입증하는 데 필요한 근거자료가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The positive identification of each batch of drug after the packaging and/or after it was received on the importer's premises was inadequate. Periodic confirmatory testing was not conducted. The evidence required to demonstrate compliance with finished product specifications was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 전자시스템이 사용목적에 대해 밸리데이션(validation)되지 않았다. 기록의 생성·수정·검토·보관·검색에 대한 통제가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The electronic system was not validated for its intended use. The controls were inadequate for creating, modifying, reviewing, storing, and/or retrieving records.

findings.text_ko: 원료 공급업체와 의약품 제조업자 간 문서화된 계약의 구비 및 내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability and/or the content of the written agreement between the raw material vendor and the drug fabricator was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 완제품 출고 승인을 위한 평가가 미흡했다. 회사는 의약품, 원료, 활성성분(active ingredient)의 각 로트 또는 배치에 대한 검체를 보관하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment to release finished products was inadequate. The company did not retain a sample of each lot or batch of a drug, raw material, and/or an active ingredient.

findings.text_ko: 제조기준서(master production document)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The master production documents were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고·후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 부적합 자재의 식별·격리보관·폐기가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The identification, quarantine, and/or disposal of rejected materials was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 온도 및/또는 습도 관리가 미흡했다. 기록의 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The temperature and/or humidity control was inadequate. The maintenance of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control unit)가 요구되는 모든 업무를 수행하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department did not undertake all of the required activities.

findings.text_ko: 반품된 의약품의 재판매 검토를 위한 평가·문서화·절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment, documentation, and/or procedures for considering the resale of returned drugs were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 원료, 공정 중 의약품, 벌크 의약품, 완제품의 검체 취급 및/또는 보관이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The handling and/or storage of samples was inadequate for raw materials, drugs being processed, bulk drugs, and/or finished products.

findings.text_ko: 기준에서 벗어난 경우 및/또는 제품이 허용범위 경계에 있는 경우에 대한 평가가 미흡했다. 기준일탈(OOS) 시험결과의 조사·처리·보고가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The evaluation was inadequate for cases where there was a deviation from the norm and/or where products were on the borderline of the acceptable range. The investigation, handling, and/or reporting of test results that were out-of-specification was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 작업자의 무균조작(aseptic) 수행이 무균성을 유지하기에 미흡했다. 무균구역 또는 청정구역의 환경 등급 설정 절차가 미흡했다. 시험실의 설계·설비·유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The operators'aseptic practices were inadequate to maintain sterility. The process was inadequate for the environmental classification of aseptic or clean areas. The design, equipment, and/or maintenance of the testing laboratory was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 시험실 데이터의 생성·유지·처리·검토가 미흡했다. 기록의 추적성·판독성·문서화·서식·정확성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The creation, maintenance, processing, and/or review of laboratory data was inadequate. The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 유틸리티 및/또는 지원 시스템의 적격성평가(qualification) 및/또는 검증이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The qualification and/or verification of utilities and/or support systems was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 데이터 거버넌스(data governance) 계획의 수립 및/또는 유지가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The establishment and/or the maintenance of a data governance plan was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기준일탈(OOS) 시험결과의 조사·처리·보고가 미흡했다. 품질관리부서(quality control department)의 불만 및 의약품 품질 관련 접수 정보 처리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The investigation, handling, and/or reporting of test results that were out-of-specification was inadequate. The quality control department's handling of complaints and/or information received about drug quality was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 온도 및 습도 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The temperature and/or humidity control was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 원료에 대한 검체채취 계획(sampling plan)이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The sampling plan for raw materials was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 설비의 예방정비 및 수리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The preventative maintenance and repair of the equipment was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 의약품 안정성시험의 실시 주기가 품목허가(marketing authorization) 내용에 부합하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The frequency of stability testing of a drug did not comply with the marketing authorization.

findings.text_ko: 미생물 및 환경조건에 대한 모니터링 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The monitoring procedures for microbial and/or environmental conditions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 변경사항의 적절한 문서화·평가·승인을 보증하기에 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 작업자의 무균조작(aseptic) 수행이 무균성을 유지하기에 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The operators'aseptic practices were inadequate to maintain sterility.

findings.text_ko: 해당 업체는 기류 패턴(air-flow pattern)이 오염 위험을 초래하지 않음을 충분히 입증하지 못했다.
findings.text_orig: The company did not adequately demonstrate that air-flow patterns did not pose a risk of contamination.

findings.text_ko: 위생관리 프로그램이 오염 위험을 파악하고 감소시키도록 적절히 설계되지 않았다. 비위생적 상태를 방지하기 위한 위생관리 프로그램의 실행 및/또는 실효성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The sanitation programs were not adequately designed to identify and/or reduce the risks of contamination. The implementation and/or the effectiveness of the sanitation program in preventing unsanitary conditions was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고·후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 시험법 밸리데이션(validation)이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The validation of test methods was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 수입자는 의약품의 제조, 포장/표시 또는 시험에 사용되는 해외 사업장이 Guidance on Evidence to Demonstrate Drug GMP Compliance of Foreign Sites (GUI-0080)에 규정된 요구사항을 충족하는지 보증하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The importer did not ensure that the foreign sites use to fabricate, package/label, or test drug products met the requirements described in Guidance on Evidence to Demonstrate Drug GMP Compliance of Foreign Sites (GUI-0080).

findings.text_ko: 시험실 데이터의 생성·관리·처리·검토가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The creation, maintenance, processing, and/or review of laboratory data was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 수탁업체에 대한 회사의 관리감독이 미흡했다.

findings.text_ko: 직원에 대한 지속적인 교육이 미흡했다.

findings.text_ko: GMP 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 회사는 의약품 시판 전 또는 처방·제조절차·포장재에 중대한 변경이 이루어지기 전에 해당 의약품의 안정성을 확인하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The company did not determine the stability of the drug before it was marketed or before significant changes were made to the drug formulations, fabrication procedures, or packaging materials.

findings.text_ko: 격리보관 구역의 관리가 미흡했다. 원료·포장재·중간제품·벌크 의약품·완제품의 구분보관·재고 회전·운송이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The control of quarantine areas was inadequate. The segregation, rotation of stock, and/or the transportation of raw materials, packaging materials, intermediates, bulk drugs, and/or finished products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 온도·습도 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The temperature and/or humidity control was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조기준서(master production document)가 미흡했다.

findings.text_ko: 요구사항에 따른 전 항목 시험이 수행되지 않았다.

findings.text_orig: The computerized system used to manage product inventory and distribution records to support recalls was not validated. The distribution records did not allow each drug to be traced individually.

findings.text_ko: 자체점검(self-inspection) 프로그램의 시행이 미흡했다.

findings.text_ko: 마스터 제조문서(master production document)가 미흡했다.

findings.text_orig: The importer did not ensure that the foreign sites use to fabricate, package/label, or test drug products met the requirements described in Guidance on Evidence to Demonstrate Drug GMP Compliance of Foreign Sites (GUI-0080).

findings.text_ko: 의약품의 품질 유지와 안전한 유통을 보장하는 보관·운송 조건을 확보하기 위한 지침·절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The guidelines and/or procedures were inadequate in ensuring storage and/or transportation conditions would maintain the quality and safe distribution of the drug.

findings.text_ko: 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 검토·개정·승인 체계가 미흡했다. 품질관리부서(quality control unit) 또는 지정 대리자가 품질관리 결정사항에 서명 및/또는 날짜 기재를 하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The system for reviewing, revising, and approving standard operating procedures was inadequate. The quality control department or the designated alternate did not sign and/or date quality control decisions.

findings.text_ko: 회수(recall)에 대한 수입자·유통자·도매상 각자의 책임을 규정한 서면 계약서가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The written agreement outlining the respective responsibilities of the importer, distributor, and/or wholesaler for recalls was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 직원의 직무기술서, 직원에게 부여된 권한 및/또는 업무 위임이 미흡하거나 문서화되지 않았다. 신규 또는 개정된 표준작업지침서(SOP) 시행 전 직원 교육이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The job descriptions for personnel, the authority given to personnel, and/or the delegation of duties was inadequate and/or undocumented. The training of personnel before new or revised standard operating procedures were implemented was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 회수(recall)에 대한 서면 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The written procedures for recalls were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 의약품의 품질과 안전한 유통이 유지되도록 보관·운송 조건을 보장하기 위한 지침·절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The guidelines and/or procedures were inadequate in ensuring storage and/or transportation conditions would maintain the quality and safe distribution of the drug.

findings.text_ko: 작업 공간이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The working spaces were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서가 GMP 문서 및 표준작업지침서(SOP)를 승인·서명·날짜 기재하지 않았다. GMP 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department did not approve, sign, and/or date the good manufacturing practices documents and/or the standard operating procedures. The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: GMP 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 공급자·제조자·시험자·포장자·표시자·유통자·수입자·도매상 간 품질계약서(quality agreement)의 보유·내용·유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 의약품의 품질 유지와 안전한 유통을 보장하는 보관·운송 조건을 확보하기 위한 지침·절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The guidelines and/or procedures were inadequate in ensuring storage and/or transportation conditions would maintain the quality and safe distribution of the drug.

findings.text_ko: 온도·습도 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The temperature and/or humidity control was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 변경사항이 적절히 문서화·평가 및/또는 승인되도록 보장하는 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 데이터 거버넌스(data governance) 계획의 수립 및/또는 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The establishment and/or the maintenance of a data governance plan was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 정제수 시스템이 미흡하여 화학적·미생물학적 순도에 대한 적정 요건을 충족하지 못할 가능성이 있었다.
findings.text_orig: The purified water system was inadequate with the potential for water not meeting the appropriate requirements for chemical and microbial purity.

findings.text_ko: 건물·시설이 청결하고 정돈된 상태를 유지할 수 있도록 설계·시공·운영 및/또는 유지관리되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The premises were not designed, constructed, operated, and/or maintained to allow clean and orderly conditions.

findings.text_ko: GMP 관련 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 온도 및/또는 습도 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The temperature and/or humidity control was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 조제된 배지의 유효기한이 발육증진시험(growth-promotion testing)으로 뒷받침되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The expiry date of the prepared culture media was not supported by the growth-promotion testing.

findings.text_ko: 설비의 예방정비 및 수리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The preventative maintenance and repair of the equipment was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 무균구역 또는 청정구역(clean area)의 환경 등급 분류 절차가 미흡했다. 무균공정(aseptic)이 수행되는 구역에서 모니터링 주기와 방법이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The process was inadequate for the environmental classification of aseptic or clean areas. In areas where aseptic operations were performed, the frequency and the methods of monitoring were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 청정구역(clean area)에 대한 문서화된 위생관리(sanitation) 프로그램이 미흡했다. Grade A 및 B 구역에서 멸균 소독제를 사용하지 않았다. 각 환경 등급별 문서화된 복장 기준이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The written sanitation program for clean areas was inadequate. Sterile disinfectants were not used in Grade A and B areas. The written clothing standards for each environmental grade were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 장비의 설계·구조 및/또는 설치 위치가 해당 장비의 적절한 세척·소독 및/또는 점검을 허용하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The design, construction, and/or location of the equipment did not allow adequate cleaning, sanitizing, and/or inspection of the equipment.

findings.text_ko: 문서화된 위생관리(sanitation) 프로그램의 구비·실행 및/또는 수준이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, implementation, and/or quality of the written sanitation program was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 결함 가능성이 있는 제품에 관한 불만 및/또는 기타 정보의 평가·기록·후속조치 및/또는 조사가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment, recording, follow-up, and/or investigation of complaints and/or other information about potentially defective products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 주요 공정 및/또는 시험 작업에 사용된 장비의 사용기록(usage log)이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The usage logs for the equipment used for significant processing and/or testing operations were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조소가 생산구역이 적절히 격리·구분되도록 배치 및/또는 설계되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The premises were not laid out and/or designed to ensure that production areas were adequately isolated and segregated.

findings.text_ko: 통상에서 벗어난 일탈(deviation)이 있었거나 제품이 허용범위 경계선상에 있었던 사례에 대한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The evaluation was inadequate for cases where there was a deviation from the norm and/or where products were on the borderline of the acceptable range.

findings.text_ko: 연간제품품질평가(annual product quality review) 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The annual product quality review procedure was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 공급자·제조자·시험자·포장자·표시자·유통자·수입자·도매상 간 품질계약서(quality agreement)의 보유·내용·유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 수입자는 의약품의 제조·포장/표시·시험에 사용되는 해외 제조소가 Guidance on Evidence to Demonstrate Drug GMP Compliance of Foreign Sites (GUI-0080)에 기술된 요건을 충족함을 보증하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The importer did not ensure that the foreign sites use to fabricate, package/label, or test drug products met the requirements described in Guidance on Evidence to Demonstrate Drug GMP Compliance of Foreign Sites (GUI-0080).

findings.text_ko: 회수(recall)에 대한 문서화된 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The written procedures for recalls were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 의약품의 품질과 안전한 유통이 유지되도록 보관·운송 조건을 보장하기 위한 지침·절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The guidelines and/or procedures were inadequate in ensuring storage and/or transportation conditions would maintain the quality and safe distribution of the drug.

findings.text_ko: 의약품의 지속적 안정성시험(ongoing stability) 프로그램이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The ongoing stability program for a drug was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 작업자에 대한 GMP 교육·기록 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The training of personnel in good manufacturing practices and/or the maintenance of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 공급자, 제조원, 시험기관, 포장업체, 표시(라벨링)업체, 유통업체, 수입업체 및/또는 도매업체 간 품질계약(quality agreement)의 구비·내용 및/또는 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고 및/또는 후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 완제품 출하를 위한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment to release finished products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 컴퓨터화시스템을 포함한 설비의 교정·점검·적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고·후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 변경사항이 적절히 문서화·평가 및/또는 승인되도록 보장하기 위한 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 원자재, 공정 중 의약품, 벌크 의약품 및/또는 완제품에 대한 검체의 취급 및/또는 보관이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The handling and/or storage of samples was inadequate for raw materials, drugs being processed, bulk drugs, and/or finished products.

findings.text_ko: 의약품의 지속적 안정성시험(ongoing stability) 프로그램이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The ongoing stability program for a drug was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: GMP 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다. 품질관리부서가 GMP 문서 및 표준작업지침서(SOP)를 승인·서명·날짜 기재하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate. The quality control department did not approve, sign, and/or date the good manufacturing practices documents and/or the standard operating procedures.

findings.text_ko: 품질경영시스템의 효과성을 실행·유지·개선하기 위해 적절하고 타당한 자원을 판단·제공하는 경영진의 역량이 미흡했다. 품질관리부서(quality control unit)가 요구되는 모든 업무를 수행하지 않았다. 품질관리부서는 독립적으로 기능하고 다른 부서와 독립적으로 경영진에 보고하는 별도의 조직이 아니었다.
findings.text_orig: Senior management's ability to determine and/or provide adequate and/or appropriate resources to implement, maintain and/or improve the effectiveness of the quality management system was inadequate. The quality control department did not undertake all of the required activities. The quality control department was not a distinct unit that functioned independently and reported to management independent of any other unit.

findings.text_ko: 회수(recall) 지원을 위한 제품 재고 및 유통기록 관리에 사용된 컴퓨터화시스템이 밸리데이션되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The computerized system used to manage product inventory and distribution records to support recalls was not validated.

findings.text_ko: 완제품 출하를 위한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment to release finished products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 공급자·제조자·시험자·포장자·표시자·유통업자·수입자·도매상 간 품질협약(quality agreement)의 구비·내용·유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 작업자에 대한 GMP 교육·기록 유지관리가 미흡했다. 작업자의 직무기술서, 부여된 권한 및 직무 위임이 미흡하거나 문서화되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The training of personnel in good manufacturing practices and/or the maintenance of records was inadequate. The job descriptions for personnel, the authority given to personnel, and/or the delegation of duties was inadequate and/or undocumented.

findings.text_ko: 컴퓨터화시스템을 포함한 설비의 교정·점검·적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다. 의약품의 품질과 안전한 유통이 유지되도록 보관·운송 조건을 보장하기 위한 지침·절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate. The guidelines and/or procedures were inadequate in ensuring storage and/or transportation conditions would maintain the quality and safe distribution of the drug.

findings.text_ko: 기준에 적합하지 않은 완제품 로트 또는 배치가 후속 제조 또는 판매에 사용될 수 있도록 제공되었다.
findings.text_orig: Lots or batches of finished product did not comply with the specifications and were made available for further fabrication or sale.

findings.text_ko: 제품 및 원자재의 오염 방지 조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The protection of products and/or materials from contamination was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: GMP 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 위생관리(sanitation) 프로그램의 청소 절차, 청소 주기, 폐기물 처리 절차 및/또는 방충·방서 대책이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The sanitation program was inadequate in its cleaning procedures, frequency of cleaning, procedures for waste disposal, and/or pest control measures.

findings.text_ko: 수입자는 의약품의 제조, 포장/표시 또는 시험에 사용하는 해외 제조소가 Guidance on Evidence to Demonstrate Drug GMP Compliance of Foreign Sites (GUI-0080)에 기술된 요건을 충족하는지 확인하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The importer did not ensure that the foreign sites use to fabricate, package/label, or test drug products met the requirements described in Guidance on Evidence to Demonstrate Drug GMP Compliance of Foreign Sites (GUI-0080).

findings.text_ko: 온도 및/또는 습도 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The temperature and/or humidity control was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: GMP 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 시험실의 설계·설비·유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The design, equipment, and/or maintenance of the testing laboratory was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 의약품의 지속적 안정성시험(ongoing stability) 프로그램이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The ongoing stability program for a drug was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 비위생적 상태를 방지하기 위한 세척절차의 실행·효과성·밸리데이션이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation, effectiveness, and/or validation of the cleaning procedures was inadequate for preventing unsanitary conditions.

findings.text_ko: 제조·포장 또는 표시·시험에 대한 책임을 규정한 품질협약(quality agreement)이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The quality agreement outlining the responsibilities for fabricating, packaging or labelling, and/or testing was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조공정·설비·원자재에 대한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Evaluation of production processes, equipment, and/or materials was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 설비의 예방정비 및 수리가 미흡했다. 컴퓨터화시스템을 포함한 설비의 교정·점검·적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The preventative maintenance and repair of the equipment was inadequate. The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 비위생적 상태를 방지하기 위한 위생관리(sanitation) 프로그램의 실행·효과성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation and/or the effectiveness of the sanitation program in preventing unsanitary conditions was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 생성·수정·검토·보관·검색에 대한 통제가 미흡했다. 기록의 추적성·가독성·문서화·서식·정확성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The controls were inadequate for creating, modifying, reviewing, storing, and/or retrieving records. The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 유틸리티 및 지원설비의 적격성평가(qualification)·검증이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The qualification and/or verification of utilities and/or support systems was inadequate.
