findings.text_orig: Changes to production processes, systems, equipment, materials, and/or suppliers were not validated before they were implemented. The master formulas to control the manufacturing process were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 불만 및/또는 결함 가능성이 있는 제품에 관한 그 밖의 정보에 대한 평가·기록·후속조치·조사가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment, recording, follow-up, and/or investigation of complaints and/or other information about potentially defective products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 완제품 규격 적합성을 입증하는 데 필요한 근거자료가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The evidence required to demonstrate compliance with finished product specifications was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조공정·설비 및/또는 자재에 대한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Evaluation of production processes, equipment, and/or materials was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 연간 제품품질평가(annual product quality review) 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The annual product quality review procedure was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 보관 및/또는 운송 조건이 의약품의 품질과 안전한 유통을 유지하도록 보장하는 지침 및/또는 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The guidelines and/or procedures were inadequate in ensuring storage and/or transportation conditions would maintain the quality and safe distribution of the drug.

findings.text_ko: 의약품에 대한 지속적 안정성시험(ongoing stability) 프로그램이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The ongoing stability program for a drug was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 변경관리 시스템이 변경사항의 적절한 문서화·평가·승인을 보장하기에 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control department)가 요구되는 업무를 모두 수행하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department did not undertake all of the required activities.

findings.text_ko: GMP 관련 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 추적성·가독성·문서화·서식 및/또는 정확성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고·후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The maintenance of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 환경 시료채취(environmental sampling) 방법이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The environmental sampling methods were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 해당 업체의 충전 용기에 대한 육안검사가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The company's visual inspection of filled containers was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 원료 로트의 각 용기에 대하여 내용물을 확인하기 위한 특이적이고 식별력 있는 시험이 실시되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: Each container of a lot of raw materials was not tested to identify its contents with a specific, discriminating test.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고 및/또는 후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기준일탈(OOS) 시험결과의 조사·처리·보고가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The investigation, handling, and/or reporting of test results that were out-of-specification was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조 및/또는 포장 과정에서 의약품 및/또는 원자재의 오염을 최소화하기에 시설 및/또는 제조공정이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The premises and/or the manufacturing process were inadequate for minimizing contamination of the drugs and/or materials during fabrication and/or packaging.

findings.text_ko: 위생관리 프로그램이 오염 위험을 파악 및/또는 저감하도록 적절히 설계되지 않았다. 시험법 밸리데이션(validation)이 미흡했다. 설비가 다른 의약품 및/또는 이물에 의한 의약품 오염 가능성을 방지하도록 설치·설계·운영·보관 및/또는 유지관리되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The sanitation programs were not adequately designed to identify and/or reduce the risks of contamination. The validation of test methods was inadequate. The equipment was not set-up, designed, operated, stored, and/or maintained to prevent potential contamination of drugs by other drugs and/or by foreign material.

findings.text_ko: 시험법 밸리데이션(validation)이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The validation of test methods was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 추적성·가독성·문서화·서식 및/또는 정확성이 미흡했다. 기록된 정보 또는 세부내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate. The recorded information or details were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 전산화시스템(computerized system)을 포함한 설비의 교정·점검 및/또는 적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 자체점검(self-inspection) 프로그램의 실행이 미흡했다. 문서화된 자체점검(self-inspection) 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation of a self-inspection program was inadequate. The written self-inspection procedure was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 생성·수정·검토·보관·검색에 대한 통제가 미흡했다. 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 검토·개정·승인 체계가 미흡했다. 기록의 추적성·가독성·문서화·서식 및/또는 정확성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The controls were inadequate for creating, modifying, reviewing, storing, and/or retrieving records. The system for reviewing, revising, and approving standard operating procedures was inadequate. The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 사용된 자재를 품질관리부서(quality control department)가 출고 승인(release)하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department did not release the materials that were used.

findings.text_ko: 반품 의약품의 재판매 검토에 대한 평가·문서화 및/또는 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment, documentation, and/or procedures for considering the resale of returned drugs were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 신규 또는 개정된 표준작업지침서(SOP) 시행 전 작업자 교육이 미흡했다. 작업자에 대한 지속적인 교육이 미흡했다. 작업자에 대한 GMP 교육 및/또는 그 기록의 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The training of personnel before new or revised standard operating procedures were implemented was inadequate. The ongoing training of personnel was inadequate. The training of personnel in good manufacturing practices and/or the maintenance of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 온도 및/또는 습도 관리가 미흡했다. 의약품 각 로트 또는 배치의 운송 및/또는 보관 조건을 입증하는 데 사용된 근거자료가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The temperature and/or humidity control was inadequate. The evidence used to demonstrate the transportation and/or storage conditions of each lot or batch of the drug was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 공급자·제조자·시험자·포장자·표시자·유통업자·수입자·도매상 간 품질계약서(quality agreement)의 구비·내용·유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고·후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 변경관리 시스템이 변경사항의 적절한 문서화·평가·승인을 보장하기에 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 추적성·가독성·문서화·서식 및/또는 정확성이 미흡했다. 회수(recall) 대상 제품의 식별 및 보관이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate. The identification and storage of recalled products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조자, 포장자/표시자, 유통업자 또는 수입자가 수행한 수탁업체 역량 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment of the contractor's competencies by the fabricator, packager/labeller, distributor, or importer was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 수입자가 의약품의 제조, 포장/표시 또는 시험에 사용하는 해외 제조소가 Guidance on Evidence to Demonstrate Drug GMP Compliance of Foreign Sites (GUI-0080) 에 기술된 요구사항을 충족하는지 확인하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The importer did not ensure that the foreign sites use to fabricate, package/label, or test drug products met the requirements described in Guidance on Evidence to Demonstrate Drug GMP Compliance of Foreign Sites (GUI-0080).

findings.text_ko: 의약품의 지속적 안정성시험 프로그램(ongoing stability program)이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The ongoing stability program for a drug was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 원료 공급업체와 의약품 제조업체 간 서면 계약의 구비 여부 및/또는 그 내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability and/or the content of the written agreement between the raw material vendor and the drug fabricator was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 위생관리 프로그램이 오염 위험을 파악 및/또는 저감하도록 적절히 설계되지 않았다. 위생관리 프로그램의 세척절차·세척주기·폐기물 처리절차 및/또는 방충·방서 조치가 미흡했다. 설비가 다른 의약품 및/또는 이물에 의한 의약품 오염 가능성을 방지하도록 설치·설계·운영·보관 및/또는 유지관리되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The sanitation programs were not adequately designed to identify and/or reduce the risks of contamination. The sanitation program was inadequate in its cleaning procedures, frequency of cleaning, procedures for waste disposal, and/or pest control measures. The equipment was not set-up, designed, operated, stored, and/or maintained to prevent potential contamination of drugs by other drugs and/or by foreign material.

findings.text_ko: 의약품 각 로트 또는 배치의 운송 및/또는 보관 조건을 입증하는 데 사용된 근거자료가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The evidence used to demonstrate the transportation and/or storage conditions of each lot or batch of the drug was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control unit)가 요구되는 모든 업무를 수행하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department did not undertake all of the required activities.

findings.text_ko: 제조·포장 또는 표시 및/또는 시험에 대한 책임을 규정한 품질계약서(quality agreement)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The quality agreement outlining the responsibilities for fabricating, packaging or labelling, and/or testing was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 직원에 대한 GMP 교육 및/또는 그 기록의 유지관리가 미흡했다. 직원의 직무기술서, 직원에게 부여된 권한 및/또는 직무 위임이 미흡하거나 문서화되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The training of personnel in good manufacturing practices and/or the maintenance of records was inadequate. The job descriptions for personnel, the authority given to personnel, and/or the delegation of duties was inadequate and/or undocumented.

findings.text_ko: 기록된 정보 또는 세부사항이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The recorded information or details were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 설비의 밸리데이션(validation) 또는 설비의 계획적 유지보수가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The validation of equipment or the planned maintenance of equipment was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 시험실 데이터의 생성·유지관리·처리 및/또는 검토가 미흡했다. 기록의 생성·수정·검토·보관 및/또는 검색에 대한 통제가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The creation, maintenance, processing, and/or review of laboratory data was inadequate. The controls were inadequate for creating, modifying, reviewing, storing, and/or retrieving records.

findings.text_ko: 용기가 입고 시 세척되거나 표시되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: Containers were not cleaned or labelled when they were received.

findings.text_ko: 충전된 용기에 대한 회사의 외관검사(visual inspection)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The company's visual inspection of filled containers was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 생성·수정·검토·보관·검색에 대한 통제가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The controls were inadequate for creating, modifying, reviewing, storing, and/or retrieving records.

findings.text_ko: 제조공정, 설비 및/또는 자재에 대한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Evaluation of production processes, equipment, and/or materials was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control department)가 연간제품품질평가(annual product quality review) 결과를 평가하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department did not evaluate the results of the annual product quality review.

findings.text_ko: 주요 제조 및/또는 시험 작업에 사용되는 설비에 대한 예방정비 프로그램이 미흡했다. 컴퓨터화시스템을 포함한 설비의 교정, 점검 및/또는 적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The preventative maintenance program was inadequate for the equipment used in significant processing and/or testing operations. The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기준에서 벗어난 일탈(deviation)이 있었던 경우 및/또는 제품이 허용범위 경계에 있었던 경우에 대한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The evaluation was inadequate for cases where there was a deviation from the norm and/or where products were on the borderline of the acceptable range.

findings.text_ko: 건물·시설의 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The maintenance of the premises was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 위생관리(sanitation) 프로그램이 오염 위험을 파악 및/또는 저감하도록 적절히 설계되지 않았다. 비위생적 상태를 방지하기 위한 세척절차의 실행, 효과성 및/또는 밸리데이션(validation)이 미흡했다. 시험방법 밸리데이션(validation)이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The sanitation programs were not adequately designed to identify and/or reduce the risks of contamination. The implementation, effectiveness, and/or validation of the cleaning procedures was inadequate for preventing unsanitary conditions. The validation of test methods was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 시험방법 밸리데이션(validation)이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The validation of test methods was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 변경이 적절히 문서화·평가 및/또는 승인되도록 보증하는 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 회사가 의약품, 원료 및/또는 원료의약품(active ingredient)의 각 로트 또는 배치 검체를 적절한 조건에서 보관하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The company did not store a sample from each lot or batch of a drug, raw material, and/or an active ingredient under the proper conditions.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사, 보고 및/또는 후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 불만사항 및/또는 결함 가능성이 있는 제품에 관한 기타 정보의 평가·기록·후속조치 및/또는 조사가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment, recording, follow-up, and/or investigation of complaints and/or other information about potentially defective products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 데이터 거버넌스(data governance) 계획의 수립 및/또는 유지가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The establishment and/or the maintenance of a data governance plan was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 변경사항의 적절한 문서화·평가 및/또는 승인을 보장하기에 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 격리구역(quarantine area)의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The control of quarantine areas was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 추적성·가독성·문서화·서식 및/또는 정확성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 회수(recall) 지원을 위한 제품 재고 및 유통기록 관리에 사용되는 컴퓨터화시스템이 밸리데이션(validation)되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The computerized system used to manage product inventory and distribution records to support recalls was not validated.

findings.text_ko: 원료·포장재·중간제품·벌크의약품 및/또는 완제품의 구획 분리, 재고 회전, 운송이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The segregation, rotation of stock, and/or the transportation of raw materials, packaging materials, intermediates, bulk drugs, and/or finished products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 공급자·제조자·시험자·포장자·표시자·유통업자·수입자·도매상 간 품질계약서(quality agreement)의 구비·내용·유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.

findings.text_orig: The importer did not ensure that the foreign sites use to fabricate, package/label, or test drug products met the requirements described in Guidance on Evidence to Demonstrate Drug GMP Compliance of Foreign Sites (GUI-0080).

findings.text_ko: 수탁업체에 대한 회사의 관리감독이 미흡했다.

findings.text_ko: 직원의 직무기술서, 직원에게 부여된 권한, 업무 위임이 미흡하거나 문서화되지 않았다. GMP에 대한 직원 교육 또는 관련 기록의 유지관리가 미흡했다.

findings.text_ko: 제조기준서(master production document)가 미흡했다.

findings.text_ko: 원자재 샘플링 계획이 미흡했다. 원자재의 각 로트 또는 배치를 의약품 제조에 사용하기 전에 원자재 기준규격에 따라 시험하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The sampling plan for raw materials was inadequate. Each lot or batch of raw materials was not tested against the raw material specifications before it was used to fabricate a drug.

The equipment was not set-up, designed, operated, stored, and/or maintained to prevent potential contamination of drugs by other drugs and/or by foreign material. The implementation, effectiveness, and/or validation of the cleaning procedures was inadequate for preventing unsanitary conditions. The sanitation program was inadequate in its cleaning procedures, frequency of cleaning, procedures for waste disposal, and/or pest control measures.

findings.text_orig: The equipment was not set-up, designed, operated, stored, and/or maintained to prevent potential contamination of drugs by other drugs and/or by foreign material. The preventative maintenance and repair of the equipment was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 변경사항의 적절한 문서화·평가·승인을 보증하기에 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 시험법 이전(test method transfer)에 대한 문서화된 프로토콜 또는 그 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The written protocol and/or the assessment of the test method transfer was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 의약품에 대한 지속적 안정성시험(ongoing stability) 프로그램이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The ongoing stability program for a drug was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 의약품 각 로트 또는 배치의 운송 및 보관 조건을 입증하는 데 사용된 증빙이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The evidence used to demonstrate the transportation and/or storage conditions of each lot or batch of the drug was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조·포장·표시·요구되는 시험·보관 및/또는 유통과 그 각각의 조건에 대한 증빙의 관리가 미흡했다. 기록의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The maintenance of evidence was inadequate for manufacturing, packaging, labelling, required testing, storage, and/or distribution, including the respective conditions. The maintenance of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고 및/또는 후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조 기준문서(master production document)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The master production documents were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 직원에 대한 GMP 교육 및/또는 그 기록의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The training of personnel in good manufacturing practices and/or the maintenance of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 직원에 대한 GMP 교육 및/또는 그 기록의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The training of personnel in good manufacturing practices and/or the maintenance of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기능하는 및/또는 독립적인 품질관리부서(quality control unit)가 존재한다는 증빙이 없었다. 품질관리 요건에 대한 의사결정을 책임지는 인원으로서 현장에 상주하는 및/또는 품질관리부서(quality control unit)가 온전히 활용할 수 있는 인원이 없었다.
findings.text_orig: There was no evidence of a functioning and/or independent quality control department. There was no person on site and/or fully available to the quality control department who was responsible for making decisions for the quality control requirements.

findings.text_ko: 문서화된 자체점검(self-inspection) 절차가 미흡했다. 자체점검(self-inspection) 프로그램의 실행이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The written self-inspection procedure was inadequate. The implementation of a self-inspection program was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control unit)가 요구되는 모든 업무를 수행하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department did not undertake all of the required activities.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고 및/또는 후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 건물·시설의 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The maintenance of the premises was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록된 정보 또는 세부 내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The recorded information or details were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control department) 책임자가 시행 전에 제조·포장·표시·시험·보관 및/또는 운송의 방법과 절차를 검토 및/또는 승인하는 것이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The examination and/or approval of fabrication, packaging, labelling, testing, storage, and/or the transportation method and procedures by the person in charge of the quality control department before implementation was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 공급자·제조업자·시험업자·포장업자·표시업자·유통업자·수입업자 및/또는 도매업자 간 품질계약서(quality agreement)의 구비·내용 및/또는 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 우수의약품 제조 및 품질관리기준(GMP) 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 연간 제품품질평가(annual product quality review) 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The annual product quality review procedure was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 변경사항의 적절한 문서화·평가 및/또는 승인을 보장하기에 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 검토·개정·승인 체계가 미흡했다. 기록의 추적성·가독성·문서화·서식 및/또는 정확성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The system for reviewing, revising, and approving standard operating procedures was inadequate. The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록된 정보 또는 세부 내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The recorded information or details were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 직원에 대한 GMP 교육 및/또는 그 기록의 관리가 미흡했다. 직원에 대한 지속적인 교육이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The training of personnel in good manufacturing practices and/or the maintenance of records was inadequate. The ongoing training of personnel was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 변경사항의 적절한 문서화·평가 및/또는 승인을 보장하기에 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The maintenance of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 주요 제조공정 및/또는 시험 작업에 사용된 장비의 사용기록(usage log)이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The usage logs for the equipment used for significant processing and/or testing operations were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 데이터 거버넌스(data governance) 계획의 수립 및/또는 유지가 미흡했다. 전자시스템이 의도된 용도에 대해 밸리데이션되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The establishment and/or the maintenance of a data governance plan was inadequate. The electronic system was not validated for its intended use.

findings.text_ko: 제조 및/또는 포장 중 의약품 및/또는 자재의 오염을 최소화하기에 건물·시설 및/또는 제조공정이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The premises and/or the manufacturing process were inadequate for minimizing contamination of the drugs and/or materials during fabrication and/or packaging.

findings.text_ko: 회사가 멸균된 부품, 용기 또는 장비의 보관허용기간(hold time)에 대한 타당성을 입증하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The company did not justify the hold time for sterilized components, containers, or equipment.

findings.text_ko: 문서화된 기준규격(specifications)이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The written specifications were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조공정·장비 및/또는 자재에 대한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Evaluation of production processes, equipment, and/or materials was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 수율 및/또는 수불 대조 수량을 적절한 단계에서 확인하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: Yields and/or the reconciled quantities were not checked at appropriate stages.

findings.text_ko: 컴퓨터화시스템을 포함한 장비의 교정·점검 및/또는 적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 추적성·가독성·문서화·서식 및/또는 정확성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 보관 및/또는 운송 조건이 의약품의 품질과 안전한 유통을 유지하도록 보장하는 지침 및/또는 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The guidelines and/or procedures were inadequate in ensuring storage and/or transportation conditions would maintain the quality and safe distribution of the drug.

findings.text_ko: 비위생적 상태를 방지하기 위한 세척 절차의 실행·유효성 및/또는 밸리데이션이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation, effectiveness, and/or validation of the cleaning procedures was inadequate for preventing unsanitary conditions.

findings.text_ko: 부유입자 및 미생물 한도를 초과한 경우 회사의 작업 절차에 조사 및 시정조치(CAPA) 실시가 규정되어 있지 않았다. 부유입자 모니터링 시스템이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: When the particulate and microbiological limits were exceeded, the company's operating procedures did not prescribe an investigation and implementation of corrective actions. The airborne particle monitoring system was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 회사가 청정구역의 미생물 오염과 부유입자수를 최소화하도록 건물·시설과 장비를 설계하거나 유지관리하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The company did not design or maintain the premises and equipment to minimize microbial contamination and the number of airborne particles in clean areas.

findings.text_ko: 제조공정·설비 및/또는 원자재에 대한 평가가 미흡했다. 해당 업체는 부유입자 및 미생물 모니터링 결과에 대한 적절한 경보기준(alert limit)과 조치기준(action limit)을 설정하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: Evaluation of production processes, equipment, and/or materials was inadequate. The company did not set appropriate alert and action limits for the results of particulate and microbiological monitoring.

findings.text_ko: 청정구역(clean area)에 대한 문서화된 위생관리 프로그램이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The written sanitation program for clean areas was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 각 청정등급별 문서화된 복장 기준이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The written clothing standards for each environmental grade were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 전산화시스템(computerized system)을 포함한 설비의 교정·점검 및/또는 적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 우수의약품 제조 및 품질관리기준(GMP) 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 유틸리티 및/또는 지원 시스템의 적격성평가(qualification) 및/또는 검증이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The qualification and/or verification of utilities and/or support systems was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 위생관리 프로그램이 오염 위험을 파악 및/또는 저감하도록 적절히 설계되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The sanitation programs were not adequately designed to identify and/or reduce the risks of contamination.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 생성·수정·검토·보관·검색에 대한 통제가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The controls were inadequate for creating, modifying, reviewing, storing, and/or retrieving records.

findings.text_ko: 의약품 제조업자의 원료 기준규격이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The drug fabricator's specifications for raw materials were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control unit)가 독립적으로 기능하고 다른 어떤 부서와도 독립적으로 경영진에 보고하는 별도의 조직이 아니었다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department was not a distinct unit that functioned independently and reported to management independent of any other unit.

findings.text_ko: 컴퓨터화시스템을 포함한 장비의 교정·점검 및/또는 적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제품 및/또는 자재의 오염 방지가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The protection of products and/or materials from contamination was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 위생관리 프로그램이 오염 위험을 파악 및/또는 저감하도록 적절히 설계되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The sanitation programs were not adequately designed to identify and/or reduce the risks of contamination.

findings.text_ko: 원료의 검체채취(sampling) 계획이 미흡했다. 의약품 제조에 사용되는 원료의 기준규격이 공정서(pharmacopoeia) 기준을 충족하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The sampling plan for raw materials was inadequate. The specifications for raw materials used to produce drugs did not meet pharmacopoeial standards.

findings.text_ko: GMP 관련 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 시약 및 배지(culture media)의 입고·조제 및/또는 취급이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The receipt, preparation, and/or handling of reagents and culture media was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 시험법의 밸리데이션이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The validation of test methods was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 온도 및/또는 습도 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The temperature and/or humidity control was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 시험실 데이터의 생성·관리·처리 및/또는 검토가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The creation, maintenance, processing, and/or review of laboratory data was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조소가 오염을 방지하도록 설계·시공·운영 및/또는 유지관리되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The premises were not designed, constructed, operated, and/or maintained to prevent contamination.

findings.text_ko: 변경관리(change control) 체계가 변경사항의 적절한 문서화·평가 및/또는 승인을 보증하기에 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 위생관리 프로그램이 오염 위험을 확인하고/또는 감소시키도록 적절히 설계되지 않았다. 세척 절차의 실행·효과성 및/또는 밸리데이션(validation)이 비위생적 상태를 방지하기에 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The sanitation programs were not adequately designed to identify and/or reduce the risks of contamination. The implementation, effectiveness, and/or validation of the cleaning procedures was inadequate for preventing unsanitary conditions.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고 및/또는 후속조치가 미흡했다. 기준일탈(OOS) 시험결과의 조사·처리·보고가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate. The investigation, handling, and/or reporting of test results that were out-of-specification was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 주요 공정 및/또는 시험 작업에 사용되는 설비의 사용기록(usage log)이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The usage logs for the equipment used for significant processing and/or testing operations were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조공정·설비 및/또는 자재에 대한 평가가 미흡했다. 밸리데이션(validation) 시험이 사전에 정한 프로토콜에 따라 수행되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: Evaluation of production processes, equipment, and/or materials was inadequate. Validation studies were not conducted in keeping with the predefined protocols.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 생성·수정·검토·보관·검색에 대한 통제가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The controls were inadequate for creating, modifying, reviewing, storing, and/or retrieving records.

findings.text_ko: 건물 내로 해충 및/또는 이물이 유입되는 것을 방지하도록 시설이 설계·시공 및/또는 유지관리되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The premises were not designed, constructed, and/or maintained to prevent the entry of pests and/or foreign material into the building.

findings.text_ko: 의약품 각 로트 또는 배치의 운송 및/또는 보관 조건을 입증하는 데 사용된 증빙이 미흡했다. 보관 및/또는 운송 조건이 의약품의 품질과 안전한 유통을 유지하도록 보장하는 데 있어 지침 및/또는 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The evidence used to demonstrate the transportation and/or storage conditions of each lot or batch of the drug was inadequate. The guidelines and/or procedures were inadequate in ensuring storage and/or transportation conditions would maintain the quality and safe distribution of the drug.

findings.text_ko: 기준일탈(OOS) 시험결과의 조사·처리·보고가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The investigation, handling, and/or reporting of test results that were out-of-specification was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 시약 및 배지의 입고·조제 및/또는 취급이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The receipt, preparation, and/or handling of reagents and culture media was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 원료 공급업체와 의약품 제조업자 간 문서화된 계약의 구비 및/또는 내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability and/or the content of the written agreement between the raw material vendor and the drug fabricator was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 주요 제조공정 및/또는 시험 작업에 사용되는 설비에 대한 예방정비 프로그램이 미흡했다. 전산화시스템(computerized system)을 포함한 설비의 교정·점검 및/또는 적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The preventative maintenance program was inadequate for the equipment used in significant processing and/or testing operations. The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록된 정보 또는 세부내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The recorded information or details were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 불만 및/또는 결함 가능성이 있는 제품에 관한 그 밖의 정보에 대한 평가·기록·후속조치 및/또는 조사가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment, recording, follow-up, and/or investigation of complaints and/or other information about potentially defective products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고 및/또는 후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 시험실 데이터의 생성·관리·처리 및/또는 검토가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The creation, maintenance, processing, and/or review of laboratory data was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사, 보고 및/또는 후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 정본 시험성적서(certificate of analysis)의 구비 여부 또는 그 내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability or the content of the authentic certificate of analysis was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 수입자가 의약품의 제조, 포장/표시 또는 시험에 사용하는 해외 제조소가 Guidance on Evidence to Demonstrate Drug GMP Compliance of Foreign Sites (GUI-0080) 에 기술된 요구사항을 충족하는지 확인하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The importer did not ensure that the foreign sites use to fabricate, package/label, or test drug products met the requirements described in Guidance on Evidence to Demonstrate Drug GMP Compliance of Foreign Sites (GUI-0080).

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control department)가 GMP 문서 및/또는 표준작업지침서(SOP)를 승인·서명 및/또는 일자 기재하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department did not approve, sign, and/or date the good manufacturing practices documents and/or the standard operating procedures.

findings.text_ko: 원료·포장재·표시자재·완제품 및/또는 재작업 중인 제품에 대한 품질관리부서(quality control department)의 승인이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department's approval was inadequate for raw materials, packaging materials, labelling, finished products, and/or products being reprocessed.

findings.text_ko: 문서가 해당 사업장에 비치되어 있지 않았다. 기록된 정보 또는 세부 내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Documents were not available on the premises. The recorded information or details were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 변경사항의 적절한 문서화·평가 및/또는 승인을 보장하기에 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 보관 및/또는 운송 조건이 의약품의 품질과 안전한 유통을 유지하도록 보장하는 지침 및/또는 절차가 미흡했다. 컴퓨터화시스템을 포함한 장비의 교정·점검 및/또는 적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The guidelines and/or procedures were inadequate in ensuring storage and/or transportation conditions would maintain the quality and safe distribution of the drug. The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 회사가 Health Canada 에 신청서를 제출하지 않은 채 캐나다 국외의 검체 보관 장소를 사용했다.
findings.text_orig: The company used sample retention sites outside of Canada without sending a request to Health Canada.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control department) 책임자의 품질관리 결정사항을 문서화하는 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The procedure was inadequate for documenting quality control decisions by the person in charge of the quality control department.

findings.text_ko: 제조공정·장비 및/또는 자재에 대한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Evaluation of production processes, equipment, and/or materials was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 전자시스템이 의도된 용도에 대해 밸리데이션되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The electronic system was not validated for its intended use.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control department)가 독립적으로 기능하고 다른 어떤 부서와도 독립적으로 경영진에 보고하는 별도의 조직이 아니었다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department was not a distinct unit that functioned independently and reported to management independent of any other unit.

findings.text_ko: 온도 및/또는 습도 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The temperature and/or humidity control was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control department) 책임자의 업무가 자격을 갖추지 않은 사람에게 위임되었다.
findings.text_orig: The duties of the individual in charge of the quality control department were delegated to an unqualified individual.

findings.text_ko: 문서화된 자체점검(self-inspection) 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The written self-inspection procedure was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 문서화된 기준규격(specifications)이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The written specifications were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 컴퓨터화시스템을 포함한 장비의 교정·점검 및/또는 적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 완제품 출하를 위한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment to release finished products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 연간 제품품질평가(annual product quality review) 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The annual product quality review procedure was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 컴퓨터화시스템을 포함한 장비의 교정·점검 및/또는 적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다. 습열멸균(moist heat sterilization) 사이클에 대한 회사의 모니터링과 문서화가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate. The company's monitoring and documentation of moist heat sterilization cycles was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 컴퓨터화시스템을 포함한 장비의 교정·점검 및/또는 적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 시험법의 밸리데이션 및/또는 문서화가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The validation and/or the documentation of test methods was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 미생물 및/또는 환경 조건에 대한 모니터링 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The monitoring procedures for microbial and/or environmental conditions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 데이터 거버넌스(data governance) 계획의 수립 및/또는 유지가 미흡했다. 기록의 추적성·가독성·문서화·서식 및/또는 정확성이 미흡했다. 기록된 정보 또는 세부 내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The establishment and/or the maintenance of a data governance plan was inadequate. The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate. The recorded information or details were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 시험실 데이터의 생성·관리·처리 및/또는 검토가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The creation, maintenance, processing, and/or review of laboratory data was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 시약 및 배지(culture media)의 입고·조제 및/또는 취급이 미흡했다. 배지의 적합성을 검증하지 않았다. 조제된 배지의 사용기한이 성장촉진시험(growth-promotion testing)으로 뒷받침되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The receipt, preparation, and/or handling of reagents and culture media was inadequate. The suitability of the culture media was not verified. The expiry date of the prepared culture media was not supported by the growth-promotion testing.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고 및/또는 후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 수입업체가 의약품의 제조·포장/표시 또는 시험에 사용되는 해외 제조소가 Guidance on Evidence to Demonstrate Drug GMP Compliance of Foreign Sites (GUI-0080)에 기술된 요건을 충족하는지 확인하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The importer did not ensure that the foreign sites use to fabricate, package/label, or test drug products met the requirements described in Guidance on Evidence to Demonstrate Drug GMP Compliance of Foreign Sites (GUI-0080).

findings.text_ko: 의약품의 지속적 안정성시험 프로그램이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The ongoing stability program for a drug was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 검토·개정·승인 체계가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The system for reviewing, revising, and approving standard operating procedures was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 건물 내부로 해충 및/또는 이물이 유입되는 것을 방지하도록 시설을 설계·시공·유지관리하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The premises were not designed, constructed, and/or maintained to prevent the entry of pests and/or foreign material into the building.

findings.text_ko: 작업자에 대한 지속적인 교육이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The ongoing training of personnel was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 자체점검(self-inspection) 프로그램의 실시가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation of a self-inspection program was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 추적성·가독성·문서화·서식·정확성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 포장 작업이 문서화된 작업절차 또는 기준(specification)에 따라 수행되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: Packaging operations were not performed in keeping with the written operating procedures or specifications.

findings.text_ko: 설비가 의도된 용도로 사용될 수 있도록 하는 데 있어 설비의 설계·위치·유지관리가 미흡했다
findings.text_orig: The design, location, and/or maintenance of the equipment was inadequate for allowing the equipment to serve its intended purpose

findings.text_ko: 유틸리티 및/또는 지원 시스템의 적격성평가(qualification)·검증이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The qualification and/or verification of utilities and/or support systems was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 오염으로부터 제품 및/또는 자재를 보호하는 조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The protection of products and/or materials from contamination was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 사전 승인된 문서화된 절차 또는 지시에 따른 원료·제품·포장재의 취급이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The handling of raw materials, products, or packaging materials in keeping with pre-approved written procedures or instructions was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 시험실 데이터의 생성·유지관리·처리·검토가 미흡했다. 컴퓨터화 시스템을 포함한 설비의 교정·점검·적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The creation, maintenance, processing, and/or review of laboratory data was inadequate. The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The maintenance of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 컴퓨터화 시스템을 포함한 설비의 교정·점검·적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 의약품 제조업체(fabricator)의 원료 기준(specification)이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The drug fabricator's specifications for raw materials were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 비위생적 상태를 방지하기 위한 위생관리 프로그램의 시행·실효성이 미흡했다. 비위생적 상태를 방지하기 위한 세척절차의 시행·실효성·밸리데이션(validation)이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation and/or the effectiveness of the sanitation program in preventing unsanitary conditions was inadequate. The implementation, effectiveness, and/or validation of the cleaning procedures was inadequate for preventing unsanitary conditions.

findings.text_ko: 작업자의 직무기술서·부여 권한·업무 위임이 미흡했거나 문서화되어 있지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The job descriptions for personnel, the authority given to personnel, and/or the delegation of duties was inadequate and/or undocumented.

findings.text_ko: 설비의 예방정비 및 수리가 미흡했다. 다른 의약품 및/또는 이물에 의한 의약품 오염 가능성을 방지하도록 설비를 설치·설계·운전·보관·유지관리하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The preventative maintenance and repair of the equipment was inadequate. The equipment was not set-up, designed, operated, stored, and/or maintained to prevent potential contamination of drugs by other drugs and/or by foreign material.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고·후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control department)가 요구되는 모든 업무를 수행하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department did not undertake all of the required activities.

findings.text_ko: 직원에 대한 GMP 교육 및/또는 관련 기록의 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The training of personnel in good manufacturing practices and/or the maintenance of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록된 정보 또는 세부사항이 미흡했다. 기록의 추적성·가독성·문서화·서식 및/또는 정확성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The recorded information or details were inadequate. The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 데이터 거버넌스 계획(data governance plan)의 수립 및/또는 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The establishment and/or the maintenance of a data governance plan was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 컴퓨터화시스템을 포함한 장비의 교정·점검 및/또는 적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서 책임자가 실시 전에 수행하는 제조·포장·표시·시험·보관 및/또는 운송 방법 및 절차에 대한 검토 및/또는 승인이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The examination and/or approval of fabrication, packaging, labelling, testing, storage, and/or the transportation method and procedures by the person in charge of the quality control department before implementation was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질경영시스템의 유효성을 실행·유지 및/또는 개선하기 위해 적절하고 충분한 자원을 결정 및/또는 제공하는 경영진의 역량이 미흡했다. 데이터 거버넌스 계획(data governance plan)의 수립 및/또는 유지관리가 미흡했다. 직원에 대한 GMP 교육 및/또는 관련 기록의 유지관리가 미흡했다. 컴퓨터화시스템을 포함한 장비의 교정·점검 및/또는 적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Senior management's ability to determine and/or provide adequate and/or appropriate resources to implement, maintain and/or improve the effectiveness of the quality management system was inadequate. The establishment and/or the maintenance of a data governance plan was inadequate. The training of personnel in good manufacturing practices and/or the maintenance of records was inadequate. The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 의약품 품질에 관하여 접수된 불만 및/또는 정보에 대한 품질관리부서의 처리가 미흡했다. 기준일탈(OOS) 시험결과의 조사·처리·보고가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department's handling of complaints and/or information received about drug quality was inadequate. The investigation, handling, and/or reporting of test results that were out-of-specification was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 변경사항이 적절히 문서화·평가 및/또는 승인되도록 보장하는 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고·후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 원료 공급업체와 의약품 제조업체(fabricator) 간 서면계약의 구비·내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability and/or the content of the written agreement between the raw material vendor and the drug fabricator was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 시험방법이 밸리데이션(validation)되지 않았거나 시험법 이관(method transfer) 연구가 수행되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: Test methods were not validated or the method transfer studies were not conducted.

findings.text_ko: 진본 시험성적서(authentic certificate of analysis)의 구비 또는 내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability or the content of the authentic certificate of analysis was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 위생관리 프로그램의 세척절차·세척주기·폐기물 처리절차·방충방서 대책이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The sanitation program was inadequate in its cleaning procedures, frequency of cleaning, procedures for waste disposal, and/or pest control measures.

findings.text_ko: 변경사항이 적절히 문서화·평가·승인되도록 보장하는 데 있어 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 자체점검(self-inspection) 프로그램의 실시가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation of a self-inspection program was inadequate.

findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조공정·장비 및/또는 자재에 대한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Evaluation of production processes, equipment, and/or materials was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 위생관리 프로그램이 오염 위험을 파악 및/또는 저감하도록 적절히 설계되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The sanitation programs were not adequately designed to identify and/or reduce the risks of contamination.

findings.text_ko: 시험실 데이터의 생성·유지관리·처리 및/또는 검토가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The creation, maintenance, processing, and/or review of laboratory data was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 시험법 밸리데이션(validation)이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The validation of test methods was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 장비가 다른 의약품 및/또는 이물에 의한 의약품 오염 가능성을 방지하도록 설치·설계·운전·보관 및/또는 유지관리되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The equipment was not set-up, designed, operated, stored, and/or maintained to prevent potential contamination of drugs by other drugs and/or by foreign material.

findings.text_ko: 수입업체가 의약품의 제조·포장/표시 또는 시험에 사용되는 해외 제조소가 Guidance on Evidence to Demonstrate Drug GMP Compliance of Foreign Sites (GUI-0080)에 기술된 요건을 충족하는지 확인하지 않았다. 공급자·제조원·시험소·포장업체·표시업체·유통업체·수입업체 및/또는 도매업체 간 품질계약서(quality agreement)의 구비·내용 및/또는 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The importer did not ensure that the foreign sites use to fabricate, package/label, or test drug products met the requirements described in Guidance on Evidence to Demonstrate Drug GMP Compliance of Foreign Sites (GUI-0080). The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 연간제품품질평가(annual product quality review) 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The annual product quality review procedure was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 보관 및/또는 운송 조건이 의약품의 품질과 안전한 유통을 유지하도록 보장하는 지침 및/또는 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The guidelines and/or procedures were inadequate in ensuring storage and/or transportation conditions would maintain the quality and safe distribution of the drug.

findings.text_ko: 의약품의 지속적 안정성시험 프로그램이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The ongoing stability program for a drug was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 공정구역 또는 무균구역의 미생물학적 모니터링을 위한 검체 채취 절차가 미흡했다. 회사가 오염 가능성이나 시스템 저하를 방지하기에 충분한 빈도로 무균충전 구역을 모니터링하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The sampling procedure was inadequate for microbiological monitoring in processing areas or aseptic areas. The company did not monitor the aseptic filling area frequently enough to avoid possible contamination or system deterioration.

findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate. The temperature and/or humidity control was inadequate.

findings.text_orig: The annual product quality review procedure was inadequate.

findings.text_orig: The sanitation program was inadequate in its cleaning procedures, frequency of cleaning, procedures for waste disposal, and/or pest control measures.

findings.text_ko: 완제품 출하 판정을 위한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment to release finished products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 불만 및 결함 가능성이 있는 제품에 관한 기타 정보의 평가·기록·후속조치·조사가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment, recording, follow-up, and/or investigation of complaints and/or other information about potentially defective products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 변경사항이 적절히 문서화·평가·승인되도록 보장하는 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 공급업체·제조업체·시험업체·포장업체·표시업체·유통업체·수입업체·도매업체 간 품질계약(quality agreement)의 구비·내용·관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 전자서명에 대해 마련된 통제가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The controls put in place for electronic signatures were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 데이터 거버넌스 계획의 수립·유지가 미흡했다. 전자시스템이 의도된 용도에 대해 밸리데이션(validation)되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The establishment and/or the maintenance of a data governance plan was inadequate. The electronic system was not validated for its intended use.

findings.text_ko: 변경사항이 적절히 문서화·평가·승인되도록 보장하는 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 미흡했다. 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고·후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved. Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기준서(specification)가 문서로 작성되지 않았거나 품질관리부서(quality control unit) 책임자 또는 지정 대리인의 승인을 받지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The specifications were not in writing and/or approved by the person in charge of the quality control department or the designated alternative.

findings.text_ko: 수입업체는 의약품의 제조·포장/표시 또는 시험에 이용하는 해외 제조소가 Guidance on Evidence to Demonstrate Drug GMP Compliance of Foreign Sites (GUI-0080)에 기술된 요건을 충족하는지 확인하지 않았다. GMP 관련 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The importer did not ensure that the foreign sites use to fabricate, package/label, or test drug products met the requirements described in Guidance on Evidence to Demonstrate Drug GMP Compliance of Foreign Sites (GUI-0080). The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control unit) 책임자의 학력·경력·감독이 미흡했다. 작업자에 대한 GMP 교육 및 그 기록의 관리가 미흡했다. 작업자의 직무기술서·부여된 권한·업무 위임이 미흡하거나 문서화되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The education, experience, and/or oversight of the individual in charge of the quality control department was inadequate. The training of personnel in good manufacturing practices and/or the maintenance of records was inadequate. The job descriptions for personnel, the authority given to personnel, and/or the delegation of duties was inadequate and/or undocumented.

findings.text_ko: 자체점검(self-inspection) 프로그램의 실행이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation of a self-inspection program was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 보관용 검체에 관한 문서화된 절차와 기록이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The written procedures and records for retaining samples were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 온도 및/또는 습도 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The temperature and/or humidity control was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 검토·개정·승인 체계가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The system for reviewing, revising, and approving standard operating procedures was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 회수(recall)에 관한 문서화된 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The written procedures for recalls were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 불만 및 결함 가능성이 있는 제품에 관한 기타 정보의 평가·기록·후속조치·조사가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment, recording, follow-up, and/or investigation of complaints and/or other information about potentially defective products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리 요건에 관한 의사결정 책임자가 해당 직위의 책임을 수행하기에 충분한 현장 운영 지식을 갖추지 못했다.
findings.text_orig: The person responsible for making decisions about quality control requirements did not have adequate knowledge of on-site operations to fulfill the responsibilities of this position.

findings.text_ko: 각 환경 등급(grade)별 문서화된 복장 기준이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The written clothing standards for each environmental grade were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 회사는 무균제제 제조의 덜 중요한 공정 단계에 사용되는 청정구역(clean area)을 충분히 모니터링하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The company did not adequately monitor the clean areas used for the less critical stages of manufacturing sterile products.

findings.text_ko: 회사의 무균구역 시설 및 설비 세척이 미흡했다. 작업자의 무균조작(aseptic) 수행이 무균성을 유지하기에 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The company's cleaning of the premises and the equipment in aseptic areas was inadequate. The operators'aseptic practices were inadequate to maintain sterility.

findings.text_ko: 회사는 청정구역(clean area)의 미생물 오염과 부유입자 수를 최소화하도록 시설과 설비를 설계·유지관리하지 않았다. 설비의 설계·시공·운전·위치가 의약품 오염을 방지하기에 미흡했다. 무균조작(aseptic)이 수행되는 구역에서 모니터링의 주기와 방법이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The company did not design or maintain the premises and equipment to minimize microbial contamination and the number of airborne particles in clean areas. The design, construction, operation, and/or location of the equipment was inadequate for preventing contamination of the drug. In areas where aseptic operations were performed, the frequency and the methods of monitoring were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 작업자의 직무기술서·부여된 권한·업무 위임이 미흡하거나 문서화되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The job descriptions for personnel, the authority given to personnel, and/or the delegation of duties was inadequate and/or undocumented.

findings.text_ko: 회사는 멸균 후 재오염을 방지하기 위해 멸균된 자재를 충분히 보호하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The company did not adequately protect sterilized material to prevent re-contamination after sterilization.

findings.text_ko: 인사기록의 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The maintenance of personnel records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: GMP 관련 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 작업자에 대한 지속적 교육이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The ongoing training of personnel was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 추적성·가독성·문서화·서식 및/또는 정확성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 보관기간이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The retention time for records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: GMP 관련 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 컴퓨터화 시스템을 포함한 설비의 교정·점검·적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기준일탈(OOS) 시험결과의 조사·처리·보고가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The investigation, handling, and/or reporting of test results that were out-of-specification was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: GMP 관련 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 추적성·가독성·문서화·서식 및/또는 정확성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 컴퓨터화시스템을 포함한 설비의 교정·점검 및/또는 적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다. 기록의 생성·수정·검토·보관 및/또는 검색에 대한 통제가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate. The controls were inadequate for creating, modifying, reviewing, storing, and/or retrieving records.

findings.text_ko: 위생관리(sanitation) 프로그램이 오염 위험을 확인 및/또는 저감하도록 적절히 설계되지 않았다. 비위생적 상태를 방지하기 위한 위생관리(sanitation) 프로그램의 실행 및/또는 효과성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The sanitation programs were not adequately designed to identify and/or reduce the risks of contamination. The implementation and/or the effectiveness of the sanitation program in preventing unsanitary conditions was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: GMP 관련 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 시설의 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The maintenance of the premises was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조공정·설비 및/또는 자재에 대한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Evaluation of production processes, equipment, and/or materials was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 의약품의 청결하고 위생적인 제조·포장 및/또는 표시를 보증하기 위한 작업자 최소 건강·위생 요건의 이행이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation of minimum health and hygiene requirements for personnel was inadequate for ensuring the clean and sanitary fabrication, packaging, and/or labelling of drugs.

findings.text_ko: 시험실 데이터의 생성·유지·처리 및/또는 검토가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The creation, maintenance, processing, and/or review of laboratory data was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 공급자·제조자·시험자·포장자·표시자·유통업자·수입자 및/또는 도매상 간 품질계약서(quality agreement)의 구비·내용 및/또는 유지관리가 미흡했다. 품질관리부서(quality control unit)가 요구되는 모든 업무를 수행하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate. The quality control department did not undertake all of the required activities.

findings.text_ko: 컴퓨터화시스템을 포함한 설비의 교정·점검 및/또는 적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 유지관리가 미흡했다. 기록의 추적성·가독성·문서화·서식 및/또는 정확성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The maintenance of records was inadequate. The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기준일탈(OOS) 시험결과의 조사·처리 및/또는 보고가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The investigation, handling, and/or reporting of test results that were out-of-specification was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control unit)는 로트 및/또는 배치의 재처리(reprocessing) 및/또는 재작업(reworking)을 적절히 승인·평가 및/또는 문서화하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department did not appropriately approve, assess, and/or document the reprocessing and/or reworking of a lot and/or batch.

findings.text_ko: 보관 및/또는 운송 조건이 의약품의 품질과 안전한 유통을 유지하도록 보증하는 지침 및/또는 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The guidelines and/or procedures were inadequate in ensuring storage and/or transportation conditions would maintain the quality and safe distribution of the drug.

findings.text_ko: 의약품의 지속적 안정성시험(ongoing stability) 프로그램이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The ongoing stability program for a drug was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 각 공급업체로부터 입고된 원료에 대해 완전한 확인시험(confirmatory testing)을 실시하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: Complete confirmatory testing was not conducted on raw materials from each vendor.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고 및/또는 후속조치가 미흡했다. 원료의 출고 및 입고에 관한 표준작업지침서(SOP) 또는 기록이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate. The standard operating procedures or records for shipping and receiving raw materials were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 주요 제조공정 및/또는 시험 작업에 사용되는 설비에 대해 예방정비(preventative maintenance) 체계가 수립되어 있지 않았다. 컴퓨터화시스템을 포함한 설비의 교정·점검 및/또는 적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: A preventative maintenance system had not been established for the equipment used in significant processing and/or testing operations The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 변경관리 시스템이 변경사항의 적절한 문서화·평가 및/또는 승인을 보증하기에 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 의약품 제조자의 원료 기준규격이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The drug fabricator's specifications for raw materials were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 회사는 멸균 전 모든 공정 단계에서 오염을 최소화하기 위한 예방조치를 취하지 않았다. 작업자의 무균공정(aseptic) 조작이 무균성을 유지하기에 미흡했다. 무균제품 생산에 사용되는 청정구역(clean area)의 상태가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The company did not take precautions to minimize contamination during all processing prior to sterilization. The operators'aseptic practices were inadequate to maintain sterility. The condition of the clean area used to produce sterile products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 생성·수정·검토·보관 및/또는 검색에 대한 통제가 미흡했다. 기록의 추적성·가독성·문서화·서식 및/또는 정확성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The controls were inadequate for creating, modifying, reviewing, storing, and/or retrieving records. The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 충전된 용기에 대한 회사의 육안검사가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The company's visual inspection of filled containers was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 시험방법 밸리데이션(validation)이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The validation of test methods was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 위생관리(sanitation) 프로그램이 오염 위험을 확인 및/또는 저감하도록 적절히 설계되지 않았다. 비위생적 상태를 방지하기 위한 위생관리(sanitation) 프로그램의 실행 및/또는 효과성이 미흡했다. 시험방법 밸리데이션(validation)이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The sanitation programs were not adequately designed to identify and/or reduce the risks of contamination. The implementation and/or the effectiveness of the sanitation program in preventing unsanitary conditions was inadequate. The validation of test methods was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 데이터 거버넌스 계획의 수립 및/또는 유지관리가 미흡했다. 전자서명에 대해 마련된 통제가 미흡했다. 기록의 생성·수정·검토·보관 및/또는 검색에 대한 통제가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The establishment and/or the maintenance of a data governance plan was inadequate. The controls put in place for electronic signatures were inadequate. The controls were inadequate for creating, modifying, reviewing, storing, and/or retrieving records.

findings.text_ko: 온도 및/또는 습도 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The temperature and/or humidity control was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 공급자·제조자·시험자·포장자·표시자·유통업자·수입자 및/또는 도매상 간 품질계약서(quality agreement)의 구비·내용 및/또는 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 작업자의 직무기술서·부여된 권한 및/또는 업무 위임이 미흡하거나 문서화되어 있지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The job descriptions for personnel, the authority given to personnel, and/or the delegation of duties was inadequate and/or undocumented.

findings.text_ko: 격리구역(quarantine area) 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The control of quarantine areas was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 회수(recall) 지원을 위한 제품 재고 및 유통기록 관리에 사용되는 전산화 시스템이 밸리데이션(validation)되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The computerized system used to manage product inventory and distribution records to support recalls was not validated.

findings.text_ko: 변경이 적절히 문서화·평가·승인되도록 보장하는 변경관리(change control) 체계가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 의약품에 대한 지속적 안정성시험(ongoing stability) 프로그램이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The ongoing stability program for a drug was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 공급자·제조자·시험자·포장자·표시자·유통자·수입자 및/또는 도매상 간 품질계약서(quality agreement)의 구비·내용 및/또는 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 원료 공급업체와 의약품 제조자 간 문서화된 계약서의 구비 및/또는 내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability and/or the content of the written agreement between the raw material vendor and the drug fabricator was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록된 정보 또는 세부 내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The recorded information or details were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 의약품 안정성시험 프로그램에 해당 의약품을 제조한 매년 각 함량별 최소 1개 배치가 포함되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The stability program for a drug did not include a minimum of one batch of every strength of the drug for every year the drug was fabricated.

findings.text_ko: 변경관리 시스템이 변경사항의 적절한 문서화·평가 및/또는 승인을 보증하기에 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고 및/또는 후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 자체점검(self-inspection) 프로그램의 실행이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation of a self-inspection program was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 원료 샘플링 계획이 미흡했다. 원료 로트의 각 용기에 대해 내용물을 확인하기 위한 특이적이고 식별력 있는 시험을 실시하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The sampling plan for raw materials was inadequate. Each container of a lot of raw materials was not tested to identify its contents with a specific, discriminating test.

findings.text_ko: 보관용 검체(retention sample)에 관한 절차서 및 기록이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The written procedures and records for retaining samples were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 원료 공급업체 인증(vendor certification) 없이 원료에 대한 축소 재시험 프로그램을 운영하고 있었다. 원료의 출고 및 입고에 관한 표준작업지침서(SOP) 또는 기록이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: A reduced retesting program for raw materials was in place without the raw material vendor certification. The standard operating procedures or records for shipping and receiving raw materials were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 보관 및/또는 운송 조건이 의약품의 품질과 안전한 유통을 유지하도록 보증하는 지침 및/또는 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The guidelines and/or procedures were inadequate in ensuring storage and/or transportation conditions would maintain the quality and safe distribution of the drug.

findings.text_ko: 완제품 출하 판정을 위한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment to release finished products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 데이터 거버넌스 계획의 수립 및/또는 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The establishment and/or the maintenance of a data governance plan was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control unit)의 원료·포장재·반제품 및/또는 벌크 의약품에 대한 문서화·표시 및/또는 격리 조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department's documentation, labelling, and/or quarantining of raw materials, packaging materials, in-process drugs, and/or bulk drugs was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 작업자의 직무기술서·부여된 권한 및/또는 업무 위임이 미흡하거나 문서화되어 있지 않았다. 작업자에 대한 지속적 교육이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The job descriptions for personnel, the authority given to personnel, and/or the delegation of duties was inadequate and/or undocumented. The ongoing training of personnel was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 공급자·제조자·시험자·포장자·표시자·유통업자·수입자 및/또는 도매상 간 품질계약서(quality agreement)의 구비·내용 및/또는 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 연간제품품질평가(annual product quality review) 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The annual product quality review procedure was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 시험실의 설계·설비 및/또는 유지관리가 미흡했다. 온도 및/또는 습도 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The design, equipment, and/or maintenance of the testing laboratory was inadequate. The temperature and/or humidity control was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 정제수 시스템이 미흡하여 용수가 화학적·미생물학적 순도에 대한 적절한 요건을 충족하지 못할 가능성이 있었다.
findings.text_orig: The purified water system was inadequate with the potential for water not meeting the appropriate requirements for chemical and microbial purity.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고 및/또는 후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 의약품의 지속적 안정성시험(ongoing stability) 프로그램이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The ongoing stability program for a drug was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 포장 후 및/또는 수입자 시설에 입고된 후 각 의약품 배치의 확인 식별이 미흡했다. 캐나다 입고 전 또는 후 검체에 대해 실시한 확인시험(confirmatory test)이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The positive identification of each batch of drug after the packaging and/or after it was received on the importer's premises was inadequate. The confirmatory tests conducted on samples before or after they were received in Canada were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 설비가 다른 의약품 및/또는 이물에 의한 의약품 오염 가능성을 방지하도록 설치·설계·운영·보관 및/또는 유지관리되지 않았다. 컴퓨터화시스템을 포함한 설비의 교정·점검 및/또는 적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다. 설비의 예방정비 및 수리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The equipment was not set-up, designed, operated, stored, and/or maintained to prevent potential contamination of drugs by other drugs and/or by foreign material. The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate. The preventative maintenance and repair of the equipment was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 시설이 오염을 방지하도록 설계·시공·운영 및/또는 유지관리되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The premises were not designed, constructed, operated, and/or maintained to prevent contamination.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 추적성·가독성·문서화·서식 및/또는 정확성이 미흡했다. 기록의 생성·수정·검토·보관 및/또는 검색에 대한 통제가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate. The controls were inadequate for creating, modifying, reviewing, storing, and/or retrieving records.

findings.text_ko: 비위생적 상태를 방지하기 위한 위생관리(sanitation) 프로그램의 실행 및/또는 효과성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation and/or the effectiveness of the sanitation program in preventing unsanitary conditions was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 공급자·제조원·시험소·포장자·표시자·유통업자·수입자 및/또는 도매상 간 품질협약(quality agreement)의 구비·내용 및/또는 유지가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 회수(recall)에 관한 문서화된 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The written procedures for recalls were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고 및/또는 후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 회사가 의약품·원료 및/또는 주성분의 각 로트 또는 배치 검체를 요구되는 기간 동안 보관하지 않았다. 보관용 검체(retention sample)에 관한 문서화된 절차와 기록이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The company did not retain a sample of each lot or batch of a drug, raw material, and/or an active ingredient for the required amount of time. The written procedures and records for retaining samples were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control unit)의 원료·포장재·공정 중 의약품 및/또는 벌크 의약품에 대한 문서화·표시 및/또는 격리보관(quarantine)이 미흡했다. 새로운 공정 작업을 시작하기 전에 라인 클리어런스(line clearance)가 수행되지 않았다. 제품 및/또는 자재의 오염 방지가 미흡했다. 제조 단계가 완료되는 시점에 해당 정보가 제조기록서(batch record)에 기재되지 않았다. 인쇄된 포장재가 출입이 제한된 구역에 보관되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department's documentation, labelling, and/or quarantining of raw materials, packaging materials, in-process drugs, and/or bulk drugs was inadequate. Line clearance was not performed before starting new processing operations. The protection of products and/or materials from contamination was inadequate. As the manufacturing steps were completed, the information was not recorded in the manufacturing batch record. Printed packaging materials were not stored in an area with restricted access.

findings.text_ko: 보관 및/또는 운송 조건이 의약품의 품질과 안전한 유통을 유지하도록 보장하는 지침 및/또는 절차가 미흡했다. 의약품 각 로트 또는 배치의 운송 및/또는 보관 조건을 입증하는 데 사용된 근거자료가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The guidelines and/or procedures were inadequate in ensuring storage and/or transportation conditions would maintain the quality and safe distribution of the drug. The evidence used to demonstrate the transportation and/or storage conditions of each lot or batch of the drug was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 문서화된 자체점검(self-inspection) 절차가 미흡했다. 공급자·제조자·시험자·포장자·표시자·유통자·수입자 및/또는 도매상 간 품질계약서(quality agreement)의 구비·내용 및/또는 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The written self-inspection procedure was inadequate. The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 격리보관(quarantine) 구역의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The control of quarantine areas was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 포장재에 대한 기준규격이 불완전하거나 미흡했다. 품질관리부서(quality control unit)의 포장 또는 표시용 포장재 사용 승인(release)이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The specifications for any packaging materials were incomplete or inadequate. The quality control department's release of packaging materials for use in packaging or labelling was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 측정기기의 정확성과 정밀성이 정기적으로 점검되지 않았다. 주요 공정 및/또는 시험 작업에 사용되는 설비에 대한 예방정비(preventive maintenance) 프로그램이 미흡했다. 전산화 시스템(computerized system)을 포함한 설비의 교정·점검 및/또는 적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Measuring devices were not regularly checked for accuracy and precision. The preventative maintenance program was inadequate for the equipment used in significant processing and/or testing operations. The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 문서화된 위생관리 프로그램(sanitation program)의 구비·실행 및/또는 수준이 미흡했다. 위생관리 프로그램(sanitation program)의 세척 절차, 세척 주기, 폐기물 처리 절차 및/또는 방충·방서 대책이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, implementation, and/or quality of the written sanitation program was inadequate. The sanitation program was inadequate in its cleaning procedures, frequency of cleaning, procedures for waste disposal, and/or pest control measures.

findings.text_ko: 완제품 출하 판정을 위한 평가가 미흡했다. 품질관리부서(quality control unit)가 로트 및/또는 배치의 재처리(reprocessing) 및/또는 재작업(rework)을 적절히 승인·평가 및/또는 문서화하지 않았다. 원료·포장재·표시자재·완제품 및/또는 재처리 중인 제품에 대한 품질관리부서(quality control unit)의 승인이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment to release finished products was inadequate. The quality control department did not appropriately approve, assess, and/or document the reprocessing and/or reworking of a lot and/or batch. The quality control department's approval was inadequate for raw materials, packaging materials, labelling, finished products, and/or products being reprocessed.

findings.text_ko: 청결하고 정돈된 상태가 유지되도록 시설이 설계·시공·운영 및/또는 유지관리되지 않았다. 액체 및/또는 가스 배출구(outlet)의 표시가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The premises were not designed, constructed, operated, and/or maintained to allow clean and orderly conditions. The labelling of outlets for liquids and/or gases was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 유지관리가 미흡했다. 기록의 생성·수정·검토·보관·검색에 대한 통제가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The maintenance of records was inadequate. The controls were inadequate for creating, modifying, reviewing, storing, and/or retrieving records.

findings.text_ko: 직원의 직무기술서, 직원에게 부여된 권한 및/또는 업무 위임이 미흡하거나 문서화되지 않았다. 직원에 대한 GMP 교육훈련 및/또는 그 기록의 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The job descriptions for personnel, the authority given to personnel, and/or the delegation of duties was inadequate and/or undocumented. The training of personnel in good manufacturing practices and/or the maintenance of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고 및/또는 후속조치가 미흡했다. 변경이 적절히 문서화·평가 및/또는 승인되도록 보장하는 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate. The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 원료 각 로트의 검체가 기준규격에 대해 전항목 시험되지 않았다. 원료에 대한 검체채취 계획(sampling plan)이 미흡했다. 의약품 제조에 사용되는 모든 원료에 대해 품질관리부서(quality control unit)가 승인한 기준규격이 구비되어 있지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: A sample from each lot of raw materials was not fully tested against the specifications. The sampling plan for raw materials was inadequate. The specifications approved by the quality control department were not available for all raw materials used to produce drugs.

findings.text_ko: 원료 공급업체 인증(vendor certification) 없이 원료에 대한 축소 재시험 프로그램이 운영되고 있었다.
findings.text_orig: A reduced retesting program for raw materials was in place without the raw material vendor certification.

findings.text_ko: 다른 의약품 및/또는 이물에 의한 의약품 오염 가능성을 방지하도록 설비가 설치·설계·운영·보관 및/또는 유지관리되지 않았다. 비위생적 상태를 방지하는 데 있어 위생관리 프로그램(sanitation program)의 실행 및/또는 효과성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The equipment was not set-up, designed, operated, stored, and/or maintained to prevent potential contamination of drugs by other drugs and/or by foreign material. The implementation and/or the effectiveness of the sanitation program in preventing unsanitary conditions was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 부적합 판정된 자재 및 제품의 취급이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The handling of rejected materials and products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조공정·설비 및/또는 자재에 대한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Evaluation of production processes, equipment, and/or materials was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 공급자·제조자·시험자·포장자·표시자·유통업자·수입자 및/또는 도매상 간 품질계약서(quality agreement)의 구비·내용 및/또는 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: GMP 관련 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 자체점검(self-inspection) 프로그램의 실행이 미흡했다. 자체점검(self-inspection) 절차서가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation of a self-inspection program was inadequate. The written self-inspection procedure was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 변경관리 시스템이 변경사항의 적절한 문서화·평가 및/또는 승인을 보증하기에 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control unit)는 결함 가능성이 있는 제품에 관한 불만의 철저한 조사 및/또는 평가를 보증하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department did not ensure a thorough investigation and/or evaluation of complaints concerning potentially defective products.

findings.text_orig: The controls put in place for electronic signatures were inadequate.

findings.text_orig: The temperature and/or humidity control was inadequate. The doors, windows, walls, ceilings, and/or floors were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록된 정보 또는 세부 내용이 미흡했다.

findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.
