findings.text_ko: 기록의 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The maintenance of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: GMP 관련 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 불만 및/또는 결함 가능성이 있는 제품에 관한 기타 정보의 평가·기록·후속조치 및/또는 조사가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment, recording, follow-up, and/or investigation of complaints and/or other information about potentially defective products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The maintenance of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 연간 제품품질평가(annual product quality review) 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The annual product quality review procedure was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 사전 승인된 문서화된 절차 또는 지시에 따른 원료·제품·포장재의 취급이 미흡했다. 원료·포장재·중간제품·벌크 의약품 및/또는 완제품의 구획 분리, 재고 선입선출(rotation of stock) 및/또는 운송이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The handling of raw materials, products, or packaging materials in keeping with pre-approved written procedures or instructions was inadequate. findings.text_orig: The annual product quality review procedure was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 전산화 시스템을 포함한 설비의 교정·점검·적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다. 설비의 예방정비 및 수리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate. The preventative maintenance and repair of the equipment was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 공급자·제조자·시험자·포장자·표시자·유통업자·수입자·도매업자 간 품질계약서(quality agreement)의 구비·내용·유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 포장 후 및 수입자 사업장에 입고된 후 의약품 각 배치에 대한 확인표시(positive identification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The positive identification of each batch of drug after the packaging and/or after it was received on the importer's premises was inadequate.

findings.text_orig: The master formula for packaged products did not include the required information. The recorded information or details were inadequate.

findings.text_orig: The assessment, recording, follow-up, and/or investigation of complaints and/or other information about potentially defective products was inadequate.

findings.text_orig: The electronic system was not validated for its intended use.

findings.text_orig: The assessment to release finished products was inadequate. The procedure was inadequate for documenting quality control decisions by the person in charge of the quality control department.

findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 제조기준서(master production document)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The master production documents were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 시험법 밸리데이션(validation)이 미흡했다. 시험법 이관(transfer)에 대한 문서화된 프로토콜 및/또는 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The validation of test methods was inadequate. The written protocol and/or the assessment of the test method transfer was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: GMP 관련 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 구입한 배지(media)의 보관·운송·기록 및/또는 시험에 관하여 마련된 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The procedures in place were inadequate for the storage, transportation, records, and/or testing of purchased media.

findings.text_ko: 위생관리 프로그램(sanitation program)이 오염 위험을 확인 및/또는 저감하도록 적절히 설계되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The sanitation programs were not adequately designed to identify and/or reduce the risks of contamination.

findings.text_ko: 무균공정(aseptic) 작업이 수행되는 구역에서 모니터링의 주기와 방법이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: In areas where aseptic operations were performed, the frequency and the methods of monitoring were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 전산화 시스템(computerized system)을 포함한 설비의 교정·점검 및/또는 적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control unit) 책임자의 품질관리 결정사항을 문서화하는 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The procedure was inadequate for documenting quality control decisions by the person in charge of the quality control department.

findings.text_ko: 완제품 시험 요건 미달 사례의 확인 및/또는 조사가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Identifying and/or investigating the failures to meet finished product testing requirements was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 온도 및/또는 습도 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The temperature and/or humidity control was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기준일탈(OOS) 시험결과의 조사·처리·보고가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The investigation, handling, and/or reporting of test results that were out-of-specification was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 변경이 적절히 문서화·평가 및/또는 승인되도록 보장하는 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 수입 제품에 대하여 해외 제조소의 안정성 시험이 캐나다 GMP 및/또는 캐나다 품목허가에 부합하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: For imported products, the stability studies from foreign sites were not compliant with Canadian good manufacturing practices and/or Canadian marketing authorization.

findings.text_ko: 불만 및/또는 결함 가능성이 있는 제품에 관한 기타 정보의 평가·기록·후속조치 및/또는 조사가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment, recording, follow-up, and/or investigation of complaints and/or other information about potentially defective products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control unit)가 GMP 문서 및/또는 표준작업지침서(SOP)를 승인·서명 및/또는 일자 기재하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department did not approve, sign, and/or date the good manufacturing practices documents and/or the standard operating procedures.

findings.text_ko: 제조기준서(master production document)가 미흡했다. 기록된 정보 또는 세부 내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The master production documents were inadequate. The recorded information or details were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 완제품 출하 판정을 위한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment to release finished products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 의약품에 대한 지속적 안정성 프로그램(ongoing stability program)이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The ongoing stability program for a drug was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 자체점검(self-inspection) 프로그램의 실행이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation of a self-inspection program was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고 및/또는 후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 반품된 의약품의 재판매 검토를 위한 평가·문서화 및/또는 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment, documentation, and/or procedures for considering the resale of returned drugs were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 자체점검(self-inspection) 프로그램의 실행이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation of a self-inspection program was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 온도 및/또는 습도 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The temperature and/or humidity control was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 주요 제조공정 및/또는 시험 작업에 사용되는 설비에 대한 예방정비(preventive maintenance) 프로그램이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The preventative maintenance program was inadequate for the equipment used in significant processing and/or testing operations.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control unit)가 연간제품품질평가(APQR) 결과를 평가하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department did not evaluate the results of the annual product quality review.

findings.text_ko: 공급자·제조자·시험자·포장자·표시자·유통자·수입자 및/또는 도매상 간 품질계약서(quality agreement)의 구비·내용 및/또는 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기준일탈(OOS) 시험결과의 조사·처리 및/또는 보고가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The investigation, handling, and/or reporting of test results that were out-of-specification was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 변경사항의 적절한 문서화·평가 및/또는 승인을 보장하기에 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 시험실 데이터의 생성·유지·처리 및/또는 검토가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The creation, maintenance, processing, and/or review of laboratory data was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 회수(recall)에 대한 문서화된 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The written procedures for recalls were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질경영시스템의 실행·유지 및/또는 효과성 개선에 필요한 적절한 자원을 파악하고 제공하는 경영진의 역량이 미흡했다. 품질관리부서(quality control unit)가 요구되는 모든 업무를 수행하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: Senior management's ability to determine and/or provide adequate and/or appropriate resources to implement, maintain and/or improve the effectiveness of the quality management system was inadequate. The quality control department did not undertake all of the required activities.

findings.text_ko: 회사는 의약품을 시판하기 전 또는 제형·제조방법·포장재에 중요한 변경을 하기 전에 해당 의약품의 안정성을 확인하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The company did not determine the stability of the drug before it was marketed or before significant changes were made to the drug formulations, fabrication procedures, or packaging materials.

findings.text_ko: 비위생적 상태를 방지하기 위한 위생관리 프로그램의 실행 및/또는 효과성이 미흡했다. 위생관리 프로그램이 오염 위험을 파악하고 저감하도록 적절히 설계되지 않았다. 위생관리 프로그램의 청소절차, 청소주기, 폐기물 처리절차 및/또는 방충·방서 대책이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation and/or the effectiveness of the sanitation program in preventing unsanitary conditions was inadequate. The sanitation programs were not adequately designed to identify and/or reduce the risks of contamination. The sanitation program was inadequate in its cleaning procedures, frequency of cleaning, procedures for waste disposal, and/or pest control measures.

findings.text_ko: 시설이 청결하고 정돈된 상태를 유지할 수 있도록 설계·시공·운영 및/또는 유지관리되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The premises were not designed, constructed, operated, and/or maintained to allow clean and orderly conditions.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고 및/또는 후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 문서화된 기준규격(specification)이 미흡했다. 정품 시험성적서(certificate of analysis)의 구비 또는 내용이 미흡했다. 완제품 로트 또는 배치를 제조 또는 판매하기 전에 기준규격에 따라 검사하거나 시험하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The written specifications were inadequate. The availability or the content of the authentic certificate of analysis was inadequate. Lots or batches of finished product were not examined or tested against the specifications before they were fabricated or sold.

findings.text_ko: 제조공정·설비 및/또는 자재에 대한 평가가 미흡했다. 마스터 제조문서(master production document)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Evaluation of production processes, equipment, and/or materials was inadequate. The master production documents were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 작업자의 직무기술서, 부여된 권한 및/또는 업무 위임이 미흡하거나 문서화되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The job descriptions for personnel, the authority given to personnel, and/or the delegation of duties was inadequate and/or undocumented.

findings.text_ko: 데이터 거버넌스(data governance) 계획의 수립·유지가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The establishment and/or the maintenance of a data governance plan was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록된 정보 또는 세부 내용이 미흡했다. 시약 및 배지의 입고·조제·취급이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The recorded information or details were inadequate. The receipt, preparation, and/or handling of reagents and culture media was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고·후속 조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기준일탈(OOS) 시험결과의 조사·처리·보고가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The investigation, handling, and/or reporting of test results that were out-of-specification was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 전산화 시스템을 포함한 설비의 교정·점검·적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 공급자·제조자·시험자·포장자·표시자·유통업자·수입자·도매상 간 품질계약서(quality agreement)의 구비·내용·유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 변경사항의 적절한 문서화·평가·승인을 보장하기에 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고·후속조치가 미흡했다. 기록된 정보 또는 세부 내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate. The recorded information or details were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 결함 가능성이 있는 제품에 대한 불만 및 기타 정보의 평가·기록·후속조치·조사가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment, recording, follow-up, and/or investigation of complaints and/or other information about potentially defective products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: GMP 관련 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 보관용 검체(retain sample)에 대한 문서화된 절차와 기록이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The written procedures and records for retaining samples were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 보관·운송 조건이 의약품의 품질과 안전한 유통을 유지하도록 보장하는 지침·절차가 미흡했다. 온도·습도 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The guidelines and/or procedures were inadequate in ensuring storage and/or transportation conditions would maintain the quality and safe distribution of the drug. The temperature and/or humidity control was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 자체점검(self-inspection) 프로그램의 실행이 미흡했다. 문서화된 자체점검(self-inspection) 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation of a self-inspection program was inadequate. The written self-inspection procedure was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 연간제품품질평가(annual product quality review) 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The annual product quality review procedure was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control unit) 책임자의 업무가 자격을 갖추지 않은 사람에게 위임되었다.
findings.text_orig: The duties of the individual in charge of the quality control department were delegated to an unqualified individual.

findings.text_ko: 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 변경사항의 적절한 문서화·평가·승인을 보장하기에 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 회수(recall)에 관한 문서화된 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The written procedures for recalls were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control unit)가 GMP 문서 및 표준작업지침서(SOP)를 승인·서명하지 않았거나 날짜를 기재하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department did not approve, sign, and/or date the good manufacturing practices documents and/or the standard operating procedures.

findings.text_ko: 직원에 대한 GMP 교육훈련 및 그 기록의 유지가 미흡했다. 직원의 직무기술서, 직원에게 부여된 권한, 업무 위임이 미흡하거나 문서화되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The training of personnel in good manufacturing practices and/or the maintenance of records was inadequate. The job descriptions for personnel, the authority given to personnel, and/or the delegation of duties was inadequate and/or undocumented.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 생성·수정·검토·보관·검색에 대한 통제가 미흡했다. 데이터 거버넌스(data governance) 계획의 수립 및 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The controls were inadequate for creating, modifying, reviewing, storing, and/or retrieving records. The establishment and/or the maintenance of a data governance plan was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 컴퓨터화 시스템을 포함한 설비의 교정·점검·적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 완제품 기준규격 적합성을 입증하는 데 필요한 증빙자료가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The evidence required to demonstrate compliance with finished product specifications was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 회수(recall) 사실이 Health Canada에 보고되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: Health Canada was not notified of a recall.

findings.text_ko: 무균공정(aseptic processing) 밸리데이션(validation)이 미흡했다. 직원에 대한 지속적인 교육훈련이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The validation of aseptic processing was inadequate. The ongoing training of personnel was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 환경모니터링(environmental monitoring)을 위해 채취한 시료 수가 불충분했다. 환경 시료채취 방법이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The number of samples taken for environmental monitoring was insufficient. The environmental sampling methods were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 공급자·제조자·시험자·포장자·표시자·유통업자·수입자·도매상 간 품질계약서(quality agreement)의 구비·내용·유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조·포장·표시·필수 시험·보관·유통 및 각 조건에 대한 증빙자료의 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The maintenance of evidence was inadequate for manufacturing, packaging, labelling, required testing, storage, and/or distribution, including the respective conditions.

findings.text_ko: 신규 또는 개정된 표준작업지침서(SOP) 시행 전 작업자 교육훈련이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The training of personnel before new or revised standard operating procedures were implemented was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 정본 시험성적서(certificate of analysis)의 구비 또는 내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability or the content of the authentic certificate of analysis was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 결함 가능성이 있는 제품에 대한 불만 및 기타 정보의 평가·기록·후속조치·조사가 미흡했다. 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고·후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment, recording, follow-up, and/or investigation of complaints and/or other information about potentially defective products was inadequate. Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: GMP 관련 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 작업자에 대한 지속적인 교육훈련이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The ongoing training of personnel was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 컴퓨터화 시스템을 포함한 설비의 교정·점검·적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 공급자·제조자·시험자·포장자·표시자·유통업자·수입자·도매상 간 품질계약서(quality agreement)의 구비·내용·유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 수입자 및 유통업자의 현행 제조기준서(master production document) 및 품목허가사항 준수가 미흡했다. 완제품 출하승인을 위한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The importer and/or the distributor's compliance with the current master production documents and/or the marketing authorization was inadequate. The assessment to release finished products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 보관용 검체(retain sample)에 대한 문서화된 절차와 기록이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The written procedures and records for retaining samples were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기준일탈(OOS) 시험결과의 조사·처리·보고가 미흡했다. 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고·후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The investigation, handling, and/or reporting of test results that were out-of-specification was inadequate. Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록된 정보 또는 세부 내용이 미흡했다. 기록의 생성·수정·검토·보관·검색에 대한 통제가 미흡했다. GMP 관련 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The recorded information or details were inadequate. The controls were inadequate for creating, modifying, reviewing, storing, and/or retrieving records. The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 자재, 벌크 용기, 주요 설비 및 작업실이 적절히 식별·표시되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: Materials, bulk containers, major items of equipment, and/or the rooms were not properly identified.

findings.text_ko: 제조·포장·표시·시험·보관·운송 방법 및 절차에 대한 품질관리부서(quality control unit) 책임자의 실행 전 검토·승인이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The examination and/or approval of fabrication, packaging, labelling, testing, storage, and/or the transportation method and procedures by the person in charge of the quality control department before implementation was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 비위생적 상태를 방지하기 위한 세척절차의 실행·유효성·밸리데이션(validation)이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation, effectiveness, and/or validation of the cleaning procedures was inadequate for preventing unsanitary conditions.

findings.text_ko: 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 변경사항의 적절한 문서화·평가·승인을 보장하기에 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 전자서명(electronic signature)에 대해 마련된 통제가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The controls put in place for electronic signatures were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 반품된 의약품의 재판매 검토를 위한 평가·문서화·절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment, documentation, and/or procedures for considering the resale of returned drugs were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 진본 시험성적서(certificate of analysis)의 구비 또는 내용이 미흡했다. 배치증명서(batch certificate)의 내용이 미흡했다. 완제품 출하를 위한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability or the content of the authentic certificate of analysis was inadequate. The content of the batch certificate was inadequate. The assessment to release finished products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고·후속 조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 작업자의 직무기술서, 부여된 권한 및 업무 위임이 미흡하거나 문서화되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The job descriptions for personnel, the authority given to personnel, and/or the delegation of duties was inadequate and/or undocumented.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control unit)가 연간 제품품질평가(annual product quality review) 결과를 평가하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department did not evaluate the results of the annual product quality review.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 생성·수정·검토·보관·검색에 대한 통제가 미흡했다. 기록의 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The controls were inadequate for creating, modifying, reviewing, storing, and/or retrieving records. The maintenance of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 완제품 출하승인을 위한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment to release finished products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고·후속조치가 미흡했다. 품질관리부서(quality control unit)가 요구되는 모든 업무를 수행하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate. The quality control department did not undertake all of the required activities.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control unit)가 요구되는 모든 업무를 수행하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department did not undertake all of the required activities.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 유지관리가 미흡했다. 기록의 추적성·가독성·문서화·서식 및/또는 정확성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The maintenance of records was inadequate. The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 수입자는 의약품의 제조·포장/표시 또는 시험에 사용되는 해외 제조소가 Guidance on Evidence to Demonstrate Drug GMP Compliance of Foreign Sites (GUI-0080)에 기술된 요건을 충족하는지 확인하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The importer did not ensure that the foreign sites use to fabricate, package/label, or test drug products met the requirements described in Guidance on Evidence to Demonstrate Drug GMP Compliance of Foreign Sites (GUI-0080).

findings.text_ko: 제품 간 교차오염 및/또는 혼동을 방지하기 위한 최적의 인원 및/또는 자재 동선이 확보되도록 시설이 배치 및/또는 설계되지 않았다. 제조구역이 적절히 격리·구획되도록 시설이 배치 및/또는 설계되지 않았다. 원료·포장재·중간제품·벌크 의약품 및/또는 완제품의 구획 분리, 재고 선입선출(rotation of stock) 및/또는 운송이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The premises were not laid out and/or designed for an optimal flow of personnel and/or materials to prevent cross-contamination and/or mix-ups between products. The premises were not laid out and/or designed to ensure that production areas were adequately isolated and segregated. The segregation, rotation of stock, and/or the transportation of raw materials, packaging materials, intermediates, bulk drugs, and/or finished products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리 요건에 대한 의사결정 책임자가 해당 직위의 책임을 수행하는 데 필요한 현장 운영에 관한 충분한 지식을 갖추지 못했다. 품질관리부서(quality control unit)가 요구되는 활동을 모두 수행하지 않았다. 품질경영시스템(quality management system)의 실행 및/또는 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The person responsible for making decisions about quality control requirements did not have adequate knowledge of on-site operations to fulfill the responsibilities of this position. The quality control department did not undertake all of the required activities. The implementation and/or maintenance of the quality management system was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 오염을 방지하도록 시설이 설계·시공·운영 및/또는 유지관리되지 않았다. 문서화된 위생관리 프로그램(sanitation program)의 구비·실행 및/또는 수준이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The premises were not designed, constructed, operated, and/or maintained to prevent contamination. The availability, implementation, and/or quality of the written sanitation program was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 온도 및/또는 습도 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The temperature and/or humidity control was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 보관용 검체(retention sample)에 관한 문서화된 절차와 기록이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The written procedures and records for retaining samples were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 전산화 시스템(computerized system)을 포함한 설비의 교정·점검 및/또는 적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다. 주요 공정 및/또는 시험 작업에 사용되는 설비의 사용기록(usage log)이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate. The usage logs for the equipment used for significant processing and/or testing operations were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기준규격에 부적합한 완제품 로트 또는 배치가 추가 제조 또는 판매에 사용 가능한 상태로 제공되었다. 문서화된 기준규격이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Lots or batches of finished product did not comply with the specifications and were made available for further fabrication or sale. The written specifications were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조 단계가 완료되는 시점에 해당 정보가 제조기록서(batch record)에 기재되지 않았다. 제조소에 입고된 모든 원료 로트에 대해 개별 확인시험(identity test)이 실시되지 않았다. 인쇄된 포장재가 출입이 제한된 구역에 보관되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: As the manufacturing steps were completed, the information was not recorded in the manufacturing batch record. Specific identity testing was not conducted on all lots of raw materials received on the premises. Printed packaging materials were not stored in an area with restricted access.

findings.text_ko: 제조·포장 또는 표시 및/또는 시험에 대한 책임을 규정한 품질계약서(quality agreement)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The quality agreement outlining the responsibilities for fabricating, packaging or labelling, and/or testing was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 완제품 출하 판정을 위한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment to release finished products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 변경이 적절히 문서화·평가 및/또는 승인되도록 보장하는 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control unit) 책임자가 시행 전에 제조·포장·표시·시험·보관 및 운송 방법과 절차를 검토·승인하는 것이 미흡했다. 의약품 각 로트 또는 배치의 운송·보관 조건을 입증하는 데 사용된 증빙이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The examination and/or approval of fabrication, packaging, labelling, testing, storage, and/or the transportation method and procedures by the person in charge of the quality control department before implementation was inadequate. The evidence used to demonstrate the transportation and/or storage conditions of each lot or batch of the drug was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 직원에 대한 GMP 교육훈련 및 그 기록의 유지가 미흡했다. 신규 또는 개정된 표준작업지침서(SOP) 시행 전 직원 교육훈련이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The training of personnel in good manufacturing practices and/or the maintenance of records was inadequate. The training of personnel before new or revised standard operating procedures were implemented was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 완제품 출하를 위한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment to release finished products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 수입자가 의약품의 제조·포장/표시 또는 시험에 사용하는 해외 제조소가 Guidance on Evidence to Demonstrate Drug GMP Compliance of Foreign Sites (GUI-0080)에 기술된 요건을 충족하는지 확인하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The importer did not ensure that the foreign sites use to fabricate, package/label, or test drug products met the requirements described in Guidance on Evidence to Demonstrate Drug GMP Compliance of Foreign Sites (GUI-0080).

findings.text_ko: 공급자·제조자·시험자·포장자·표시자·유통업자·수입자·도매업자 간 품질계약서(quality agreement)의 구비·내용·유지관리가 미흡했다. 원료 공급업체와 의약품 제조자 간 서면 계약의 구비·내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate. The availability and/or the content of the written agreement between the raw material vendor and the drug fabricator was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: GMP 관련 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control unit)의 시험·검사 수행 시험실 선정이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department's selection of a laboratory for testing and/or examination was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control unit)가 요구되는 모든 업무를 수행하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department did not undertake all of the required activities.

findings.text_ko: 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 변경사항의 적절한 문서화·평가·승인을 보장하기에 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고·후속 조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 문서화된 자체점검(self-inspection) 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The written self-inspection procedure was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 불만사항 및 결함 가능성이 있는 제품에 관한 그 밖의 정보에 대한 평가·기록·후속조치·조사가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment, recording, follow-up, and/or investigation of complaints and/or other information about potentially defective products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: GMP 관련 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 불만사항 및 결함 가능성이 있는 제품에 관한 그 밖의 정보에 대한 평가·기록·후속조치·조사가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment, recording, follow-up, and/or investigation of complaints and/or other information about potentially defective products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 확인시험이 별도의 다른 시험실에서 수행되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: Confirmatory testing was not performed by an alternate laboratory.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고·후속 조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 수탁업체에 대한 회사의 관리·감독이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The company's oversight of the contracted party was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control unit)가 요구되는 모든 업무를 수행하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department did not undertake all of the required activities.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 생성·수정·검토·보관·검색에 대한 통제가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The controls were inadequate for creating, modifying, reviewing, storing, and/or retrieving records.

findings.text_ko: 자체점검(self-inspection) 프로그램의 실행이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation of a self-inspection program was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 포장 후 및/또는 수입업자 시설에 입고된 후 각 의약품 배치에 대한 확인(positive identification)이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The positive identification of each batch of drug after the packaging and/or after it was received on the importer's premises was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 문서화된 위생관리 프로그램의 보유, 실행 및/또는 수준이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, implementation, and/or quality of the written sanitation program was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조구역이 적절히 격리·구분되도록 시설이 배치 및/또는 설계되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The premises were not laid out and/or designed to ensure that production areas were adequately isolated and segregated.

findings.text_ko: 세척이 가능하도록 및/또는 이물의 축적을 방지하도록 시설이 시공 및/또는 유지관리되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The premises were not constructed and/or maintained to allow cleaning and/or prevent the accumulation of foreign material.

findings.text_ko: 작업자의 무균조작(aseptic) 수행이 무균성을 유지하기에 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The operators'aseptic practices were inadequate to maintain sterility.

findings.text_ko: 세척 절차의 실행, 효과성 및/또는 밸리데이션(validation)이 비위생적 상태를 방지하기에 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation, effectiveness, and/or validation of the cleaning procedures was inadequate for preventing unsanitary conditions.

findings.text_ko: 회사는 청정구역(clean area)에서 미생물 오염과 부유입자 수를 최소화하도록 시설과 장비를 설계하거나 유지관리하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The company did not design or maintain the premises and equipment to minimize microbial contamination and the number of airborne particles in clean areas.

findings.text_ko: 포장재에 대한 검체채취 계획이 미흡했다. 품질관리부서가 승인한 포장재에 대한 규격 설정이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The sampling plan for packaging materials was inadequate. The establishment of specifications was inadequate for packaging materials approved by the quality control department.

findings.text_ko: 무균공정(aseptic processing)의 밸리데이션(validation)이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The validation of aseptic processing was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 충전된 용기에 대한 회사의 육안검사가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The company's visual inspection of filled containers was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 캐나다에 반입되기 전 또는 반입된 후 검체에 대해 수행된 확인시험이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The confirmatory tests conducted on samples before or after they were received in Canada were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기준규격이 문서화되지 않았거나 품질관리부서(quality control unit) 책임자 또는 지정 대리인의 승인을 받지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The specifications were not in writing and/or approved by the person in charge of the quality control department or the designated alternative.

findings.text_ko: 의약품 품질에 관해 접수된 불만 및/또는 정보에 대한 품질관리부서(quality control unit)의 처리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department's handling of complaints and/or information received about drug quality was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 보관 및/또는 운송 조건이 의약품의 품질과 안전한 유통을 유지하도록 보장하는 지침 및/또는 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The guidelines and/or procedures were inadequate in ensuring storage and/or transportation conditions would maintain the quality and safe distribution of the drug.

findings.text_ko: 공급자, 제조업자, 시험업자, 포장업자, 표시업자, 유통업자, 수입업자 및/또는 도매상 간 품질계약서(quality agreement)의 보유, 내용 및/또는 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 수탁업체에 대한 회사의 관리·감독이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The company's oversight of the contracted party was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 원료, 포장재, 표시재료, 완제품 및/또는 재작업 중인 제품에 대한 품질관리부서의 승인이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department's approval was inadequate for raw materials, packaging materials, labelling, finished products, and/or products being reprocessed.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사, 보고 및/또는 후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서가 요구되는 모든 업무를 수행하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department did not undertake all of the required activities.

findings.text_ko: 컴퓨터화시스템을 포함한 설비의 교정·점검 및/또는 적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 시험방법 밸리데이션(validation)이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The validation of test methods was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록된 정보 또는 세부내용이 미흡했다. GMP 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The recorded information or details were inadequate. The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조 공정 단계가 완료되는 시점에 해당 정보를 제조기록서(batch record)에 기록하지 않았다. 제품 및/또는 자재의 오염 방지가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: As the manufacturing steps were completed, the information was not recorded in the manufacturing batch record. The protection of products and/or materials from contamination was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 변경사항의 적절한 문서화·평가 및/또는 승인을 보장하기에 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 비위생적 상태를 방지하기 위한 위생관리 프로그램의 실행 및/또는 효과성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation and/or the effectiveness of the sanitation program in preventing unsanitary conditions was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고 및/또는 후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control unit) 책임자의 학력·경력 및/또는 감독이 미흡했다. 직원에 대한 지속적인 교육이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The education, experience, and/or oversight of the individual in charge of the quality control department was inadequate. The ongoing training of personnel was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 미생물 및/또는 환경 조건에 대한 모니터링 절차가 미흡했다. 비위생적 상태를 방지하기 위한 세척절차의 실행·효과성 및/또는 밸리데이션(validation)이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The monitoring procedures for microbial and/or environmental conditions were inadequate. The implementation, effectiveness, and/or validation of the cleaning procedures was inadequate for preventing unsanitary conditions.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고 및/또는 후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: GMP 관련 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다. 기록의 추적성·가독성·문서화·서식 및/또는 정확성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate. The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 변경사항이 적절히 문서화·평가 및/또는 승인되도록 보장하는 변경관리(change control) 체계가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 설비의 밸리데이션(validation) 또는 계획된 유지보수가 미흡했다. 중요 제조공정이 밸리데이션(validation)되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The validation of equipment or the planned maintenance of equipment was inadequate. Critical production processes were not validated.

findings.text_ko: 원료 공급업체 인증(vendor certification) 없이 원료에 대한 축소 재시험 프로그램을 운영하고 있었다.
findings.text_orig: A reduced retesting program for raw materials was in place without the raw material vendor certification.

findings.text_ko: 시험실 데이터의 생성·유지·처리 및/또는 검토가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The creation, maintenance, processing, and/or review of laboratory data was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 전산화 시스템을 포함한 설비의 교정·점검 및/또는 적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 의약품·원료 및/또는 주성분의 각 로트 또는 배치별 검체를 적절한 조건에서 보관하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The company did not store a sample from each lot or batch of a drug, raw material, and/or an active ingredient under the proper conditions.

findings.text_ko: 제조기준서(master production document)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The master production documents were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기준일탈(OOS) 시험결과의 조사·처리·보고가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The investigation, handling, and/or reporting of test results that were out-of-specification was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 추적성·가독성·문서화·서식 및/또는 정확성이 미흡했다. 기록된 정보 또는 세부내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate. The recorded information or details were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 컴퓨터화시스템을 포함한 설비의 교정·점검 및/또는 적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 설비가 의도된 용도에 적합하게 사용되도록 하기 위한 설계·설치위치 및/또는 유지관리가 미흡했다
findings.text_orig: The design, location, and/or maintenance of the equipment was inadequate for allowing the equipment to serve its intended purpose

findings.text_ko: GMP 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 위생관리 프로그램이 오염 위험을 파악하고 저감하도록 적절히 설계되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The sanitation programs were not adequately designed to identify and/or reduce the risks of contamination.

findings.text_ko: 격리보관구역(quarantine)의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The control of quarantine areas was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 위생관리 프로그램이 오염 위험을 확인하고/또는 저감하도록 적절히 설계되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The sanitation programs were not adequately designed to identify and/or reduce the risks of contamination.

findings.text_ko: 직원에 대한 지속적인 교육이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The ongoing training of personnel was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 컴퓨터화시스템을 포함한 설비의 교정·점검 및/또는 적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_orig: The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 변경사항의 적절한 문서화·평가 및/또는 승인을 보장하기에 미흡했다. 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고 및/또는 후속조치가 미흡했다. 결함 가능성이 있는 제품에 관한 불만 및/또는 기타 정보의 평가·기록·후속조치 및/또는 조사가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved. Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate. The assessment, recording, follow-up, and/or investigation of complaints and/or other information about potentially defective products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 작업자의 직무기술서, 부여된 권한 및/또는 업무 위임이 미흡하거나 문서화되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The job descriptions for personnel, the authority given to personnel, and/or the delegation of duties was inadequate and/or undocumented.

findings.text_ko: 회수(recall)에 대한 수입자·유통자 및/또는 도매상 각각의 책임을 규정한 문서화된 계약이 미흡했다. 공급자·제조자·시험자·포장자·표시자·유통자·수입자 및/또는 도매상 간 품질계약서(quality agreement)의 구비·내용 및/또는 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The written agreement outlining the respective responsibilities of the importer, distributor, and/or wholesaler for recalls was inadequate. The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 보관 및/또는 운송 조건이 의약품의 품질과 안전한 유통을 유지하도록 보장하는 지침 및/또는 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The guidelines and/or procedures were inadequate in ensuring storage and/or transportation conditions would maintain the quality and safe distribution of the drug.

findings.text_ko: 컴퓨터화시스템을 포함한 설비의 교정·점검 및/또는 적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 반품 의약품의 재판매 검토에 대한 평가·문서화 및/또는 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment, documentation, and/or procedures for considering the resale of returned drugs were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 작업자에 대한 GMP 교육 및/또는 그 기록의 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The training of personnel in good manufacturing practices and/or the maintenance of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 변경사항의 적절한 문서화·평가 및/또는 승인을 보장하기에 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고 및/또는 후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 포장 제품에 대한 마스터 포뮬러(master formula)에 요구되는 정보가 포함되어 있지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The master formula for packaged products did not include the required information.

findings.text_ko: 포장지시서에 요구되는 정보가 포함되어 있지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: Packaging orders did not include the required information.

findings.text_ko: 연간제품품질평가(annual product quality review) 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The annual product quality review procedure was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 변경사항이 적절히 문서화·평가 및/또는 승인되도록 보장하는 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고 및/또는 후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 추적성·가독성·문서화·서식 및/또는 정확성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 위생관리 프로그램의 세척절차, 세척주기, 폐기물 처리 절차 및/또는 방충·방서 대책이 미흡했다. 문서화된 위생관리 프로그램의 구비·실행 및/또는 품질이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The sanitation program was inadequate in its cleaning procedures, frequency of cleaning, procedures for waste disposal, and/or pest control measures. The availability, implementation, and/or quality of the written sanitation program was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 공급자·제조자·시험자·포장자·표시자·유통업자·수입자 및/또는 도매업자 간 품질계약서(quality agreement)의 구비·내용 및/또는 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 생성·수정·검토·보관 및/또는 검색에 대한 통제가 미흡했다. 기록의 추적성·가독성·문서화·서식 및/또는 정확성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The controls were inadequate for creating, modifying, reviewing, storing, and/or retrieving records. The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 액체 및/또는 가스 배출구(outlet)의 표시가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The labelling of outlets for liquids and/or gases was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: GMP 관련 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 비위생적 상태를 방지하기 위한 세척절차의 실행·유효성 및/또는 밸리데이션이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation, effectiveness, and/or validation of the cleaning procedures was inadequate for preventing unsanitary conditions.

findings.text_ko: 의약품 오염을 방지하기에 설비의 설계·구조·운전 및/또는 위치가 미흡했다. 주요 공정 및/또는 시험 작업에 사용되는 설비에 대한 예방정비 체계가 수립되어 있지 않았다
findings.text_orig: The design, construction, operation, and/or location of the equipment was inadequate for preventing contamination of the drug. A preventative maintenance system had not been established for the equipment used in significant processing and/or testing operations

findings.text_ko: 마스터 제조지시서(master production document)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The master production documents were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 의약품에 대한 지속적 안정성시험(ongoing stability) 프로그램이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The ongoing stability program for a drug was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 완제품 출하판정을 위한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment to release finished products was inadequate.

findings.text_orig: The training of personnel in good manufacturing practices and/or the maintenance of records was inadequate. The assessment, recording, follow-up, and/or investigation of complaints and/or other information about potentially defective products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 자체점검(self-inspection) 프로그램의 실행이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation of a self-inspection program was inadequate.

findings.text_orig: The job descriptions for personnel, the authority given to personnel, and/or the delegation of duties was inadequate and/or undocumented.

findings.text_ko: 연간제품품질평가(annual product quality review) 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The annual product quality review procedure was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 완제품 출하 판정을 위한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment to release finished products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 변경이 적절히 문서화·평가·승인되도록 보장하는 변경관리(change control) 체계가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 연간 제품품질평가(annual product quality review) 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The annual product quality review procedure was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 비위생적 상태를 방지하기 위한 세척절차의 실행·효과성 및/또는 밸리데이션(validation)이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation, effectiveness, and/or validation of the cleaning procedures was inadequate for preventing unsanitary conditions.

findings.text_ko: 기록된 정보 또는 세부 내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The recorded information or details were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제품 및/또는 자재의 오염 방지가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The protection of products and/or materials from contamination was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조공정·설비 및/또는 자재에 대한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Evaluation of production processes, equipment, and/or materials was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 문서화된 위생(hygiene) 프로그램을 공장 직원 및/또는 방문자가 준수하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The written hygiene program was not being followed by plant personnel and/or visitors.

findings.text_ko: 문서화된 위생관리 프로그램의 구비·실행 및/또는 수준이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, implementation, and/or quality of the written sanitation program was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 의약품에 대한 지속적 안정성시험(ongoing stability) 프로그램이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The ongoing stability program for a drug was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 문서화된 자체점검(self-inspection) 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The written self-inspection procedure was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 문서화된 규격(specification)이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The written specifications were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조·포장·표시·필요 시험·보관 및/또는 유통과 각각의 조건에 관한 증거자료의 유지관리가 미흡했다. GMP 관련 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The maintenance of evidence was inadequate for manufacturing, packaging, labelling, required testing, storage, and/or distribution, including the respective conditions. The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조, 포장 또는 표시 및/또는 시험에 관한 책임을 규정한 품질계약서(quality agreement)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The quality agreement outlining the responsibilities for fabricating, packaging or labelling, and/or testing was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 변경사항이 적절히 문서화·평가 및/또는 승인되도록 보장하는 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 설비의 예방정비 및 수리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The preventative maintenance and repair of the equipment was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 신규 또는 개정된 표준작업지침서(SOP) 시행 전 직원 교육이 미흡했다. 직원의 직무기술서, 직원에게 부여된 권한 및/또는 업무 위임이 미흡하거나 문서화되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The training of personnel before new or revised standard operating procedures were implemented was inadequate. The job descriptions for personnel, the authority given to personnel, and/or the delegation of duties was inadequate and/or undocumented.

findings.text_ko: 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 검토·개정·승인 체계가 미흡했다. 기록된 정보 또는 세부사항이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The system for reviewing, revising, and approving standard operating procedures was inadequate. The recorded information or details were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리 요건에 관한 의사결정을 담당하는 자가 해당 직위의 책임을 수행하기에 충분한 현장 운영 지식을 갖추지 못했다.
findings.text_orig: The person responsible for making decisions about quality control requirements did not have adequate knowledge of on-site operations to fulfill the responsibilities of this position.

findings.text_ko: 위생관리 프로그램의 세척절차, 세척주기, 폐기물 처리 절차 및/또는 방충·방서 대책이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The sanitation program was inadequate in its cleaning procedures, frequency of cleaning, procedures for waste disposal, and/or pest control measures.

findings.text_ko: 표시(labelling) 작업 책임자 및/또는 2차 표시자(secondary labeller)의 품질관리부서(quality control department)에 대한 교육·경험 및/또는 위임된 업무가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The training, experience, and/or delegated duties for the individual responsible for labelling operations and/or the quality control department of a secondary labeller were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조구역이 적절히 격리·구획되도록 시설이 배치 및/또는 설계되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The premises were not laid out and/or designed to ensure that production areas were adequately isolated and segregated.

findings.text_ko: GMP 관련 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 자체점검(self-inspection) 프로그램의 실행이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation of a self-inspection program was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고 및/또는 후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 의약품 각 로트 또는 배치의 운송 및/또는 보관 조건을 입증하는 데 사용된 증거자료가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The evidence used to demonstrate the transportation and/or storage conditions of each lot or batch of the drug was inadequate.

findings.text_orig: The company's cleaning of the premises and the equipment in aseptic areas was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고 및/또는 후속조치가 미흡했다.

findings.text_orig: The validation of aseptic processing was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: GMP 관련 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 추적성·가독성·문서화·서식 및/또는 정확성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate.

findings.text_orig: The controls put in place for electronic signatures were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 온도 및 습도 관리가 미흡했다. 기록된 정보 또는 세부 내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The temperature and/or humidity control was inadequate. The recorded information or details were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 재판매를 검토 중인 반품 의약품의 평가 절차에서 미흡사항이 확인됐다.
findings.text_orig: Deficiencies were noted with the procedure for the assessment of returned drugs being considered for resale.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고·후속조치가 미흡했다. 기록의 추적성, 가독성, 문서화, 서식, 정확성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate. The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 부적합 자재의 식별·격리·폐기가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The identification, quarantine, and/or disposal of rejected materials was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: GMP 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.

findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 생성·수정·검토·보관·검색에 대한 통제가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The controls were inadequate for creating, modifying, reviewing, storing, and/or retrieving records.

findings.text_orig: The investigation, handling, and/or reporting of test results that were out-of-specification was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 결함 가능성이 있는 제품에 관한 불만 및/또는 기타 정보의 평가·기록·후속조치 및/또는 조사가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment, recording, follow-up, and/or investigation of complaints and/or other information about potentially defective products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 위생관리 프로그램의 청소절차, 청소주기, 폐기물 처리절차 및/또는 방충·방서 대책이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The sanitation program was inadequate in its cleaning procedures, frequency of cleaning, procedures for waste disposal, and/or pest control measures.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고 및/또는 후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 부유입자 모니터링 시스템이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The airborne particle monitoring system was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control unit)가 요구되는 모든 업무를 수행하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department did not undertake all of the required activities.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 생성·수정·검토·보관 및/또는 검색에 대한 통제가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The controls were inadequate for creating, modifying, reviewing, storing, and/or retrieving records.

findings.text_ko: 완제품 규격 적합성을 입증하는 데 요구되는 증거자료가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The evidence required to demonstrate compliance with finished product specifications was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 직원에 대한 지속적인 교육이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The ongoing training of personnel was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 불량 가능성이 있는 제품에 관한 불만 및/또는 기타 정보의 평가·기록·후속조치 및/또는 조사가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment, recording, follow-up, and/or investigation of complaints and/or other information about potentially defective products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control department)가 요구되는 활동을 모두 수행하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department did not undertake all of the required activities.

findings.text_ko: 반품된 의약품의 재판매 검토에 관한 평가·문서화 및/또는 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment, documentation, and/or procedures for considering the resale of returned drugs were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고 및/또는 후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 문서화된 위생관리 프로그램의 구비·실행 및/또는 수준이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, implementation, and/or quality of the written sanitation program was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 무균구역(aseptic area)의 시설 및 설비 세척이 미흡했다. 청정구역(clean area)에 대한 문서화된 위생관리 프로그램이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The company's cleaning of the premises and the equipment in aseptic areas was inadequate. The written sanitation program for clean areas was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 작업자의 무균조작(aseptic) 관행이 무균성을 유지하기에 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The operators'aseptic practices were inadequate to maintain sterility.

findings.text_ko: 중요 공정 및 절차가 정기적으로 평가되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: Critical processes and procedures were not evaluated on a regular basis.

findings.text_ko: 멸균 전 모든 공정에서 오염을 최소화하기 위한 예방조치를 취하지 않았다. 충전된 용기에 대한 육안검사(visual inspection)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The company did not take precautions to minimize contamination during all processing prior to sterilization. The company's visual inspection of filled containers was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 습열멸균(moist heat sterilization)에 대한 밸리데이션(validation)이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The company's validation of moist heat sterilization was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 생성·수정·검토·보관·검색에 대한 통제가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The controls were inadequate for creating, modifying, reviewing, storing, and/or retrieving records.

findings.text_ko: 제조공정·설비 및/또는 자재에 대한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Evaluation of production processes, equipment, and/or materials was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control unit)가 제품 품질에 관한 모든 의사결정에 참여하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department was not involved in all decisions for the quality of the product.

findings.text_ko: 기록된 정보 또는 세부 내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The recorded information or details were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 직원에 대한 지속적인 교육이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The ongoing training of personnel was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 원료·공정 중 의약품·벌크 의약품 및/또는 완제품 검체의 취급 및/또는 보관이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The handling and/or storage of samples was inadequate for raw materials, drugs being processed, bulk drugs, and/or finished products.

findings.text_ko: 위생관리 프로그램이 오염 위험을 파악 및/또는 저감하도록 적절히 설계되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The sanitation programs were not adequately designed to identify and/or reduce the risks of contamination.

findings.text_ko: 시약 및 배지(culture media)의 입고·조제 및/또는 취급이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The receipt, preparation, and/or handling of reagents and culture media was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 원료 로트의 각 용기에 대해 내용물을 확인하는 특이적이고 식별력 있는 시험을 실시하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: Each container of a lot of raw materials was not tested to identify its contents with a specific, discriminating test.

findings.text_ko: 원료 공급업체와 의약품 제조원 간 문서화된 협약의 구비 및/또는 내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability and/or the content of the written agreement between the raw material vendor and the drug fabricator was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 멸균 전 모든 공정에서 오염을 최소화하기 위한 예방조치를 취하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The company did not take precautions to minimize contamination during all processing prior to sterilization.

findings.text_ko: 기준에서 벗어난 일탈(deviation)이 있었던 경우 및/또는 제품이 허용범위 경계선에 있었던 경우에 대한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The evaluation was inadequate for cases where there was a deviation from the norm and/or where products were on the borderline of the acceptable range.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control unit)가 요구되는 모든 업무를 수행하지 않았다.

findings.text_ko: 제조구역 또는 무균구역(aseptic area)의 미생물 모니터링을 위한 검체채취 절차가 미흡했다. 무균제품 제조의 덜 중요한 단계에 사용되는 청정구역(clean area)을 적절히 모니터링하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The sampling procedure was inadequate for microbiological monitoring in processing areas or aseptic areas. The company did not adequately monitor the clean areas used for the less critical stages of manufacturing sterile products.

findings.text_ko: 전산화 시스템을 포함한 설비의 교정·점검 및/또는 적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 시험방법의 밸리데이션(validation) 및/또는 문서화가 미흡했다. 전산화 시스템을 포함한 설비의 교정·점검 및/또는 적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다. 구매한 배지(media)의 보관·운송·기록 및/또는 시험에 관한 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The validation and/or the documentation of test methods was inadequate. The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate. The procedures in place were inadequate for the storage, transportation, records, and/or testing of purchased media.
