findings.text_orig: The written procedures for recalls were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control unit)의 승인 없이 제품이 판매 가능한 상태로 제공되었다.
findings.text_orig: The product was made available for sale without the approval of the quality control department.

findings.text_ko: GMP 관련 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 자체점검(self-inspection) 프로그램의 실행이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation of a self-inspection program was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사, 보고 및/또는 후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 시약 및 배지의 입고·조제 및/또는 취급이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The receipt, preparation, and/or handling of reagents and culture media was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조공정·설비 및/또는 자재에 대한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Evaluation of production processes, equipment, and/or materials was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 시설의 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The maintenance of the premises was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 공급자·제조업자·시험기관·포장업자·표시업자·유통업자·수입업자 및/또는 도매업자 간 품질계약서(quality agreement)의 구비·내용 및/또는 유지관리가 미흡했다. 제조업자, 포장·표시업자, 유통업자 또는 수입업자에 의한 수탁자 역량 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate. The assessment of the contractor's competencies by the fabricator, packager/labeller, distributor, or importer was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 연간 제품품질평가 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The annual product quality review procedure was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사, 보고 및/또는 후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 온도 및/또는 습도 관리가 미흡했다. 보관 및/또는 운송 조건이 의약품의 품질과 안전한 유통을 유지하도록 보장하는 지침 및/또는 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The temperature and/or humidity control was inadequate. The guidelines and/or procedures were inadequate in ensuring storage and/or transportation conditions would maintain the quality and safe distribution of the drug.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control unit)가 요구되는 모든 업무를 수행하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department did not undertake all of the required activities.

findings.text_ko: 위생관리 프로그램이 오염 위험을 파악 및/또는 저감하도록 적절히 설계되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The sanitation programs were not adequately designed to identify and/or reduce the risks of contamination.

findings.text_ko: 기준일탈(OOS) 시험결과의 조사·처리 및/또는 보고가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The investigation, handling, and/or reporting of test results that were out-of-specification was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 컴퓨터화시스템을 포함한 장비의 교정·점검 및/또는 적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 생성·수정·검토·보관 및/또는 검색에 대한 통제가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The controls were inadequate for creating, modifying, reviewing, storing, and/or retrieving records.

findings.text_ko: 보관 및/또는 운송 조건이 의약품의 품질과 안전한 유통을 유지하도록 보장하기에 지침 및/또는 절차가 미흡했다. 온도 및/또는 습도 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The guidelines and/or procedures were inadequate in ensuring storage and/or transportation conditions would maintain the quality and safe distribution of the drug. The temperature and/or humidity control was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기준일탈(OOS) 시험결과의 조사·처리·보고가 미흡했다. 회사의 용수 시험 모니터링이 미흡했다. 정제수 설비의 운전이 신뢰할 수 있는 용수 공급원을 보장하기에 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The investigation, handling, and/or reporting of test results that were out-of-specification was inadequate. The company's monitoring of water testing was inadequate. The operation of the water purification equipment was inadequate for ensuring a reliable source of water.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 추적성·가독성·문서화·서식 및/또는 정확성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 원료의 검체채취 계획이 미흡했다. 원료 로트의 각 용기에 대해 내용물을 확인하기 위한 특이적·식별력 있는 시험을 실시하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The sampling plan for raw materials was inadequate. Each container of a lot of raw materials was not tested to identify its contents with a specific, discriminating test.

findings.text_ko: 주요 제조공정 및/또는 시험 작업에 사용되는 설비에 대한 예방정비(preventive maintenance) 프로그램이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The preventative maintenance program was inadequate for the equipment used in significant processing and/or testing operations.

findings.text_ko: 시약 및 배지의 입고·조제 및/또는 취급이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The receipt, preparation, and/or handling of reagents and culture media was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 공급자·제조자·시험자·포장자·표시자·유통업자·수입자 및/또는 도매상 간 품질계약서(quality agreement)의 구비·내용 및/또는 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 위생관리 프로그램이 오염 위험을 파악 및/또는 저감하도록 적절히 설계되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The sanitation programs were not adequately designed to identify and/or reduce the risks of contamination.

findings.text_ko: 연간 제품품질평가(annual product quality review) 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The annual product quality review procedure was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 무균 의약품의 경우, 안정성시험 프로그램에 초기 시험 시점 및 유효기한 종료 시점의 무균성 확인이 포함되어 있지 않았다. 해당 의약품의 지속 안정성시험(ongoing stability) 프로그램이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: For sterile drugs, the stability program did not include a confirmation of sterility at the initial testing and at the end of the drug's shelf life. The ongoing stability program for a drug was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 시험실 데이터의 생성·유지·처리 및/또는 검토가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The creation, maintenance, processing, and/or review of laboratory data was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 문서화된 규격이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The written specifications were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 포장 후 및/또는 수입업체 시설에 입고된 후 각 의약품 배치에 대한 확인시험(positive identification)이 미흡했다. 확인시험(confirmatory testing)이 별도의 시험기관에서 수행되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The positive identification of each batch of drug after the packaging and/or after it was received on the importer's premises was inadequate. Confirmatory testing was not performed by an alternate laboratory.

findings.text_ko: 컴퓨터화시스템을 포함한 장비의 교정, 점검 및/또는 적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 정품 시험성적서(certificate of analysis)의 구비 또는 내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability or the content of the authentic certificate of analysis was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 직원의 직무기술서, 직원에게 부여된 권한 및/또는 업무 위임이 미흡하거나 문서화되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The job descriptions for personnel, the authority given to personnel, and/or the delegation of duties was inadequate and/or undocumented.

findings.text_ko: 공정구역 또는 무균구역(aseptic area)의 미생물 모니터링을 위한 검체채취 절차가 미흡했다. 무균구역 또는 청정구역의 환경 등급 분류 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The sampling procedure was inadequate for microbiological monitoring in processing areas or aseptic areas. The process was inadequate for the environmental classification of aseptic or clean areas.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 유지·관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The maintenance of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 컴퓨터화시스템을 포함한 장비의 교정·점검 및/또는 적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조공정을 관리하기 위한 마스터 포뮬러(master formula)가 미흡했다. 실시 전 품질관리부서(quality control unit) 책임자에 의한 제조·포장·표시·시험·보관 및/또는 운송 방법과 절차의 검토 및/또는 승인이 미흡했다. 인쇄된 포장재가 출입이 제한된 구역에 보관되지 않았다. 부적합 판정된 자재 및 제품의 취급이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The master formulas to control the manufacturing process were inadequate. The examination and/or approval of fabrication, packaging, labelling, testing, storage, and/or the transportation method and procedures by the person in charge of the quality control department before implementation was inadequate. Printed packaging materials were not stored in an area with restricted access. The handling of rejected materials and products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 건물 내로 해충 및/또는 이물이 유입되는 것을 방지하도록 시설이 설계·건축 및/또는 유지관리되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The premises were not designed, constructed, and/or maintained to prevent the entry of pests and/or foreign material into the building.

findings.text_ko: 2차 표시업체(secondary labeller)의 표시작업 책임자 및/또는 품질관리부서(quality control unit)에 대한 교육·경력 및/또는 위임된 업무가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The training, experience, and/or delegated duties for the individual responsible for labelling operations and/or the quality control department of a secondary labeller were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 시설의 유지관리가 미흡했다. 온도 및/또는 습도 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The maintenance of the premises was inadequate. The temperature and/or humidity control was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질경영시스템의 효과성을 실행·유지 및/또는 개선하기 위해 적절하고 타당한 자원을 결정하고 제공하는 경영진의 역량이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Senior management's ability to determine and/or provide adequate and/or appropriate resources to implement, maintain and/or improve the effectiveness of the quality management system was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 전자시스템이 의도된 용도에 대해 밸리데이션(validation)되지 않았다. 기록의 생성·수정·검토·보관 및/또는 검색에 대한 통제가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The electronic system was not validated for its intended use. The controls were inadequate for creating, modifying, reviewing, storing, and/or retrieving records.

findings.text_ko: 연간 제품품질평가 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The annual product quality review procedure was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 정품 시험성적서(certificate of analysis)의 구비 또는 내용이 미흡했다. 캐나다 반입 전 또는 반입 후 검체에 대해 실시한 확인시험이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability or the content of the authentic certificate of analysis was inadequate. The confirmatory tests conducted on samples before or after they were received in Canada were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사, 보고 및/또는 후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 보관 및/또는 운송 조건이 의약품의 품질과 안전한 유통을 유지하도록 보장하는 지침 및/또는 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The guidelines and/or procedures were inadequate in ensuring storage and/or transportation conditions would maintain the quality and safe distribution of the drug.

findings.text_ko: 의약품의 지속적 안정성시험(ongoing stability) 프로그램이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The ongoing stability program for a drug was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 유지·관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The maintenance of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 직원 기록의 유지·관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The maintenance of personnel records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 의약품 안정성시험의 설계가 미흡했거나 문서화된 근거로 타당성이 입증되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The design of the drug stability study was inadequate and/or not justified with a documented rationale.

findings.text_ko: 온도 및/또는 습도 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The temperature and/or humidity control was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 생성·수정·검토·보관 및/또는 검색에 대한 통제가 미흡했다. 컴퓨터화시스템을 포함한 장비의 교정·점검 및/또는 적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The controls were inadequate for creating, modifying, reviewing, storing, and/or retrieving records. The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조, 포장 또는 표시, 및/또는 시험에 대한 책임을 규정한 품질계약서(quality agreement)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The quality agreement outlining the responsibilities for fabricating, packaging or labelling, and/or testing was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 완제품 출하 판정을 위한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment to release finished products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 자체점검(self-inspection) 프로그램의 실행이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation of a self-inspection program was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 불만 및/또는 결함 가능성이 있는 제품에 관한 기타 정보의 평가·기록·후속조치 및/또는 조사가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment, recording, follow-up, and/or investigation of complaints and/or other information about potentially defective products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 회수(recall)에 관한 문서화된 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The written procedures for recalls were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 변경이 적절히 문서화·평가 및/또는 승인되도록 보장하는 변경관리 시스템이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사, 보고 및/또는 후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 연간 제품품질평가 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The annual product quality review procedure was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 무균조작(aseptic)이 수행되는 구역에서 모니터링 주기와 방법이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: In areas where aseptic operations were performed, the frequency and the methods of monitoring were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 무균구역 또는 청정구역의 미립자 또는 미생물 오염을 최소화하기 위한 환경 기준이 미흡했다. 각 환경 등급별 문서화된 복장 기준이 미흡했다. 작업자의 무균조작(aseptic) 관행이 무균성을 유지하기에 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The environmental standards were inadequate in order to minimise particular or microbial contamination of aseptic or clean areas. The written clothing standards for each environmental grade were inadequate. The operators'aseptic practices were inadequate to maintain sterility.

findings.text_ko: 의약품에 대한 지속적 안정성시험 프로그램이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The ongoing stability program for a drug was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사, 보고 및/또는 후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 무균공정(aseptic processing)의 밸리데이션(validation)이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The validation of aseptic processing was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조공정·설비 및/또는 자재에 대한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Evaluation of production processes, equipment, and/or materials was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 설비의 밸리데이션(validation) 또는 계획된 설비 유지보수가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The validation of equipment or the planned maintenance of equipment was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 데이터 거버넌스(data governance) 계획의 수립 및/또는 유지가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The establishment and/or the maintenance of a data governance plan was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 원료, 공정 중 의약품, 벌크 의약품 및/또는 완제품에 대한 검체의 취급 및/또는 보관이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The handling and/or storage of samples was inadequate for raw materials, drugs being processed, bulk drugs, and/or finished products.

findings.text_ko: 포장재에 대한 기준규격(specification)이 불완전하거나 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The specifications for any packaging materials were incomplete or inadequate.

findings.text_orig: The validation of aseptic processing was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사, 보고 및/또는 후속조치가 미흡했다.

findings.text_orig: The recorded information or details were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조공정, 장비 및/또는 원자재에 대한 평가가 미흡했다. Grade A 및 B 구역에서 멸균된 소독제를 사용하지 않았다. 오염 발생 또는 시스템 성능 저하를 방지하기에 충분한 빈도로 무균 충전구역을 모니터링하지 않았다. 기류 패턴이 오염 위험을 초래하지 않는다는 점을 업체가 충분히 입증하지 못했다.
findings.text_orig: Evaluation of production processes, equipment, and/or materials was inadequate. Sterile disinfectants were not used in Grade A and B areas. The company did not monitor the aseptic filling area frequently enough to avoid possible contamination or system deterioration. The company did not adequately demonstrate that air-flow patterns did not pose a risk of contamination.

findings.text_ko: 제품 및/또는 원자재를 오염으로부터 보호하는 조치가 미흡했다.

findings.text_orig: The guidelines and/or procedures were inadequate in ensuring storage and/or transportation conditions would maintain the quality and safe distribution of the drug.

findings.text_orig: The maintenance of records was inadequate.

findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 전자서명에 대해 마련된 통제가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The controls put in place for electronic signatures were inadequate.

findings.text_orig: The importer did not have a batch certificate for each lot or batch of the drug received.

findings.text_orig: The evidence required to demonstrate compliance with finished product specifications was inadequate.

findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_orig: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 전산화시스템을 포함한 설비의 교정, 점검, 적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다. 기록의 생성·수정·검토·보관·검색에 대한 통제가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate. The controls were inadequate for creating, modifying, reviewing, storing, and/or retrieving records.

findings.text_orig: The implementation, effectiveness, and/or validation of the cleaning procedures was inadequate for preventing unsanitary conditions.

findings.text_orig: The equipment was not set-up, designed, operated, stored, and/or maintained to prevent potential contamination of drugs by other drugs and/or by foreign material.

findings.text_orig: The protection of products and/or materials from contamination was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조구역 출입을 지정된 인원으로만 제한하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The production areas were not restricted to designated staff only.

findings.text_ko: 작업자 인사기록의 유지관리가 미흡했다. 작업자에 대한 지속적인 교육이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The maintenance of personnel records was inadequate. The ongoing training of personnel was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 공조(환기)설비 공기질의 유지관리 및/또는 모니터링이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The maintenance and/or monitoring of the ventilation system's air quality was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록된 정보 또는 세부내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The recorded information or details were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 비위생적 상태를 방지하기 위한 위생관리 프로그램의 실행 및/또는 그 유효성이 미흡했다. 문서화된 위생관리 프로그램의 구비, 실행 및/또는 수준이 미흡했다. 위생관리 프로그램이 오염 위험을 파악 및/또는 저감하도록 적절히 설계되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation and/or the effectiveness of the sanitation program in preventing unsanitary conditions was inadequate. The availability, implementation, and/or quality of the written sanitation program was inadequate. The sanitation programs were not adequately designed to identify and/or reduce the risks of contamination.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The maintenance of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 온도 및/또는 습도 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The temperature and/or humidity control was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 전자서명에 대해 마련된 통제가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The controls put in place for electronic signatures were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 변경관리 시스템이 변경사항의 적절한 문서화, 평가 및/또는 승인을 보장하기에 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_orig: The ongoing training of personnel was inadequate.

findings.text_orig: The sampling procedure was inadequate for microbiological monitoring in processing areas or aseptic areas.

findings.text_ko: 의약품 제조에 사용된 원료를 기준에 따라 시험하지 않았거나, 기준에 적합하지 않았거나 및/또는 사용기한이 경과했다. 제조자의 원료 기준(specification)이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The raw materials used to fabricate a drug were not tested against the specifications, did not comply with the specifications, and/or were expired. The drug fabricator's specifications for raw materials were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: A등급 및 B등급 구역에서 멸균된 소독제를 사용하지 않았다. 무균구역의 시설 및 장비에 대한 세척·청소가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Sterile disinfectants were not used in Grade A and B areas. The company's cleaning of the premises and the equipment in aseptic areas was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 모든 멸균공정에 대하여 밸리데이션을 실시하지 않았다. 무균공정(aseptic processing) 밸리데이션이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The company did not validate all sterilization processes. The validation of aseptic processing was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사, 보고 및/또는 후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 유틸리티 및/또는 지원설비(support system)의 적격성평가(qualification) 및/또는 검증이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The qualification and/or verification of utilities and/or support systems was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 작업자에 대한 건강 요건을 문서화된 절차에 규정하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The health requirements for personnel were not captured in a written procedure.

findings.text_ko: 배지의 적합성을 검증하지 않았다. 원료, 공정 중 의약품, 벌크 의약품 및/또는 완제품 검체의 취급 및/또는 보관이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The suitability of the culture media was not verified. The handling and/or storage of samples was inadequate for raw materials, drugs being processed, bulk drugs, and/or finished products.

findings.text_ko: 컴퓨터화시스템을 포함한 장비의 교정·점검 및/또는 적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 작업자의 무균조작(aseptic practice)이 무균성을 유지하기에 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The operators'aseptic practices were inadequate to maintain sterility.

findings.text_ko: 시험실 데이터의 생성, 유지, 처리 및/또는 검토가 미흡했다. 기록의 추적성·가독성·문서화·양식 및/또는 정확성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The creation, maintenance, processing, and/or review of laboratory data was inadequate. The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 작업 공간이 미흡했다. 유틸리티 및/또는 지원 시스템의 적격성평가(qualification) 및/또는 검증이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The working spaces were inadequate. The qualification and/or verification of utilities and/or support systems was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조공정을 관리하기 위한 마스터 포뮬러(master formula)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The master formulas to control the manufacturing process were inadequate.

findings.text_orig: The quality control department's handling of complaints and/or information received about drug quality was inadequate.

findings.text_orig: The maintenance of records was inadequate. The validation of test methods was inadequate. The quality agreement outlining the responsibilities for fabricating, packaging or labelling, and/or testing was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 추적성, 판독성, 문서화, 서식, 정확성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control unit)가 요구되는 업무를 모두 수행하지 않았다. 품질경영시스템의 효과성을 이행·유지·개선하는 데 필요한 적절한 자원을 결정하거나 제공하는 경영진의 역량이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department did not undertake all of the required activities. findings.text_ko: 온도 및/또는 습도 관리가 미흡했다. 의약품의 각 로트 또는 배치에 대한 운송 및/또는 보관 조건을 입증하는 데 사용된 근거자료가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The temperature and/or humidity control was inadequate. The evidence used to demonstrate the transportation and/or storage conditions of each lot or batch of the drug was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 공급자, 제조자, 시험자, 포장자, 표시자, 유통자, 수입자, 도매상 간 품질계약서(quality agreement)의 보유, 내용, 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 자체점검(self-inspection) 프로그램의 운영이 미흡했다.

findings.text_ko: 의약품의 각 로트 또는 배치에 대한 운송 및/또는 보관 조건을 입증하는 데 사용된 근거자료가 미흡했다. 보관 및/또는 운송 조건이 의약품의 품질과 안전한 유통을 유지하도록 보장하는 지침 및/또는 절차가 미흡했다.

findings.text_orig: The controls were inadequate for creating, modifying, reviewing, storing, and/or retrieving records.

The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved. The quality control department's handling of complaints and/or information received about drug quality was inadequate.

findings.text_orig: The positive identification of each batch of drug after the packaging and/or after it was received on the importer's premises was inadequate.

findings.text_orig: The evidence used to demonstrate the transportation and/or storage conditions of each lot or batch of the drug was inadequate. Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: GMP 관련 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다.

findings.text_orig: The ongoing training of personnel was inadequate.

findings.text_orig: The temperature and/or humidity control was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 공급자·제조업자·시험자·포장자·표시자·유통업자·수입자·도매업자 간 품질계약서(quality agreement)의 구비·내용·유지가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고·후속조치가 미흡했다. 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 검토·개정·승인 체계가 미흡했다.

findings.text_orig: Senior management's ability to determine and/or provide adequate and/or appropriate resources to implement, maintain and/or improve the effectiveness of the quality management system was inadequate.

findings.text_orig: The creation, maintenance, processing, and/or review of laboratory data was inadequate.

findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 유지관리가 미흡했다.

findings.text_orig: Lots and/or batches of packaging materials were not examined and/or tested against the written specifications before they were used.

findings.text_orig: The guidelines and/or procedures were inadequate in ensuring storage and/or transportation conditions would maintain the quality and safe distribution of the drug. findings.text_ko: 컴퓨터화시스템을 포함한 설비의 교정·점검·적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 문서화된 위생관리 프로그램에 작업자 및/또는 방문자에 대한 복장 요건과 위생 절차가 명확히 규정되어 있지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The written hygiene program did not clearly define clothing requirements and/or hygiene procedures for personnel and/or visitors.

findings.text_orig: The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate. The quality control department did not approve, sign, and/or date the good manufacturing practices documents and/or the standard operating procedures.

findings.text_ko: 품질경영시스템의 실행 및/또는 유지관리가 미흡했다. 품질관리부서 책임자의 학력·경력 및/또는 감독이 미흡했다. 포장작업 책임자의 교육훈련·경력 및/또는 보고체계가 미흡했다. 직원에 대한 GMP 교육훈련 및/또는 기록 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation and/or maintenance of the quality management system was inadequate. The education, experience, and/or oversight of the individual in charge of the quality control department was inadequate. The training, experience, and/or reporting structure of the individual responsible for packaging operations was inadequate. The training of personnel in good manufacturing practices and/or the maintenance of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조, 포장, 표시, 시험, 보관 및/또는 운송 방법과 절차에 대하여 시행 전 품질관리부서 책임자의 검토 및/또는 승인이 미흡했다. 제조기준서(master production document)가 미흡했다. 새로운 공정 작업을 시작하기 전에 라인 클리어런스(line clearance)가 실시되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The examination and/or approval of fabrication, packaging, labelling, testing, storage, and/or the transportation method and procedures by the person in charge of the quality control department before implementation was inadequate. The master production documents were inadequate. Line clearance was not performed before starting new processing operations.

findings.text_ko: 회수(recall)에 대한 문서화된 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The written procedures for recalls were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 전자시스템이 의도된 용도에 대해 밸리데이션(validation)되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The electronic system was not validated for its intended use.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사, 보고 및/또는 후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 원료, 포장재, 표시(라벨링), 완제품 및/또는 재가공 중인 제품에 대한 품질관리부서(quality control unit)의 승인이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department's approval was inadequate for raw materials, packaging materials, labelling, finished products, and/or products being reprocessed.

findings.text_ko: 온도 및/또는 습도 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The temperature and/or humidity control was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 변경이 적절히 문서화·평가 및/또는 승인되도록 하는 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 공급업체, 제조원(fabricator), 시험소(tester), 포장자, 표시자, 유통업자, 수입자 및/또는 도매상 간 품질계약서(quality agreement)의 구비·내용 및/또는 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 추적성·가독성·문서화·양식 및/또는 정확성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 반품된 의약품의 재판매 검토에 대한 평가·문서화 및/또는 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment, documentation, and/or procedures for considering the resale of returned drugs were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 직원의 직무기술서, 직원에게 부여된 권한 및/또는 업무 위임이 미흡하거나 문서화되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The job descriptions for personnel, the authority given to personnel, and/or the delegation of duties was inadequate and/or undocumented.

findings.text_ko: 진본 시험성적서(authentic certificate of analysis)의 구비 또는 내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability or the content of the authentic certificate of analysis was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 밸리데이션(validation) 시험이 사전에 정해진 프로토콜에 따라 수행되지 않았다. 제조공정, 장비 및/또는 원자재에 대한 평가가 미흡했다. 기록된 정보 또는 세부내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Validation studies were not conducted in keeping with the predefined protocols. Evaluation of production processes, equipment, and/or materials was inadequate. The recorded information or details were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 데이터 거버넌스 계획(data governance plan)의 수립 및/또는 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The establishment and/or the maintenance of a data governance plan was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 안정성시험 프로그램에 사용된 분석시험법에 대한 밸리데이션(validation)을 적절히 수행하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The company did not adequately validate the analytical test procedures used in the stability program.

findings.text_orig: The sanitation programs were not adequately designed to identify and/or reduce the risks of contamination. The implementation, effectiveness, and/or validation of the cleaning procedures was inadequate for preventing unsanitary conditions. The implementation and/or the effectiveness of the sanitation program in preventing unsanitary conditions was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 각 공급업체(vendor)가 인증 기준을 충족함을 확인하는 문서가 공급업체별로 발행되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: A document was not issued for each vendor verifying the vendor meets the criteria for certification.

findings.text_ko: 위생관리(sanitation) 프로그램이 오염 위험을 파악하거나 저감하도록 적절히 설계되지 않았다. 시험실의 설계·설비·유지관리가 미흡했다. 시약 및 배지의 수령·조제·취급이 미흡했다. 시험실 데이터의 생성·유지·처리·검토가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The sanitation programs were not adequately designed to identify and/or reduce the risks of contamination. The design, equipment, and/or maintenance of the testing laboratory was inadequate. The receipt, preparation, and/or handling of reagents and culture media was inadequate. The creation, maintenance, processing, and/or review of laboratory data was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기준일탈(OOS) 시험결과의 조사·처리·보고가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The investigation, handling, and/or reporting of test results that were out-of-specification was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 컴퓨터화시스템을 포함한 설비의 교정·점검·적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 컴퓨터화 시스템을 포함한 설비의 교정, 점검 및/또는 적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 시험실 데이터의 생성, 유지, 처리 및/또는 검토가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The creation, maintenance, processing, and/or review of laboratory data was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 추적성, 판독성, 문서화, 서식 및/또는 정확성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서가 요구되는 모든 업무를 수행하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department did not undertake all of the required activities.

findings.text_ko: 주기적 확인시험(periodic confirmatory testing)이 실시되지 않았다. 포장 후 및/또는 수입자 사업장에 입고된 후 각 배치 의약품에 대한 확인시험(positive identification)이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Periodic confirmatory testing was not conducted. The positive identification of each batch of drug after the packaging and/or after it was received on the importer's premises was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 수입자가 의약품의 제조, 포장/표시 또는 시험에 사용하는 해외 사업장이 Guidance on Evidence to Demonstrate Drug GMP Compliance of Foreign Sites (GUI-0080)에 기술된 요건을 충족하는지 확인하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The importer did not ensure that the foreign sites use to fabricate, package/label, or test drug products met the requirements described in Guidance on Evidence to Demonstrate Drug GMP Compliance of Foreign Sites (GUI-0080).

findings.text_ko: 완제품 출하 승인을 위한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment to release finished products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 문서가 사업장에 비치되어 있지 않았다. 문서가 공용어 중 하나로 제공되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: Documents were not available on the premises. Documents were not available in one of the official languages.

findings.text_ko: 자체점검(self-inspection) 프로그램의 운영이 미흡했다.

findings.text_ko: 문서화된 기준규격이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The written specifications were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 의약품에 대한 지속적 안정성시험 프로그램(ongoing stability program)이 미흡했다. 기록의 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The ongoing stability program for a drug was inadequate. "The maintenance of records was inadequate.

findings.text_orig: The "Water for Injection" was not produced, stored or distributed to prevent microbial growth.

findings.text_orig: Complete confirmatory testing was not conducted on raw materials from each vendor.

findings.text_orig: The health examinations of personnel (pre-employment and/or ongoing) were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 컴퓨터화 시스템을 포함한 설비의 교정, 점검 및/또는 적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_orig: The establishment and/or the maintenance of a data governance plan was inadequate.

findings.text_orig: The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 공급자·제조자·시험자·포장자·표시자·유통자·수입자 및/또는 도매상 간 품질계약서(quality agreement)의 구비·내용 및/또는 유지관리가 미흡했다.

findings.text_ko: 시험실 데이터의 생성·유지관리·처리 및/또는 검토가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The creation, maintenance, processing, and/or review of laboratory data was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 컴퓨터화 시스템을 포함한 장비의 교정·점검 및/또는 적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control department)가 GMP 문서 및/또는 표준작업지침서(SOP)를 승인·서명 및/또는 날짜 기재하지 않았다. 전자서명(electronic signature)에 대해 마련된 통제가 미흡했다.

findings.text_orig: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 완제품 출하승인(release)을 위한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment to release finished products was inadequate.

findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 회수(recall)에 대한 문서화된 절차가 미흡했다. 문서화된 자체점검(self-inspection) 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The written procedures for recalls were inadequate. The written self-inspection procedure was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 연간 제품품질평가(annual product quality review) 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The annual product quality review procedure was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 불만 및/또는 결함 가능성이 있는 제품에 관한 기타 정보의 평가·기록·후속조치 및/또는 조사가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment, recording, follow-up, and/or investigation of complaints and/or other information about potentially defective products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: GMP 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기준에서 벗어난 경우 및/또는 제품이 허용범위 경계에 있는 경우에 대한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The evaluation was inadequate for cases where there was a deviation from the norm and/or where products were on the borderline of the acceptable range.

findings.text_ko: 공급자·제조자·시험자·포장자·표시자·유통자·수입자 및/또는 도매상 간 품질계약서(quality agreement)의 구비·내용 및/또는 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 회수(recall)에 대한 문서화된 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The written procedures for recalls were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 문서화된 자체점검(self-inspection) 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The written self-inspection procedure was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 변경이 적절히 문서화·평가 및/또는 승인되도록 보장하는 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 불만 및/또는 결함 가능성이 있는 제품에 관한 기타 정보의 평가·기록·후속조치 및/또는 조사가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment, recording, follow-up, and/or investigation of complaints and/or other information about potentially defective products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록된 정보 또는 세부내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The recorded information or details were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 추적성·가독성·문서화·서식 및/또는 정확성이 미흡했다. 기록의 생성·수정·검토·보관·검색에 대한 통제가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate. The controls were inadequate for creating, modifying, reviewing, storing, and/or retrieving records.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control department)가 독립적으로 기능하고 다른 어떤 부서와도 독립적으로 경영진에 보고하는 별도의 조직이 아니었다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department was not a distinct unit that functioned independently and reported to management independent of any other unit.

findings.text_ko: 온도 및/또는 습도 관리가 미흡했다. 보관 및/또는 운송 조건이 의약품의 품질과 안전한 유통을 유지하도록 보장하기 위한 지침 및/또는 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The temperature and/or humidity control was inadequate. The guidelines and/or procedures were inadequate in ensuring storage and/or transportation conditions would maintain the quality and safe distribution of the drug.

findings.text_ko: 직원에 대한 GMP 교육 및/또는 관련 기록의 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The training of personnel in good manufacturing practices and/or the maintenance of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control department)가 GMP 문서 및/또는 표준작업지침서(SOP)를 승인·서명 및/또는 날짜 기재하지 않았다. 기록의 생성·수정·검토·보관·검색에 대한 통제가 미흡했다. GMP 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department did not approve, sign, and/or date the good manufacturing practices documents and/or the standard operating procedures. The controls were inadequate for creating, modifying, reviewing, storing, and/or retrieving records. The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 격리보관구역(quarantine area)의 관리가 미흡했다. 시설(premises)이 오염을 방지하도록 설계·건축·운영 및/또는 유지관리되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The control of quarantine areas was inadequate. The premises were not designed, constructed, operated, and/or maintained to prevent contamination.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 유지관리가 미흡했다. 기록의 추적성·가독성·문서화·서식 및/또는 정확성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The maintenance of records was inadequate. The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 문서화된 위생관리 프로그램(sanitation program)의 구비·실행 및/또는 수준이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, implementation, and/or quality of the written sanitation program was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 컴퓨터화시스템을 포함한 설비의 교정·점검 및/또는 적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control unit) 또는 지정된 대리자가 품질관리 판정 사항에 서명 및/또는 일자를 기재하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department or the designated alternate did not sign and/or date quality control decisions.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control unit) 책임자의 학력·경력 및/또는 감독이 미흡했다. 품질관리부서가 실제로 기능하고/하거나 독립적으로 운영된다는 증거가 없었다.
findings.text_orig: The education, experience, and/or oversight of the individual in charge of the quality control department was inadequate. There was no evidence of a functioning and/or independent quality control department.

findings.text_ko: GMP 관련 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 생성·수정·검토·보관 및/또는 검색에 대한 통제가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The controls were inadequate for creating, modifying, reviewing, storing, and/or retrieving records.

findings.text_ko: 제품 및/또는 자재의 오염 방지가 미흡했다. 사전 승인된 문서화된 절차 또는 지시에 따른 원료·제품·포장재의 취급이 미흡했다. 기록된 정보 또는 세부사항이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The protection of products and/or materials from contamination was inadequate. The handling of raw materials, products, or packaging materials in keeping with pre-approved written procedures or instructions was inadequate. The recorded information or details were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 해당 의약품의 지속(ongoing) 안정성시험 프로그램이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The ongoing stability program for a drug was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사, 보고 및/또는 후속조치가 미흡했다. 기준일탈(OOS) 시험결과의 조사·처리·보고가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate. The investigation, handling, and/or reporting of test results that were out-of-specification was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 온도 및/또는 습도 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The temperature and/or humidity control was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 비위생적 상태를 방지하기 위한 세척 절차의 실행, 효과성 및/또는 밸리데이션이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation, effectiveness, and/or validation of the cleaning procedures was inadequate for preventing unsanitary conditions.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 생성·수정·검토·보관·검색에 대한 통제가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The controls were inadequate for creating, modifying, reviewing, storing, and/or retrieving records.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 추적성, 가독성, 문서화, 서식 및/또는 정확성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 멸균 전 모든 공정 단계에서 오염을 최소화하기 위한 예방조치를 취하지 않았다. 환경모니터링을 위한 검체 채취 수가 불충분했다.
findings.text_orig: The company did not take precautions to minimize contamination during all processing prior to sterilization. The number of samples taken for environmental monitoring was insufficient.

findings.text_ko: 무균구역(aseptic area) 내 시설 및 장비에 대한 세척이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The company's cleaning of the premises and the equipment in aseptic areas was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기준일탈(OOS) 시험결과의 조사·처리·보고가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The investigation, handling, and/or reporting of test results that were out-of-specification was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 의약품 제조에 사용되는 원료의 기준규격이 공정서(pharmacopoeia) 기준을 충족하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The specifications for raw materials used to produce drugs did not meet pharmacopoeial standards.

findings.text_ko: 위생관리(sanitation) 프로그램이 오염 위험을 식별·저감하도록 적절하게 설계되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The sanitation programs were not adequately designed to identify and/or reduce the risks of contamination.

findings.text_ko: 데이터 거버넌스 계획(data governance plan)의 수립·유지가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The establishment and/or the maintenance of a data governance plan was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 변경사항이 적절하게 문서화·평가·승인되도록 보장하는 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 추적성·가독성·문서화·서식·정확성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 작업자의 무균조작(aseptic practice)이 무균성을 유지하기에 미흡했다. 제조공정·장비·자재에 대한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The operators'aseptic practices were inadequate to maintain sterility. Evaluation of production processes, equipment, and/or materials was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 배지충전(media fill) 실패 또는 무균시험 실패 이후의 시정조치가 미흡했다. 청정구역(critical area) 내 미생물 오염에 대한 조사가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The company's corrective action after a media fill failure or a sterility test failure was inadequate. The company's investigations of microbial contamination in critical areas were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 무균공정(aseptic processing)의 밸리데이션이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The validation of aseptic processing was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록된 정보 또는 그 세부 내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The recorded information or details were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 데이터 거버넌스(data governance) 계획의 수립 및/또는 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The establishment and/or the maintenance of a data governance plan was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 변경사항이 적절하게 문서화·평가·승인되도록 보장하는 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 시험실 데이터의 생성, 유지, 처리 및/또는 검토가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The creation, maintenance, processing, and/or review of laboratory data was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control unit)가 요구되는 활동을 모두 수행하지는 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department did not undertake all of the required activities.

findings.text_ko: 포장지시서에 요구되는 정보가 포함되어 있지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: Packaging orders did not include the required information.

findings.text_ko: 비위생적 상태를 방지하기 위한 위생관리(sanitation) 프로그램의 실행 및/또는 효과성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation and/or the effectiveness of the sanitation program in preventing unsanitary conditions was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 문서화된 위생관리(sanitation) 프로그램의 구비, 실행 및/또는 수준이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, implementation, and/or quality of the written sanitation program was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 시험실 데이터(laboratory data)의 생성·유지·처리·검토가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The creation, maintenance, processing, and/or review of laboratory data was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 데이터 거버넌스 계획(data governance plan)의 수립·유지가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The establishment and/or the maintenance of a data governance plan was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 불만 또는 잠재적 결함 제품에 관한 기타 정보의 평가·기록·후속조치·조사가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment, recording, follow-up, and/or investigation of complaints and/or other information about potentially defective products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 시설(premises)이 오염을 방지하도록 설계·건축·운영 및/또는 유지관리되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The premises were not designed, constructed, operated, and/or maintained to prevent contamination.

findings.text_ko: 비위생적 상태를 방지하기 위한 위생관리 프로그램(sanitation program)의 실행 및/또는 효과성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation and/or the effectiveness of the sanitation program in preventing unsanitary conditions was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control department)가 요구되는 활동을 모두 수행하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department did not undertake all of the required activities.

findings.text_ko: 직원에 대한 GMP 교육 및/또는 관련 기록의 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The training of personnel in good manufacturing practices and/or the maintenance of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 불만 및/또는 잠재적 결함 제품에 관한 기타 정보의 평가·기록·후속조치 및/또는 조사가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment, recording, follow-up, and/or investigation of complaints and/or other information about potentially defective products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 포장자재 공급업체 인증(vendor certification) 프로그램이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The packaging materials vendor certification program was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록된 정보나 세부 내용이 미흡했다. 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 검토·개정·승인 체계가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The recorded information or details were inadequate. The system for reviewing, revising, and approving standard operating procedures was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 변경사항이 적절히 문서화·평가 및/또는 승인되도록 보증하는 변경관리 시스템이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 보관 및/또는 운송 조건이 의약품의 품질과 안전한 유통을 유지하도록 보증하는 지침 및/또는 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The guidelines and/or procedures were inadequate in ensuring storage and/or transportation conditions would maintain the quality and safe distribution of the drug.

findings.text_ko: 제조구역이 적절히 격리·구획되도록 시설이 배치되거나 설계되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The premises were not laid out and/or designed to ensure that production areas were adequately isolated and segregated.

findings.text_ko: 작업자 관련 기록의 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The maintenance of personnel records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control unit)가 GMP 문서 및/또는 표준작업지침서(SOP)를 승인·서명 및/또는 일자 기재하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department did not approve, sign, and/or date the good manufacturing practices documents and/or the standard operating procedures.

findings.text_ko: 공급자·제조자·시험자·포장자·표시자·유통자·수입자 및/또는 도매상 간 품질계약서(quality agreement)의 구비·내용 및/또는 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 의약품에 대한 지속적 안정성시험 프로그램(ongoing stability program)이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The ongoing stability program for a drug was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: GMP 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 원자재의 입고 및 출고(수불)에 관한 표준작업지침서(SOP) 또는 기록이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The standard operating procedures or records for shipping and receiving raw materials were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 위생관리(sanitation) 프로그램이 오염 위험을 파악하거나 저감하도록 적절히 설계되지 않았다. 비위생적 상태를 방지하기 위한 세척절차의 실행·실효성 및/또는 밸리데이션(validation)이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The sanitation programs were not adequately designed to identify and/or reduce the risks of contamination. The implementation, effectiveness, and/or validation of the cleaning procedures was inadequate for preventing unsanitary conditions.

findings.text_ko: 온도 및/또는 습도 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The temperature and/or humidity control was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 전산화 시스템을 포함한 장비의 교정·점검·적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 전산화 시스템을 포함한 장비의 교정·점검·적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다. 시험실 데이터(laboratory data)의 생성·유지·처리·검토가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate. The creation, maintenance, processing, and/or review of laboratory data was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 종업원에 대한 건강관리 요건이 문서화된 절차에 규정되어 있지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The health requirements for personnel were not captured in a written procedure.

findings.text_ko: 연간 제품품질평가(annual product quality review) 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The annual product quality review procedure was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 공급자·제조자·시험자·포장자·표시자·유통업자·수입자·도매상 간 품질계약서(quality agreement)의 확보·내용·유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 종업원에 대한 GMP 교육·기록 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The training of personnel in good manufacturing practices and/or the maintenance of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control unit)가 GMP 문서·표준작업지침서(SOP)를 승인·서명·일자 기재하지 않았다. GMP 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department did not approve, sign, and/or date the good manufacturing practices documents and/or the standard operating procedures. The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 인쇄된 포장재가 출입이 제한된 구역에 보관되지 않았다. 제조공정·장비·자재에 대한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Printed packaging materials were not stored in an area with restricted access. Evaluation of production processes, equipment, and/or materials was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 변경사항이 적절하게 문서화·평가·승인되도록 보장하는 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 전산화 시스템을 포함한 장비의 교정·점검·적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고·후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조·포장 또는 표시·시험에 대한 책임을 규정한 품질계약서(quality agreement)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The quality agreement outlining the responsibilities for fabricating, packaging or labelling, and/or testing was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 생성·수정·검토·보관·검색에 대한 통제가 미흡했다. 기록의 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The controls were inadequate for creating, modifying, reviewing, storing, and/or retrieving records. The maintenance of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 연간 제품품질평가(annual product quality review) 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The annual product quality review procedure was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 작업자에 대한 GMP 교육훈련 및/또는 그 기록의 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The training of personnel in good manufacturing practices and/or the maintenance of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 불만 및/또는 결함 가능성이 있는 제품에 관한 기타 정보의 평가·기록·후속조치 및/또는 조사가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment, recording, follow-up, and/or investigation of complaints and/or other information about potentially defective products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control unit)가 연간 제품품질평가(annual product quality review) 결과를 평가하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department did not evaluate the results of the annual product quality review.

findings.text_ko: 컴퓨터화 시스템을 포함한 장비의 교정·점검 및/또는 적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 변경사항의 적절한 문서화·평가 및/또는 승인을 보장하기에 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 기준에서 일탈(deviation)이 발생한 경우 및/또는 제품이 허용범위 경계에 있는 경우에 대한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The evaluation was inadequate for cases where there was a deviation from the norm and/or where products were on the borderline of the acceptable range.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 추적성·판독성·문서화·서식 및/또는 정확성이 미흡했다. 기록된 정보 또는 세부 내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate. The recorded information or details were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조공정·장비 및/또는 자재에 대한 평가가 미흡했다. 포장 제품의 마스터 처방서(master formula)에 요구되는 정보가 포함되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: Evaluation of production processes, equipment, and/or materials was inadequate. The master formula for packaged products did not include the required information.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control unit) 책임자의 교육·경력 및/또는 감독이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The education, experience, and/or oversight of the individual in charge of the quality control department was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 문서화된 회수(recall) 체계에 각 의약품을 추적할 수 있는 유통기록이 포함되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The written recall system did not include distribution records that allowed each drug to be traced.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 생성·수정·검토·보관 및/또는 검색에 대한 통제가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The controls were inadequate for creating, modifying, reviewing, storing, and/or retrieving records.

findings.text_ko: 컴퓨터화 시스템을 포함한 설비의 교정·점검 및/또는 적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 시험방법의 밸리데이션(validation) 및/또는 문서화가 미흡했다. 기록의 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The validation and/or the documentation of test methods was inadequate. The maintenance of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 연간 제품품질평가(annual product quality review) 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The annual product quality review procedure was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 작업자에 대한 GMP 교육 및/또는 기록의 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The training of personnel in good manufacturing practices and/or the maintenance of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조, 포장 또는 표시 및/또는 시험에 대한 책임을 규정한 품질계약서(quality agreement)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The quality agreement outlining the responsibilities for fabricating, packaging or labelling, and/or testing was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 시설(premises)이 오염을 방지하도록 설계·건축·운영 및/또는 유지관리되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The premises were not designed, constructed, operated, and/or maintained to prevent contamination.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 생성·수정·검토·보관 및/또는 검색에 대한 통제가 미흡했다. 전자서명에 대해 마련된 통제가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The controls were inadequate for creating, modifying, reviewing, storing, and/or retrieving records. The controls put in place for electronic signatures were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: GMP 관련 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다. 변경사항이 적절히 문서화·평가 및/또는 승인되도록 보증하는 변경관리 시스템이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate. The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 자체점검(self-inspection) 프로그램의 운영이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation of a self-inspection program was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 불만 및/또는 잠재적 결함 제품에 관한 기타 정보의 평가·기록·후속조치 및/또는 조사가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment, recording, follow-up, and/or investigation of complaints and/or other information about potentially defective products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 정품 시험성적서(certificate of analysis)의 확보 또는 그 내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability or the content of the authentic certificate of analysis was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 공급자, 제조원(fabricator), 시험자, 포장업자, 표시업자, 유통업자, 수입업자 및/또는 도매업자 간 품질계약서(quality agreement)의 확보·내용 및/또는 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 장비가 다른 의약품 및/또는 이물에 의한 의약품 오염 가능성을 방지하도록 설치·설계·운전·보관 및/또는 유지관리되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The equipment was not set-up, designed, operated, stored, and/or maintained to prevent potential contamination of drugs by other drugs and/or by foreign material.

findings.text_ko: 멸균필터의 완전성시험(integrity test)에 대한 문서화가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The documentation for the integrity testing of sterilizing filters was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 무균공정(aseptic processing)의 밸리데이션(validation)이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The validation of aseptic processing was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 유틸리티 및/또는 지원 시스템의 적격성평가(qualification) 및/또는 검증이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The qualification and/or verification of utilities and/or support systems was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 무균구역 또는 청정구역(clean area)의 환경 등급 분류를 위한 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The process was inadequate for the environmental classification of aseptic or clean areas.

findings.text_ko: 컴퓨터화 시스템을 포함한 장비의 교정·점검 및/또는 적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다. 장비의 설계·구조·운전 및/또는 설치 위치가 의약품 오염을 방지하기에 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate. The design, construction, operation, and/or location of the equipment was inadequate for preventing contamination of the drug.

findings.text_ko: 기록된 정보나 세부 내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The recorded information or details were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사, 보고 및/또는 후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 생성·수정·검토·보관 및/또는 검색에 대한 통제가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The controls were inadequate for creating, modifying, reviewing, storing, and/or retrieving records.

findings.text_ko: 원자재 공급업체 인증(vendor certification) 프로그램에 따른 감사보고서가 확보되어 있지 않거나 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: An audit report was not available or was inadequate under the raw material vendor certification program.

findings.text_ko: 작업자에 대한 지속적인 교육이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The ongoing training of personnel was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조·포장·표시·필수 시험·보관 및/또는 유통에 대한 증빙자료의 유지관리가 미흡했으며, 각 단계의 수행 조건에 대한 증빙도 포함하여 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The maintenance of evidence was inadequate for manufacturing, packaging, labelling, required testing, storage, and/or distribution, including the respective conditions.

findings.text_ko: 기준일탈(OOS) 시험결과의 조사·처리·보고가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The investigation, handling, and/or reporting of test results that were out-of-specification was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고 및/또는 후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 공급자·제조자·시험자·포장자·표시자·유통자·수입자 및/또는 도매상 간 품질계약서(quality agreement)의 구비·내용 및/또는 유지관리가 미흡했다. 제조자, 포장/표시자, 유통자 또는 수입자에 의한 수탁자(contractor) 역량 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate. The assessment of the contractor's competencies by the fabricator, packager/labeller, distributor, or importer was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 컨설턴트 및/또는 수탁자(contractor)가 필요한 자격·교육 및/또는 경험을 갖추지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The consultants and/or contractors did not have the necessary qualifications, training, and/or experience.

findings.text_ko: 불만 및/또는 결함 가능성이 있는 제품에 관한 기타 정보의 평가·기록·후속조치 및/또는 조사가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment, recording, follow-up, and/or investigation of complaints and/or other information about potentially defective products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 의약품에 대한 지속적 안정성시험 프로그램(ongoing stability program)이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The ongoing stability program for a drug was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 요구사항에 따른 전체 시험이 수행되지 않았다. 캐나다 반입 전 또는 후에 검체에 대해 실시한 확인시험(confirmatory test)이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Complete testing was not performed according to the requirements. The confirmatory tests conducted on samples before or after they were received in Canada were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 비위생적 상태를 방지하기 위한 위생관리(sanitation) 프로그램의 실행 및/또는 실효성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation and/or the effectiveness of the sanitation program in preventing unsanitary conditions was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 회수(recall)에 관한 문서화된 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The written procedures for recalls were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 추적성·가독성·문서화·서식 및/또는 정확성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 사전 승인된 문서화된 절차나 지시에 따른 원자재·제품 또는 포장자재의 취급이 미흡했다. 제품 및/또는 자재의 오염 방지가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The handling of raw materials, products, or packaging materials in keeping with pre-approved written procedures or instructions was inadequate. The protection of products and/or materials from contamination was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 자재, 벌크 용기, 주요 설비 및/또는 작업실이 적절하게 식별 표시되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: Materials, bulk containers, major items of equipment, and/or the rooms were not properly identified.

findings.text_ko: 시험실 데이터의 생성·유지·처리 및/또는 검토가 미흡했다. 시약 및 배지의 인수·조제 및/또는 취급이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The creation, maintenance, processing, and/or review of laboratory data was inadequate. The receipt, preparation, and/or handling of reagents and culture media was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: GMP 관련 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 공급자, 제조원(fabricator), 시험자, 포장업자, 표시업자, 유통업자, 수입업자 및/또는 도매업자 간 품질계약서(quality agreement)의 확보·내용 및/또는 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 불만 및/또는 잠재적 결함 제품에 관한 기타 정보의 평가·기록·후속조치 및/또는 조사가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment, recording, follow-up, and/or investigation of complaints and/or other information about potentially defective products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 신규 또는 개정된 표준작업지침서(SOP) 시행 전 작업자에 대한 교육이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The training of personnel before new or revised standard operating procedures were implemented was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 회사는 기준일탈(OOS)·경계값 또는 경향일탈(out-of-trend)에 해당하는 안정성시험 결과에 대해 그 결과를 평가하지 않았거나 시정조치를 취하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The company did not assess the results and/or take corrective actions for stability testing results that were out-of-specification, borderline, or out-of-trend .

findings.text_ko: 완제품 출하를 위한 평가가 미흡했다. 기준일탈(OOS) 시험결과의 조사·처리 및/또는 보고가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment to release finished products was inadequate. The investigation, handling, and/or reporting of test results that were out-of-specification was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 검토·개정·승인 체계가 미흡했다. GMP 관련 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다. 기록의 추적성·가독성·문서화·서식 및/또는 정확성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The system for reviewing, revising, and approving standard operating procedures was inadequate. The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate. The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 작업자에 대한 GMP 교육 및/또는 기록의 유지관리가 미흡했다. 작업자에 대한 지속적인 교육이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The training of personnel in good manufacturing practices and/or the maintenance of records was inadequate. The ongoing training of personnel was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조, 포장 또는 표시 및/또는 시험에 대한 책임을 규정한 품질계약서(quality agreement)가 미흡했다. 자체점검(self-inspection) 프로그램의 운영이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The quality agreement outlining the responsibilities for fabricating, packaging or labelling, and/or testing was inadequate. The implementation of a self-inspection program was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 자체점검(self-inspection) 프로그램의 운영이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation of a self-inspection program was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 생성·수정·검토·보관 및/또는 검색에 대한 통제가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The controls were inadequate for creating, modifying, reviewing, storing, and/or retrieving records.

findings.text_ko: 기록된 정보나 세부 내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The recorded information or details were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 액체 및/또는 가스 배출구(outlet)의 표시가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The labelling of outlets for liquids and/or gases was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 장비의 예방정비 및 수리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The preventative maintenance and repair of the equipment was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control unit)가 의약품 품질에 관한 불만을 인지하여 담당 책임자에게 전달하는 체계가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department's ability to recognize and forward complaints about the quality of a drug to the appropriate person in charge was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 종업원 기록의 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The maintenance of personnel records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 시험방법의 밸리데이션·문서화가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The validation and/or the documentation of test methods was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조구역이 적절히 격리·구획되도록 시설이 배치되거나 설계되지 않았다. 격리보관(quarantine) 구역의 관리가 미흡했다. 온도 및/또는 습도 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The premises were not laid out and/or designed to ensure that production areas were adequately isolated and segregated. The control of quarantine areas was inadequate. The temperature and/or humidity control was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 작업자의 직무기술서, 작업자에게 부여된 권한 및/또는 업무 위임이 미흡하거나 문서화되지 않았다. 작업자에 대한 GMP 교육 및/또는 기록의 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The job descriptions for personnel, the authority given to personnel, and/or the delegation of duties was inadequate and/or undocumented. The training of personnel in good manufacturing practices and/or the maintenance of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 공급자, 제조원(fabricator), 시험자, 포장업자, 표시업자, 유통업자, 수입업자 및/또는 도매업자 간 품질계약서(quality agreement)의 확보·내용 및/또는 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조기준서(master production document)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The master production documents were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기능하고 있거나 독립적인 품질관리부서(quality control unit)가 존재한다는 증거가 없었다. 품질경영시스템의 실효성을 실행·유지 및/또는 개선하기 위해 충분하고 적절한 자원을 결정 및/또는 제공하는 최고경영진의 역량이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: There was no evidence of a functioning and/or independent quality control department. Senior management's ability to determine and/or provide adequate and/or appropriate resources to implement, maintain and/or improve the effectiveness of the quality management system was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 컴퓨터화 시스템을 포함한 설비의 교정·점검 및/또는 적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 검토·개정·승인 체계가 미흡했다. GMP 관련 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다. 변경사항이 적절히 문서화·평가 및/또는 승인되도록 보증하는 변경관리 시스템이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The system for reviewing, revising, and approving standard operating procedures was inadequate. The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate. The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 추적성·판독성·문서화·서식 및/또는 정확성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 건물·시설(premises)의 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The maintenance of the premises was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 원료의 각 로트 또는 배치가 의약품 제조에 사용되기 전에 원료 규격에 대해 시험되지 않았다. 기록의 추적성·판독성·문서화·서식 및/또는 정확성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Each lot or batch of raw materials was not tested against the raw material specifications before it was used to fabricate a drug. The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 작업자의 무균조작(aseptic practice)이 무균성을 유지하기에 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The operators'aseptic practices were inadequate to maintain sterility.

findings.text_ko: 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 변경사항의 적절한 문서화·평가 및/또는 승인을 보장하기에 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 시험실의 설계·장비 및/또는 유지관리가 미흡했다. GMP 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The design, equipment, and/or maintenance of the testing laboratory was inadequate. The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 컴퓨터화 시스템을 포함한 장비의 교정·점검 및/또는 적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 멸균필터의 완전성시험(integrity test)에 대한 문서화가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The documentation for the integrity testing of sterilizing filters was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 문서화된 위생관리(sanitation) 프로그램의 구비·실행 및/또는 수준이 미흡했다. 위생관리(sanitation) 프로그램이 오염 위험을 파악 및/또는 저감하도록 적절히 설계되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, implementation, and/or quality of the written sanitation program was inadequate. The sanitation programs were not adequately designed to identify and/or reduce the risks of contamination.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 생성·수정·검토·보관 및/또는 검색에 대한 통제가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The controls were inadequate for creating, modifying, reviewing, storing, and/or retrieving records.

findings.text_ko: 중요 공정 및 절차가 정기적으로 평가되지 않았다. 연간 제품품질평가(annual product quality review) 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Critical processes and procedures were not evaluated on a regular basis. The annual product quality review procedure was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 업체는 기류 패턴(air-flow pattern)이 오염 위험을 초래하지 않는다는 점을 적절히 입증하지 못했다. 업체는 청정구역(clean area)의 미생물 오염과 부유입자 수를 최소화하도록 건물·시설 및 장비를 설계하거나 유지관리하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The company did not adequately demonstrate that air-flow patterns did not pose a risk of contamination. The company did not design or maintain the premises and equipment to minimize microbial contamination and the number of airborne particles in clean areas.

documents.firm_name: Omega Laboratories Ltd. (now Juno Pharma Canada Inc.)

findings.text_ko: 청정구역(critical area)의 미생물 오염에 대한 회사의 조사가 미흡했다. 공정구역 또는 무균구역(aseptic area)의 미생물 모니터링을 위한 검체채취 절차가 미흡했다. 회사는 청정구역(clean area)의 미생물 오염과 부유입자 수를 최소화하도록 시설과 설비를 설계하거나 유지관리하지 않았다. 제조공정·설비 및/또는 자재에 대한 평가가 미흡했다. 품질관리부서(quality control unit)가 요구되는 활동을 모두 수행하지는 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The company's investigations of microbial contamination in critical areas were inadequate. The sampling procedure was inadequate for microbiological monitoring in processing areas or aseptic areas. The company did not design or maintain the premises and equipment to minimize microbial contamination and the number of airborne particles in clean areas. Evaluation of production processes, equipment, and/or materials was inadequate. The quality control department did not undertake all of the required activities.

findings.text_ko: 회사는 기류 패턴(air-flow pattern)이 오염 위험을 초래하지 않는다는 점을 충분히 입증하지 못했다.
findings.text_orig: The company did not adequately demonstrate that air-flow patterns did not pose a risk of contamination.

findings.text_ko: 변경사항이 적절히 문서화·평가 및/또는 승인되도록 보증하는 변경관리 시스템이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 기준에서 벗어난 일탈(deviation)이 있었던 경우 및/또는 제품이 허용범위 경계선에 있었던 경우에 대한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The evaluation was inadequate for cases where there was a deviation from the norm and/or where products were on the borderline of the acceptable range.

findings.text_ko: 컴퓨터화 시스템을 포함한 설비의 교정·점검 및/또는 적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조공정·설비 및/또는 자재에 대한 평가가 미흡했다. 청정구역(clean area)에 대한 문서화된 위생관리(sanitation) 프로그램이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Evaluation of production processes, equipment, and/or materials was inadequate. The written sanitation program for clean areas was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 작업자의 직무기술서, 작업자에게 부여된 권한 및/또는 업무 위임이 미흡하거나 문서화되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The job descriptions for personnel, the authority given to personnel, and/or the delegation of duties was inadequate and/or undocumented.

findings.text_ko: 회수(recall)에 관한 문서화된 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The written procedures for recalls were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 자체점검(self-inspection) 프로그램의 운영이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation of a self-inspection program was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The maintenance of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 공급자, 제조원(fabricator), 시험자, 포장업자, 표시업자, 유통업자, 수입업자 및/또는 도매업자 간 품질계약서(quality agreement)의 확보·내용 및/또는 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: GMP 관련 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.
