findings.text_ko: 전산화 시스템을 포함한 장비의 교정·점검·적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 보관·운송 조건이 의약품의 품질과 안전한 유통을 유지하도록 보장하는 지침·절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The guidelines and/or procedures were inadequate in ensuring storage and/or transportation conditions would maintain the quality and safe distribution of the drug.

findings.text_ko: 변경사항이 적절하게 문서화·평가·승인되도록 보장하는 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 미흡했다. 전산화 시스템을 포함한 장비의 교정·점검·적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved. The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: GMP 관련 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 회수(recall)를 지원하기 위해 제품 재고 및 유통기록을 관리하는 데 사용되는 컴퓨터화 시스템이 밸리데이션(validation)되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The computerized system used to manage product inventory and distribution records to support recalls was not validated.

findings.text_ko: 직원에 대한 GMP 교육 및 그 기록의 관리가 미흡했다. 직원의 직무기술서, 직원에게 부여된 권한 및 업무 위임이 미흡하거나 문서화되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The training of personnel in good manufacturing practices and/or the maintenance of records was inadequate. The job descriptions for personnel, the authority given to personnel, and/or the delegation of duties was inadequate and/or undocumented.

findings.text_ko: 격리보관구역의 관리가 미흡했다. 온도 및 습도 관리가 미흡했다. 건물 내부로 해충 및 이물이 유입되는 것을 방지하도록 시설이 설계·시공·유지관리되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The control of quarantine areas was inadequate. The temperature and/or humidity control was inadequate. The premises were not designed, constructed, and/or maintained to prevent the entry of pests and/or foreign material into the building.

findings.text_ko: 의약품 각 로트 또는 배치의 운송 및/또는 보관 조건을 입증하는 데 사용된 근거자료가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The evidence used to demonstrate the transportation and/or storage conditions of each lot or batch of the drug was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 의약품 안정성시험의 설계가 미흡했고 및/또는 문서화된 근거로 타당성이 입증되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The design of the drug stability study was inadequate and/or not justified with a documented rationale.

findings.text_ko: 품질경영시스템의 실행·유지 및/또는 효과성 개선을 위해 적절하고 타당한 자원을 결정하고 및/또는 제공하는 경영진의 역량이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Senior management's ability to determine and/or provide adequate and/or appropriate resources to implement, maintain and/or improve the effectiveness of the quality management system was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기류 패턴(air-flow pattern)이 오염 위험을 유발하지 않는다는 점을 충분히 입증하지 못했다.
findings.text_orig: The company did not adequately demonstrate that air-flow patterns did not pose a risk of contamination.

findings.text_ko: 청정구역(critical area)의 미생물 오염에 대한 회사의 조사가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The company's investigations of microbial contamination in critical areas were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 공급자, 제조자(fabricator), 시험자, 포장자, 표시자, 유통자, 수입자 및/또는 도매상 간 품질계약서(quality agreement)의 구비, 내용 및/또는 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 위생관리(sanitation) 프로그램의 청소 절차, 청소 주기, 폐기물 처리 절차 및/또는 방충·방서 조치가 미흡했다. 무균성을 유지하기 위한 작업자의 무균조작(aseptic) 관행이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The sanitation program was inadequate in its cleaning procedures, frequency of cleaning, procedures for waste disposal, and/or pest control measures. The operators'aseptic practices were inadequate to maintain sterility.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 생성·수정·검토·보관·검색에 대한 통제가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The controls were inadequate for creating, modifying, reviewing, storing, and/or retrieving records.

findings.text_ko: GMP 관련 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 변경사항이 적절하게 문서화·평가·승인되도록 보장하는 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 건물 내로 해충 및/또는 이물이 유입되는 것을 방지하도록 시설이 설계·시공 및/또는 유지관리되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The premises were not designed, constructed, and/or maintained to prevent the entry of pests and/or foreign material into the building.

findings.text_ko: 작업자의 직무기술서, 작업자에게 부여된 권한 및/또는 업무 위임이 미흡하거나 문서화되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The job descriptions for personnel, the authority given to personnel, and/or the delegation of duties was inadequate and/or undocumented.

findings.text_ko: 온도 및/또는 습도 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The temperature and/or humidity control was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 변경사항이 적절하게 문서화·평가·승인되도록 보장하는 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 불만 및/또는 결함 가능성이 있는 제품에 관한 그 밖의 정보에 대한 평가, 기록, 후속조치 및/또는 조사가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment, recording, follow-up, and/or investigation of complaints and/or other information about potentially defective products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 원자재, 공정 중 의약품, 벌크 의약품 및/또는 완제품에 대한 검체의 취급 및/또는 보관이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The handling and/or storage of samples was inadequate for raw materials, drugs being processed, bulk drugs, and/or finished products.

findings.text_ko: 비위생적 상태를 방지하기 위한 위생관리(sanitation) 프로그램의 실행 및/또는 효과성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation and/or the effectiveness of the sanitation program in preventing unsanitary conditions was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control unit) 책임자의 학력, 경력 및/또는 감독이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The education, experience, and/or oversight of the individual in charge of the quality control department was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 의약품을 제조·포장·표시 및/또는 시험하는 각 건물에 대한 상세 도면 또는 명세의 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The maintenance of detailed plans or specifications was inadequate for each building where drugs are fabricated, packaged, labelled, and/or tested.

findings.text_ko: 변경사항이 적절하게 문서화·평가·승인되도록 보장하는 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 시험실의 설계, 장비 및/또는 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The design, equipment, and/or maintenance of the testing laboratory was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 데이터 거버넌스(data governance) 계획의 수립 및/또는 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The establishment and/or the maintenance of a data governance plan was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 온도 및/또는 습도 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The temperature and/or humidity control was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 컴퓨터화시스템을 포함한 설비의 교정, 점검 및/또는 적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기준일탈(OOS) 시험결과의 조사·처리·보고가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The investigation, handling, and/or reporting of test results that were out-of-specification was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 변경사항이 적절하게 문서화·평가·승인되도록 보장하는 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 데이터 거버넌스(data governance) 계획의 수립 및/또는 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The establishment and/or the maintenance of a data governance plan was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 오염 위험을 파악하고 및/또는 저감하도록 위생관리(sanitation) 프로그램이 적절하게 설계되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The sanitation programs were not adequately designed to identify and/or reduce the risks of contamination.

findings.text_ko: 주요 제조공정·시험 작업에 사용되는 장비에 대한 예방정비(preventative maintenance) 프로그램이 미흡했다. 전산화 시스템을 포함한 장비의 교정·점검·적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The preventative maintenance program was inadequate for the equipment used in significant processing and/or testing operations. The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control unit)가 요구되는 업무를 모두 수행하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department did not undertake all of the required activities.

findings.text_ko: 요건에 따른 전 항목 시험이 수행되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: Complete testing was not performed according to the requirements.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고·후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조공정·장비·자재에 대한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Evaluation of production processes, equipment, and/or materials was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 주요 제조공정 및/또는 시험 작업에 사용되는 설비에 대한 예방정비(preventative maintenance) 프로그램이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The preventative maintenance program was inadequate for the equipment used in significant processing and/or testing operations.

findings.text_ko: 시험방법의 밸리데이션(validation) 및/또는 문서화가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The validation and/or the documentation of test methods was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기준일탈(OOS) 시험결과의 조사·처리·보고가 미흡했다. 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사, 보고 및/또는 후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The investigation, handling, and/or reporting of test results that were out-of-specification was inadequate. Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 데이터 거버넌스(data governance) 계획의 수립 및/또는 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The establishment and/or the maintenance of a data governance plan was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 공급자, 제조자(fabricator), 시험자, 포장자, 표시자, 유통자, 수입자 및/또는 도매상 간 품질계약서(quality agreement)의 구비, 내용 및/또는 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: GMP 관련 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다. 기록의 생성·수정·검토·보관·검색에 대한 통제가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate. The controls were inadequate for creating, modifying, reviewing, storing, and/or retrieving records.

findings.text_ko: 데이터 거버넌스(data governance) 계획의 수립 및/또는 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The establishment and/or the maintenance of a data governance plan was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 작업자에 대한 지속적인 교육훈련이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The ongoing training of personnel was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 공급자, 제조자(fabricator), 시험자, 포장자, 표시자, 유통자, 수입자 및/또는 도매상 간 품질계약서(quality agreement)의 구비, 내용 및/또는 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기준일탈(OOS), 경계값(borderline) 또는 경향이탈(out-of-trend)에 해당하는 안정성시험 결과에 대해 결과를 평가하지 않았거나 시정조치를 취하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The company did not assess the results and/or take corrective actions for stability testing results that were out-of-specification, borderline, or out-of-trend .

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사, 보고 및/또는 후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 의약품의 품질과 안전한 유통을 유지할 수 있는 보관 및/또는 운송 조건을 보장하기 위한 지침 및/또는 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The guidelines and/or procedures were inadequate in ensuring storage and/or transportation conditions would maintain the quality and safe distribution of the drug.

findings.text_ko: 전자시스템이 의도된 용도에 대해 밸리데이션(validation)되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The electronic system was not validated for its intended use.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 추적성, 가독성, 문서화, 서식 및/또는 정확성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 설비의 밸리데이션(validation) 또는 계획된 정비가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The validation of equipment or the planned maintenance of equipment was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: GMP 관련 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 변경사항이 적절하게 문서화·평가·승인되도록 보장하는 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 반품된 의약품의 재판매 검토에 관한 평가·문서화 및/또는 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment, documentation, and/or procedures for considering the resale of returned drugs were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 완제품 출하승인을 위한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment to release finished products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 연간 제품품질평가(annual product quality review) 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The annual product quality review procedure was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록된 정보 또는 세부 내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The recorded information or details were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)·보고 및/또는 후속조치에 대한 조사가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 해당 의약품에 대한 지속적 안정성시험(ongoing stability) 프로그램이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The ongoing stability program for a drug was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 자체점검(self-inspection) 프로그램의 실행이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation of a self-inspection program was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조·포장·표시·요구되는 시험·보관 및/또는 유통에 대해 각각의 조건을 포함한 증빙의 유지관리가 미흡했다. 기록의 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The maintenance of evidence was inadequate for manufacturing, packaging, labelling, required testing, storage, and/or distribution, including the respective conditions. The maintenance of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 반품된 의약품의 재판매 검토에 관한 평가·문서화 및/또는 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment, documentation, and/or procedures for considering the resale of returned drugs were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 결함 가능성이 있는 제품에 관한 불만 및/또는 기타 정보의 평가·기록·후속조치 및/또는 조사가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment, recording, follow-up, and/or investigation of complaints and/or other information about potentially defective products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조공정·설비 및/또는 자재에 대한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Evaluation of production processes, equipment, and/or materials was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 신규 또는 개정된 표준작업지침서(SOP) 시행 전 작업자 교육이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The training of personnel before new or revised standard operating procedures were implemented was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control unit)가 요구되는 모든 업무를 수행하지 않았다. 회수(recall)에 관한 문서화된 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department did not undertake all of the required activities. The written procedures for recalls were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control unit)가 연간 제품품질평가(annual product quality review) 결과를 평가하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department did not evaluate the results of the annual product quality review.

findings.text_ko: 신규 또는 개정된 표준작업지침서(SOP) 시행 전 작업자 교육이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The training of personnel before new or revised standard operating procedures were implemented was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 반품된 의약품의 재판매 검토에 관한 평가·문서화 및/또는 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment, documentation, and/or procedures for considering the resale of returned drugs were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control unit)가 요구되는 모든 업무를 수행하지 않았다. 회수(recall)에 관한 문서화된 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department did not undertake all of the required activities. The written procedures for recalls were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 반품된 의약품의 재판매 검토에 관한 평가·문서화 및/또는 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment, documentation, and/or procedures for considering the resale of returned drugs were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 신규 또는 개정된 표준작업지침서(SOP) 시행 전 작업자 교육이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The training of personnel before new or revised standard operating procedures were implemented was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 회수(recall)에 관한 문서화된 절차가 미흡했다. 품질관리부서(quality control unit)가 요구되는 모든 업무를 수행하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The written procedures for recalls were inadequate. The quality control department did not undertake all of the required activities.

findings.text_ko: 비위생적 상태를 방지하기 위한 세척 절차의 실행·효과성·밸리데이션(validation)이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation, effectiveness, and/or validation of the cleaning procedures was inadequate for preventing unsanitary conditions.

findings.text_ko: 시설이 오염을 방지하도록 설계·시공·운영·유지관리되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The premises were not designed, constructed, operated, and/or maintained to prevent contamination.

findings.text_ko: 작업자의 무균조작(aseptic) 실무가 무균성을 유지하기에 미흡했다. 제조공정·장비·자재에 대한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The operators'aseptic practices were inadequate to maintain sterility. Evaluation of production processes, equipment, and/or materials was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 전산화 시스템을 포함한 장비의 교정·점검·적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 정품 시험성적서(certificate of analysis)의 확보 또는 그 내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability or the content of the authentic certificate of analysis was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 시험실 데이터의 생성·유지·처리·검토가 미흡했다. 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고·후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The creation, maintenance, processing, and/or review of laboratory data was inadequate. Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 부유입자 및 미생물 한도가 초과되었을 때, 회사의 작업지침서에 조사 및 시정조치(CAPA) 실시가 규정되어 있지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: When the particulate and microbiological limits were exceeded, the company's operating procedures did not prescribe an investigation and implementation of corrective actions.

documents.firm_name: Jubilant Draximage Inc. dba Jubilant Radiopharma

findings.text_ko: 시약 및 배지(culture media)의 입고·조제 및/또는 취급이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The receipt, preparation, and/or handling of reagents and culture media was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 수입자가 의약품의 제조, 포장/표시 또는 시험에 이용한 해외 제조소가 Guidance on Evidence to Demonstrate Drug GMP Compliance of Foreign Sites (GUI-0080)에 기술된 요건을 충족하는지 확인하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The importer did not ensure that the foreign sites use to fabricate, package/label, or test drug products met the requirements described in Guidance on Evidence to Demonstrate Drug GMP Compliance of Foreign Sites (GUI-0080).

findings.text_ko: 업체가 멸균 전 모든 공정 중 오염을 최소화하기 위한 예방조치를 취하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The company did not take precautions to minimize contamination during all processing prior to sterilization.

findings.text_ko: 기록된 정보 또는 세부 내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The recorded information or details were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 청정구역(critical area) 내 미생물 오염에 대한 업체의 조사가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The company's investigations of microbial contamination in critical areas were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 보관 및/또는 운송 조건이 해당 의약품의 품질과 안전한 유통을 유지하도록 보장하는 데 지침 및/또는 절차가 미흡했다. 품질관리부서(quality control unit)가 결함 가능성이 있는 제품에 관한 불만에 대해 철저한 조사 및/또는 평가가 이루어지도록 하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The guidelines and/or procedures were inadequate in ensuring storage and/or transportation conditions would maintain the quality and safe distribution of the drug. The quality control department did not ensure a thorough investigation and/or evaluation of complaints concerning potentially defective products.

findings.text_ko: 원료의 입고 및 출하에 관한 표준작업지침서(SOP) 또는 기록이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The standard operating procedures or records for shipping and receiving raw materials were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control unit) 책임자의 품질관리 판정 사항을 문서화하기 위한 절차가 미흡했다. 기준에서 벗어난 경우 및/또는 제품이 허용범위 경계에 있는 경우에 대한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The procedure was inadequate for documenting quality control decisions by the person in charge of the quality control department. The evaluation was inadequate for cases where there was a deviation from the norm and/or where products were on the borderline of the acceptable range.

findings.text_ko: 업체가 기류 패턴(air-flow pattern)이 오염 위험을 초래하지 않음을 적절히 입증하지 못했다.
findings.text_orig: The company did not adequately demonstrate that air-flow patterns did not pose a risk of contamination.

findings.text_ko: 결함 가능성이 있는 제품에 관한 불만 및/또는 기타 정보의 평가·기록·후속조치 및/또는 조사가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment, recording, follow-up, and/or investigation of complaints and/or other information about potentially defective products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 해당 의약품에 대한 지속적 안정성시험(ongoing stability) 프로그램이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The ongoing stability program for a drug was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조지시서(master production documents)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The master production documents were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조, 포장 또는 표시 및/또는 시험에 대한 책임을 규정한 품질계약서(quality agreement)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The quality agreement outlining the responsibilities for fabricating, packaging or labelling, and/or testing was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 신규 또는 개정된 표준작업지침서(SOP) 시행 전 작업자 교육이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The training of personnel before new or revised standard operating procedures were implemented was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 문서화된 자체점검(self-inspection) 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The written self-inspection procedure was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 변경관리 시스템이 변경사항의 적절한 문서화·평가 및/또는 승인을 보장하기에 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control unit)가 요구되는 모든 업무를 수행하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department did not undertake all of the required activities.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)·보고 및/또는 후속조치에 대한 조사가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 오염을 방지하도록 건물·시설이 설계·건축·운영·유지관리되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The premises were not designed, constructed, operated, and/or maintained to prevent contamination.

findings.text_ko: 온도 및 습도 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The temperature and/or humidity control was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 의약품에 대한 지속적 안정성시험 프로그램(ongoing stability program)이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The ongoing stability program for a drug was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 문서화된 기준규격(specification)이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The written specifications were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 직원의 직무기술서, 직원에게 부여된 권한, 업무 위임이 미흡하거나 문서화되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The job descriptions for personnel, the authority given to personnel, and/or the delegation of duties was inadequate and/or undocumented.

findings.text_ko: 안정성시험 프로그램에 사용된 분석시험법에 대한 밸리데이션(validation)을 충분히 수행하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The company did not adequately validate the analytical test procedures used in the stability program.

findings.text_ko: 전산화시스템을 포함한 설비의 교정·점검·적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다. 의약품 오염을 방지하기에 설비의 설계·구조·운전·설치 위치가 미흡했다. 주요 제조공정·시험 작업에 사용되는 설비의 사용기록(usage log)이 미흡했다. 신뢰할 수 있는 용수 공급원을 확보하기에 정제수 설비의 운전이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate. The design, construction, operation, and/or location of the equipment was inadequate for preventing contamination of the drug. The usage logs for the equipment used for significant processing and/or testing operations were inadequate. The operation of the water purification equipment was inadequate for ensuring a reliable source of water.

findings.text_ko: 정식 시험성적서(certificate of analysis)의 보유 여부 또는 내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability or the content of the authentic certificate of analysis was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 시험실 데이터의 생성·유지·처리·검토가 미흡했다. 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고·후속조치가 미흡했다. 위생관리 프로그램(sanitation program)이 오염 위험을 파악하거나 저감하도록 적절히 설계되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The creation, maintenance, processing, and/or review of laboratory data was inadequate. Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate. The sanitation programs were not adequately designed to identify and/or reduce the risks of contamination.

findings.text_ko: 기준일탈(OOS) 시험결과의 조사·처리·보고가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The investigation, handling, and/or reporting of test results that were out-of-specification was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 연간 제품품질평가(annual product quality review) 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The annual product quality review procedure was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 추적성·판독성·문서화·서식·정확성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고·후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 각 공급업체에서 입고된 원료에 대해 완전한 확인시험을 실시하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: Complete confirmatory testing was not conducted on raw materials from each vendor.

findings.text_ko: 위생관리 프로그램(sanitation program)이 오염 위험을 파악하거나 저감하도록 적절히 설계되지 않았다. 비위생적 상태를 방지하기에 세척 절차의 실행·실효성·밸리데이션(validation)이 미흡했다. 다른 의약품 또는 이물에 의한 의약품 오염 가능성을 방지하도록 설비가 설치·설계·운전·보관·유지관리되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The sanitation programs were not adequately designed to identify and/or reduce the risks of contamination. The implementation, effectiveness, and/or validation of the cleaning procedures was inadequate for preventing unsanitary conditions. The equipment was not set-up, designed, operated, stored, and/or maintained to prevent potential contamination of drugs by other drugs and/or by foreign material.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control unit)가 로트 또는 배치의 재처리(reprocessing)·재작업(reworking)을 적절히 승인·평가·문서화하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department did not appropriately approve, assess, and/or document the reprocessing and/or reworking of a lot and/or batch.

findings.text_ko: 제조공정·설비·자재에 대한 평가가 미흡했다. 기록된 정보 또는 세부 내용이 미흡했다. 제조 마스터 문서(master production document)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Evaluation of production processes, equipment, and/or materials was inadequate. The recorded information or details were inadequate. The master production documents were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 측정기기의 정확도 및 정밀도를 정기적으로 점검하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: Measuring devices were not regularly checked for accuracy and precision.

findings.text_ko: 공급자·제조자·시험자·포장자·표시자·유통자·수입자·도매상 간 품질계약서(quality agreement)의 보유·내용·유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 회수(recall)에 대한 문서화된 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The written procedures for recalls were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 유틸리티 및 지원 설비에 대한 적격성평가(qualification) 및 검증이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The qualification and/or verification of utilities and/or support systems was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 원료 로트의 각 용기에 대해 내용물을 확인하기 위한 특이적·판별적 확인시험을 실시하지 않았다. 원료에 대한 검체채취 계획이 미흡했다. 원료 각 로트의 검체를 규격에 대해 전 항목 시험하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: Each container of a lot of raw materials was not tested to identify its contents with a specific, discriminating test. The sampling plan for raw materials was inadequate. A sample from each lot of raw materials was not fully tested against the specifications.

findings.text_ko: 설비의 예방정비 및 수리가 미흡했다. 컴퓨터화시스템을 포함한 설비의 교정·점검 및/또는 적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The preventative maintenance and repair of the equipment was inadequate. The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기준일탈(OOS) 시험결과의 조사·처리·보고가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The investigation, handling, and/or reporting of test results that were out-of-specification was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 생성·수정·검토·보관 및/또는 검색에 대한 통제가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The controls were inadequate for creating, modifying, reviewing, storing, and/or retrieving records.

findings.text_ko: 제조 및/또는 포장 중 의약품 및/또는 자재의 오염을 최소화하기에 작업소 및/또는 제조공정이 미흡했다. 작업소가 제품 간 교차오염 및/또는 혼동을 방지하기 위한 최적의 인원 및/또는 자재 동선으로 배치·설계되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The premises and/or the manufacturing process were inadequate for minimizing contamination of the drugs and/or materials during fabrication and/or packaging. The premises were not laid out and/or designed for an optimal flow of personnel and/or materials to prevent cross-contamination and/or mix-ups between products.

findings.text_ko: 비위생적 상태를 방지하기 위한 세척 절차의 실행·효과성 및/또는 밸리데이션(validation)이 미흡했다. 문서화된 위생관리 프로그램의 구비·실행 및/또는 그 수준이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation, effectiveness, and/or validation of the cleaning procedures was inadequate for preventing unsanitary conditions. The availability, implementation, and/or quality of the written sanitation program was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 생성·수정·검토·보관 및/또는 검색에 대한 통제가 미흡했다. 기록의 추적성·가독성·문서화·서식 및/또는 정확성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The controls were inadequate for creating, modifying, reviewing, storing, and/or retrieving records. The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: GMP에 대한 작업자 교육 및/또는 그 기록의 유지관리가 미흡했다. 신규 또는 개정된 표준작업지침서(SOP) 시행 전 작업자 교육이 미흡했다. 직원의 직무기술서, 직원에게 부여된 권한 및/또는 업무 위임이 미흡하거나 문서화되어 있지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The training of personnel in good manufacturing practices and/or the maintenance of records was inadequate. findings.text_ko: 기류 패턴이 오염 위험을 초래하지 않는다는 점을 회사가 충분히 입증하지 못했다.
findings.text_orig: The company did not adequately demonstrate that air-flow patterns did not pose a risk of contamination.

findings.text_ko: 환경 등급별 문서화된 복장 기준이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The written clothing standards for each environmental grade were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 무균공정(aseptic) 밸리데이션이 미흡했다. 무균공정 모의시험(aseptic process simulation)이 모든 일상 조작, 통상적 개입 및 최악 조건 상황을 포괄할 만큼 충분히 길게 수행되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The validation of aseptic processing was inadequate. The aseptic process simulation study was not long enough to cover all routine manipulations, normal interventions, and worst case situations.

findings.text_ko: 온도 및/또는 습도 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The temperature and/or humidity control was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 생성·수정·검토·보관·검색에 대한 통제가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The controls were inadequate for creating, modifying, reviewing, storing, and/or retrieving records.

findings.text_ko: 수입자가 의약품의 제조·포장/표시 또는 시험에 사용하는 해외 제조소가 Guidance on Evidence to Demonstrate Drug GMP Compliance of Foreign Sites (GUI-0080)에 기술된 요건을 충족하도록 보장하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The importer did not ensure that the foreign sites use to fabricate, package/label, or test drug products met the requirements described in Guidance on Evidence to Demonstrate Drug GMP Compliance of Foreign Sites (GUI-0080).

findings.text_ko: 의약품 각 로트 또는 배치의 운송 및/또는 보관 조건을 입증하는 데 사용된 근거자료가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The evidence used to demonstrate the transportation and/or storage conditions of each lot or batch of the drug was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조공정·설비 및 원자재에 대한 평가가 미흡했다. 공기 압력이 설정된 한도 미만으로 떨어졌을 때 경보 시스템이 작업자에게 경보를 발하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: Evaluation of production processes, equipment, and/or materials was inadequate. Warning systems did not alert personnel when air pressure fell below established limits.

findings.text_ko: 충전된 용기에 대한 회사의 육안검사가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The company's visual inspection of filled containers was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 시험실 데이터의 생성·유지·처리·검토가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The creation, maintenance, processing, and/or review of laboratory data was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 비위생적 상태를 방지하기 위한 위생관리 프로그램의 실행 및 효과성이 미흡했다. 비위생적 상태를 방지하기 위한 세척 절차의 실행·효과성·밸리데이션(validation)이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation and/or the effectiveness of the sanitation program in preventing unsanitary conditions was inadequate. The implementation, effectiveness, and/or validation of the cleaning procedures was inadequate for preventing unsanitary conditions.

findings.text_ko: 완제품 출하승인을 위한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment to release finished products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조 및 포장 과정에서 의약품·자재의 오염을 최소화하기에 시설 및 제조공정이 미흡했다. 시설이 해충 및 이물의 건물 내 유입을 방지하도록 설계·시공·유지관리되지 않았다. 시설이 제품 간 교차오염 및 혼동을 방지하기 위한 인원 및 자재의 최적 동선으로 배치·설계되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The premises and/or the manufacturing process were inadequate for minimizing contamination of the drugs and/or materials during fabrication and/or packaging. The premises were not designed, constructed, and/or maintained to prevent the entry of pests and/or foreign material into the building. The premises were not laid out and/or designed for an optimal flow of personnel and/or materials to prevent cross-contamination and/or mix-ups between products.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고·후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조공정·장비·자재에 대한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Evaluation of production processes, equipment, and/or materials was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기준일탈(OOS) 시험결과의 조사·처리·보고가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The investigation, handling, and/or reporting of test results that were out-of-specification was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록된 정보 또는 세부내용이 미흡했다. GMP 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The recorded information or details were inadequate. The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 불만사항 및 결함 가능성이 있는 제품에 관한 그 밖의 정보에 대한 평가·기록·후속조치·조사가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment, recording, follow-up, and/or investigation of complaints and/or other information about potentially defective products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 보관 및 운송 조건이 의약품의 품질과 안전한 유통을 유지하도록 보장하는 지침·절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The guidelines and/or procedures were inadequate in ensuring storage and/or transportation conditions would maintain the quality and safe distribution of the drug.

findings.text_ko: 전산화 시스템을 포함한 장비의 교정·점검·적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사, 보고 및 후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 건물·시설이 청소가 가능하도록, 그리고 이물이 축적되지 않도록 시공·유지관리되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The premises were not constructed and/or maintained to allow cleaning and/or prevent the accumulation of foreign material.

findings.text_ko: 총균수에 대한 검체채취, 시험 및 기준규격이 미흡했다. 사용 전 원료 및 포장재의 격리보관, 검체채취, 시험 및 사용승인이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The sampling, testing, and/or specifications for total microbial count were inadequate. The quarantine, sampling, testing, release of raw material, and/or the packaging materials prior to use were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 원료, 공정 중 의약품, 벌크 의약품 및 완제품 검체의 취급 및 보관이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The handling and/or storage of samples was inadequate for raw materials, drugs being processed, bulk drugs, and/or finished products.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 생성·수정·검토·보관·검색에 대한 통제가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The controls were inadequate for creating, modifying, reviewing, storing, and/or retrieving records.

findings.text_ko: GMP 관련 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 작업자에 대한 GMP 교육 및/또는 관련 기록의 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The training of personnel in good manufacturing practices and/or the maintenance of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 온도 및/또는 습도 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The temperature and/or humidity control was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 변경이 적절하게 문서화·평가·승인되도록 보장하기에 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 추적성·판독성·문서화·서식 및 정확성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 데이터 거버넌스 계획의 수립 및 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The establishment and/or the maintenance of a data governance plan was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 공급자·제조자·시험자·포장자·표시자·유통자·수입자 및/또는 도매상 간 품질계약(quality agreement)의 보유·내용·유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 시약 및 배지의 입고·조제·취급이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The receipt, preparation, and/or handling of reagents and culture media was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 환경 시료채취 방법이 미흡했다. 제조구역 또는 무균구역의 미생물 모니터링을 위한 시료채취 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The environmental sampling methods were inadequate. The sampling procedure was inadequate for microbiological monitoring in processing areas or aseptic areas.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고·후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 무균구역 또는 청정구역(clean area)의 입자 또는 미생물 오염을 최소화하기 위한 환경 기준이 미흡했다. 무균공정(aseptic)이 수행되는 구역에서 모니터링의 주기와 방법이 미흡했다. 무균성을 유지하기에 작업자의 무균조작(aseptic practice)이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The environmental standards were inadequate in order to minimise particular or microbial contamination of aseptic or clean areas. In areas where aseptic operations were performed, the frequency and the methods of monitoring were inadequate. The operators'aseptic practices were inadequate to maintain sterility.

findings.text_ko: 멸균기의 적재(loading) 방식에 대한 밸리데이션(validation)을 충분히 수행하지 않았다. 습열멸균(moist heat sterilization)에 대한 회사의 밸리데이션(validation)이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The company did not adequately validate how the sterilizer was loaded. The company's validation of moist heat sterilization was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기류 패턴(air-flow pattern)이 오염 위험을 초래하지 않는다는 점을 회사가 충분히 입증하지 못했다.
findings.text_orig: The company did not adequately demonstrate that air-flow patterns did not pose a risk of contamination.

findings.text_ko: 청정구역(clean area)에 대한 문서화된 위생관리 프로그램(sanitation program)이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The written sanitation program for clean areas was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 컴퓨터화시스템을 포함한 설비의 교정·점검 및/또는 적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 무균시험(sterility testing)을 위해 채취한 검체가 전체 배치를 대표하지 못했다.
findings.text_orig: The samples taken for sterility testing were not representative of the whole batch.

findings.text_ko: 충전된 용기에 대한 업체의 육안검사가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The company's visual inspection of filled containers was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 작업자의 무균조작(aseptic) 관행이 무균상태를 유지하기에 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The operators'aseptic practices were inadequate to maintain sterility.

findings.text_ko: 연간제품품질평가(annual product quality review) 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The annual product quality review procedure was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 완제품 출하 판정을 위한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment to release finished products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 변경이 적절하게 문서화·평가·승인되도록 보장하기에 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 제조공정·설비 및 원자재에 대한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Evaluation of production processes, equipment, and/or materials was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 신규 또는 개정된 표준작업지침서(SOP) 시행 전 작업자 교육이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The training of personnel before new or revised standard operating procedures were implemented was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 문서화된 위생관리 프로그램의 보유·실행 및 그 수준이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, implementation, and/or quality of the written sanitation program was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 변경이 적절히 문서화·평가·승인되도록 보장하기 위한 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 위생관리 프로그램의 세척 절차, 세척 주기, 폐기물 처리 절차 및 방충·방서 조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The sanitation program was inadequate in its cleaning procedures, frequency of cleaning, procedures for waste disposal, and/or pest control measures.

findings.text_ko: 온도 및 습도 관리가 미흡했다. 의약품의 품질과 안전한 유통을 유지할 수 있도록 보관 및 운송 조건을 보장하기 위한 지침과 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The temperature and/or humidity control was inadequate. The guidelines and/or procedures were inadequate in ensuring storage and/or transportation conditions would maintain the quality and safe distribution of the drug.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사, 보고 및 후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 원료 공급업체와 의약품 제조자 간 문서화된 계약의 구비 및 내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability and/or the content of the written agreement between the raw material vendor and the drug fabricator was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서가 로트 또는 배치의 재처리(reprocessing) 및 재작업(reworking)을 적절히 승인·평가·문서화하지 않았다. 새로운 배치번호가 부여되지 않았거나, 해당 의약품의 재밸리데이션 필요 여부를 판단하기 위한 평가가 수행되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department did not appropriately approve, assess, and/or document the reprocessing and/or reworking of a lot and/or batch. No new batch number was assigned and/or an assessment was not done to determine whether the drug needed to be revalidated.

findings.text_ko: 전자시스템이 의도된 용도에 대해 밸리데이션(validation)되지 않았다. 전자서명에 대해 마련된 통제가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The electronic system was not validated for its intended use. The controls put in place for electronic signatures were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 컴퓨터화 시스템을 포함한 설비의 교정, 점검 및 적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_orig: The quality control department did not undertake all of the required activities.

findings.text_ko: 제조공정, 설비 및 자재에 대한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Evaluation of production processes, equipment, and/or materials was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 의약품의 품질과 안전한 유통을 유지할 수 있도록 보관 및 운송 조건을 보장하기 위한 지침과 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The guidelines and/or procedures were inadequate in ensuring storage and/or transportation conditions would maintain the quality and safe distribution of the drug.

findings.text_ko: 기준일탈(OOS) 시험결과의 조사·처리·보고가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The investigation, handling, and/or reporting of test results that were out-of-specification was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 회사가 의약품, 원료 및 주성분(active ingredient)의 각 로트 또는 배치 검체를 적절한 조건에서 보관하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The company did not store a sample from each lot or batch of a drug, raw material, and/or an active ingredient under the proper conditions.

findings.text_ko: 시험실 데이터의 생성·유지·처리·검토가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The creation, maintenance, processing, and/or review of laboratory data was inadequate.

findings.text_orig: The quality control department's release of packaging materials for use in packaging or labelling was inadequate.

findings.text_orig: The investigation, handling, and/or reporting of test results that were out-of-specification was inadequate.

findings.text_orig: The quality control department did not evaluate the results of the annual product quality review.

findings.text_ko: 직원에 대한 GMP 교육훈련 및 그 기록의 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The training of personnel in good manufacturing practices and/or the maintenance of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 추적성·판독성·문서화·서식·정확성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 연간제품품질평가(annual product quality review) 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The annual product quality review procedure was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 변경사항이 적절히 문서화·평가·승인되도록 보장하는 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 잠재적 결함 제품에 관한 불만 및/또는 기타 정보의 평가·기록·후속조치·조사가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment, recording, follow-up, and/or investigation of complaints and/or other information about potentially defective products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 문서화된 규격(specification)이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The written specifications were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 완제품 출하 판정을 위한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment to release finished products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기준일탈(OOS)·경계치(borderline)·경향일탈(out-of-trend)에 해당하는 안정성시험 결과에 대해 결과를 평가하지 않았거나 시정조치(CAPA)를 취하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The company did not assess the results and/or take corrective actions for stability testing results that were out-of-specification, borderline, or out-of-trend .

findings.text_ko: 컴퓨터화시스템을 포함한 설비의 교정·점검·적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 공급자·제조자·시험자·포장자·표시자·유통자·수입자 및/또는 도매상 간 품질계약(quality agreement)의 보유·내용·유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기준일탈(OOS) 시험결과의 조사·처리·보고가 미흡했다. 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고 및 후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The investigation, handling, and/or reporting of test results that were out-of-specification was inadequate. Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 보관 및 운송 조건이 의약품의 품질과 안전한 유통을 유지하도록 보장하기에 지침 및 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The guidelines and/or procedures were inadequate in ensuring storage and/or transportation conditions would maintain the quality and safe distribution of the drug.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고 및 후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 정품 시험성적서(certificate of analysis)의 보유 또는 그 내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability or the content of the authentic certificate of analysis was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 전자서명에 대해 마련된 통제가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The controls put in place for electronic signatures were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control unit)의 불만 및 의약품 품질 관련 접수 정보 처리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department's handling of complaints and/or information received about drug quality was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 마스터 제조문서가 미흡했다. 문서가 공용어 중 하나로 작성되어 있지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The master production documents were inadequate. Documents were not available in one of the official languages.

findings.text_ko: 수입 제품에 대해, 해외 제조소에서 수행한 안정성시험이 캐나다 GMP 및/또는 캐나다 품목허가 사항에 부합하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: For imported products, the stability studies from foreign sites were not compliant with Canadian good manufacturing practices and/or Canadian marketing authorization.

findings.text_ko: 회수(recall)에 관한 문서화된 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The written procedures for recalls were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 변경이 적절하게 문서화·평가·승인되도록 보장하기에 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control unit) 책임자의 학력·경력·감독이 미흡했다. 직원의 직무기술서, 직원에게 부여된 권한, 업무 위임이 미흡하거나 문서화되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The education, experience, and/or oversight of the individual in charge of the quality control department was inadequate. The job descriptions for personnel, the authority given to personnel, and/or the delegation of duties was inadequate and/or undocumented.

findings.text_ko: 완제품 규격에의 적합성을 입증하는 데 요구되는 증빙자료가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The evidence required to demonstrate compliance with finished product specifications was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 불만사항 및 결함 가능성이 있는 제품에 관한 그 밖의 정보에 대한 평가·기록·후속조치·조사가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment, recording, follow-up, and/or investigation of complaints and/or other information about potentially defective products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 캐나다 반입 전 또는 반입 후 검체에 대해 실시한 확인시험이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The confirmatory tests conducted on samples before or after they were received in Canada were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 해당 작업소에 문서가 비치되어 있지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: Documents were not available on the premises.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 생성·수정·검토·보관·검색에 대한 통제가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The controls were inadequate for creating, modifying, reviewing, storing, and/or retrieving records.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control unit)가 요구되는 모든 업무를 수행하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department did not undertake all of the required activities.

findings.text_ko: 의약품에 대한 지속적 안정성시험(ongoing stability) 프로그램이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The ongoing stability program for a drug was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조공정, 설비 및/또는 원자재에 대한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Evaluation of production processes, equipment, and/or materials was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 작업소가 오염을 방지하도록 설계·시공·운영 및/또는 유지관리되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The premises were not designed, constructed, operated, and/or maintained to prevent contamination.

findings.text_ko: 컴퓨터화시스템을 포함한 설비의 교정·점검 및/또는 적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 업체는 안정성시험 프로그램에 사용된 분석시험법을 적절히 밸리데이션(validation)하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The company did not adequately validate the analytical test procedures used in the stability program.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 추적성·가독성·문서화·서식 및/또는 정확성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 문서화된 위생관리 프로그램의 구비·실행 및/또는 수준이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, implementation, and/or quality of the written sanitation program was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조구역 출입이 지정된 인원으로만 제한되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The production areas were not restricted to designated staff only.

findings.text_ko: 온도 및/또는 습도 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The temperature and/or humidity control was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 변경사항의 적절한 문서화·평가·승인을 보장하기에 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 시험실 데이터의 생성·유지·처리 및/또는 검토가 미흡했다. 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고·후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The creation, maintenance, processing, and/or review of laboratory data was inadequate. Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서가 요구되는 업무를 모두 수행하지 않았다. 품질경영시스템의 실효성을 실행·유지·개선하기 위해 적절하고 충분한 자원을 결정·제공하는 경영진의 역량이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department did not undertake all of the required activities. Senior management's ability to determine and/or provide adequate and/or appropriate resources to implement, maintain and/or improve the effectiveness of the quality management system was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 자체점검(self-inspection) 프로그램의 실행이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation of a self-inspection program was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 생성·수정·검토·보관·검색에 대한 통제가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The controls were inadequate for creating, modifying, reviewing, storing, and/or retrieving records.

findings.text_ko: 반품된 의약품의 재판매 검토에 대한 평가·문서화·절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment, documentation, and/or procedures for considering the resale of returned drugs were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 변경사항이 적절히 문서화·평가·승인되도록 보장하는 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 보관 및 운송 조건이 의약품의 품질과 안전한 유통을 유지하도록 보장하는 지침·절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The guidelines and/or procedures were inadequate in ensuring storage and/or transportation conditions would maintain the quality and safe distribution of the drug.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고·후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 직원에 대한 지속적 교육훈련이 미흡했다. 직원의 직무기술서, 직원에게 부여된 권한, 업무 위임이 미흡하거나 문서화되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The ongoing training of personnel was inadequate. The job descriptions for personnel, the authority given to personnel, and/or the delegation of duties was inadequate and/or undocumented.

findings.text_ko: 온도 및 습도 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The temperature and/or humidity control was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 데이터 거버넌스(data governance) 계획의 수립 및/또는 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The establishment and/or the maintenance of a data governance plan was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 업체의 용수 시험 모니터링이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The company's monitoring of water testing was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 공정구역 또는 무균(aseptic)구역의 미생물 모니터링을 위한 검체채취 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The sampling procedure was inadequate for microbiological monitoring in processing areas or aseptic areas.

findings.text_ko: 수입자는 의약품의 제조, 포장/표시 또는 시험에 사용되는 해외 제조소가 Guidance on Evidence to Demonstrate Drug GMP Compliance of Foreign Sites (GUI-0080)에 기술된 요건을 충족하는지 확인하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The importer did not ensure that the foreign sites use to fabricate, package/label, or test drug products met the requirements described in Guidance on Evidence to Demonstrate Drug GMP Compliance of Foreign Sites (GUI-0080).

findings.text_ko: 컴퓨터화시스템을 포함한 설비의 교정·점검 및/또는 적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 작업자에 대한 건강진단(채용 전 및/또는 정기)이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The health examinations of personnel (pre-employment and/or ongoing) were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 위생관리 프로그램이 오염 위험을 파악하거나 저감하도록 적절히 설계되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The sanitation programs were not adequately designed to identify and/or reduce the risks of contamination.

findings.text_ko: 제균필터(sterilizing filter) 완전성시험에 대한 문서화가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The documentation for the integrity testing of sterilizing filters was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 원자재, 벌크 용기, 주요 설비 및/또는 작업실이 적절히 식별 표시되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: Materials, bulk containers, major items of equipment, and/or the rooms were not properly identified.

findings.text_ko: 원료 로트의 각 용기에 대해 내용물을 확인하는 특이적·판별적 시험을 실시하지 않았다. 각 공급업체에서 입고된 원료에 대한 전항목 확인시험을 실시하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: Each container of a lot of raw materials was not tested to identify its contents with a specific, discriminating test. Complete confirmatory testing was not conducted on raw materials from each vendor.

findings.text_ko: 제조공정, 설비 및/또는 원자재에 대한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Evaluation of production processes, equipment, and/or materials was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 보관 및/또는 운송 조건이 의약품의 품질과 안전한 유통을 유지하도록 보장하는 지침 및/또는 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The guidelines and/or procedures were inadequate in ensuring storage and/or transportation conditions would maintain the quality and safe distribution of the drug.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control unit)가 로트 및/또는 배치의 재처리(reprocessing) 및/또는 재작업(rework)을 적절히 승인·평가·문서화하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department did not appropriately approve, assess, and/or document the reprocessing and/or reworking of a lot and/or batch.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사, 보고 및 후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 연간제품품질평가(annual product quality review) 절차가 미흡했다. 품질관리부서가 연간제품품질평가 결과를 평가하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The annual product quality review procedure was inadequate. The quality control department did not evaluate the results of the annual product quality review.

findings.text_ko: 의약품의 계속 안정성시험(ongoing stability) 프로그램이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The ongoing stability program for a drug was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 완제품 기준규격 적합성을 입증하는 데 요구되는 증빙자료가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The evidence required to demonstrate compliance with finished product specifications was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 문서화된 위생관리 프로그램이 작업자 및/또는 방문자에 대한 복장 요건과 위생 절차를 명확히 규정하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The written hygiene program did not clearly define clothing requirements and/or hygiene procedures for personnel and/or visitors.

findings.text_ko: 설비의 예방정비 및 수리가 미흡했다. 컴퓨터화시스템을 포함한 설비의 교정·점검·적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The preventative maintenance and repair of the equipment was inadequate. The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 추적성·가독성·문서화·서식 및/또는 정확성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 시약 및 배지(culture media)의 입고·조제 및/또는 취급이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The receipt, preparation, and/or handling of reagents and culture media was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control unit)가 요구되는 모든 업무를 수행하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department did not undertake all of the required activities.

findings.text_ko: 미생물 및/또는 환경 조건에 대한 모니터링 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The monitoring procedures for microbial and/or environmental conditions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기준일탈(OOS) 시험결과의 조사·처리·보고가 미흡했다. 통상적 수준과 다른 의약품 배치에 대한 경향분석이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The investigation, handling, and/or reporting of test results that were out-of-specification was inadequate. The analysis of trends for batches of drugs that differed from the norm was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고·후속조치가 미흡했다. 불만 및 결함 가능성이 있는 제품에 관한 그 밖의 정보에 대한 평가·기록·후속조치·조사가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate. The assessment, recording, follow-up, and/or investigation of complaints and/or other information about potentially defective products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 효과적인 세척, 위생적 상태 및/또는 의약품 오염 방지가 가능하도록 설계·시공 및/또는 유지관리되지 않은 작업소에서 의약품을 제조·포장·표시 및/또는 보관했다.
findings.text_orig: The drug was fabricated, packaged, labelled, and/or stored in premises that were not designed, constructed, and/or maintained to allow for effective cleaning, sanitary conditions, and/or the prevention of drug contamination.

findings.text_ko: 위생관리 프로그램이 오염 위험을 파악하거나 저감하도록 적절히 설계되지 않았다. 비위생적 상태를 방지하기 위한 세척 절차의 실행·유효성 및/또는 밸리데이션(validation)이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The sanitation programs were not adequately designed to identify and/or reduce the risks of contamination. The implementation, effectiveness, and/or validation of the cleaning procedures was inadequate for preventing unsanitary conditions.

findings.text_ko: 완제품 규격에의 적합성을 입증하는 데 요구되는 증빙자료가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The evidence required to demonstrate compliance with finished product specifications was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 포장 후 및 수입자 시설에 입고된 후 각 의약품 배치(batch)에 대한 확인(positive identification)이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The positive identification of each batch of drug after the packaging and/or after it was received on the importer's premises was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조·포장·표시·필수시험·보관·유통 및 각각의 조건에 관한 증빙자료의 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The maintenance of evidence was inadequate for manufacturing, packaging, labelling, required testing, storage, and/or distribution, including the respective conditions.

findings.text_ko: 정품 시험성적서(certificate of analysis)의 확보 또는 그 내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability or the content of the authentic certificate of analysis was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 연간제품품질평가(annual product quality review) 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The annual product quality review procedure was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 수입자는 의약품의 제조, 포장/표시 또는 시험에 사용하는 해외 제조소가 Guidance on Evidence to Demonstrate Drug GMP Compliance of Foreign Sites (GUI-0080)에 기술된 요건을 충족하는지 확인하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The importer did not ensure that the foreign sites use to fabricate, package/label, or test drug products met the requirements described in Guidance on Evidence to Demonstrate Drug GMP Compliance of Foreign Sites (GUI-0080).

findings.text_ko: 작업소가 청결하고 정돈된 상태를 유지할 수 있도록 설계·시공·운영 및/또는 유지관리되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The premises were not designed, constructed, operated, and/or maintained to allow clean and orderly conditions.

findings.text_ko: GMP 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 변경사항의 적절한 문서화·평가·승인을 보장하기에 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 추적성·가독성·문서화·서식 및/또는 정확성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 업체가 기류 패턴이 오염 위험을 초래하지 않는다는 점을 충분히 입증하지 못했다.
findings.text_orig: The company did not adequately demonstrate that air-flow patterns did not pose a risk of contamination.

findings.text_ko: 비위생적 상태를 방지하기 위한 위생관리 프로그램(sanitation program)의 실행 및/또는 유효성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation and/or the effectiveness of the sanitation program in preventing unsanitary conditions was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사, 보고 및/또는 후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 업체가 교육훈련의 유효성을 평가하지 않았다. 인력의 직무기술서, 인력에 부여된 권한 및/또는 업무 위임이 미흡하거나 문서화되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The effectiveness of the training was not assessed by the firm. The job descriptions for personnel, the authority given to personnel, and/or the delegation of duties was inadequate and/or undocumented.

findings.text_ko: 건물·시설이 해충 및/또는 이물의 건물 내 유입을 방지하도록 설계, 시공 및/또는 유지관리되지 않았다. 건물·시설이 오염을 방지하도록 설계, 시공, 운영 및/또는 유지관리되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The premises were not designed, constructed, and/or maintained to prevent the entry of pests and/or foreign material into the building. The premises were not designed, constructed, operated, and/or maintained to prevent contamination.

findings.text_ko: 진본 시험성적서(certificate of analysis)의 구비 또는 내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability or the content of the authentic certificate of analysis was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 시험방법이 밸리데이션(validation)되지 않았거나 그 결과가 문서화되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The test methods were not validated and/or the results were not documented.

findings.text_ko: 위생관리 프로그램의 청소 절차, 청소 주기, 폐기물 처리 절차 및/또는 방충·방서 대책이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The sanitation program was inadequate in its cleaning procedures, frequency of cleaning, procedures for waste disposal, and/or pest control measures.

findings.text_ko: 회수(recall)에 관한 문서화된 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The written procedures for recalls were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 컴퓨터화시스템을 포함한 설비의 교정, 점검 및/또는 적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 설비가 다른 의약품 및/또는 이물에 의한 의약품 오염 가능성을 방지하도록 설치, 설계, 운전, 보관 및/또는 유지관리되지 않았다. 주요 제조 및/또는 시험 작업에 사용된 설비의 사용기록이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The equipment was not set-up, designed, operated, stored, and/or maintained to prevent potential contamination of drugs by other drugs and/or by foreign material. The usage logs for the equipment used for significant processing and/or testing operations were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 공급자, 제조자, 시험자, 포장자, 표시자, 유통업자, 수입자 및/또는 도매상 간 품질계약서(quality agreement)의 구비, 내용 및/또는 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 포장재에 대한 규격이 불완전하거나 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The specifications for any packaging materials were incomplete or inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 자체점검(self-inspection) 프로그램의 실행이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation of a self-inspection program was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 회수(recall)에 대한 문서화된 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The written procedures for recalls were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기준일탈(OOS) 시험결과의 조사·처리·보고가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The investigation, handling, and/or reporting of test results that were out-of-specification was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 비위생적 상태를 방지하기 위한 위생관리 프로그램의 실행 및 실효성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation and/or the effectiveness of the sanitation program in preventing unsanitary conditions was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 자재, 벌크 용기, 주요 설비 및 작업실이 적절히 식별·표시되지 않았다. 제품 및 자재의 오염 방지가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Materials, bulk containers, major items of equipment, and/or the rooms were not properly identified. The protection of products and/or materials from contamination was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사, 보고 및 후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 의약품 안정성시험의 설계가 미흡했고 문서화된 근거로 정당화되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The design of the drug stability study was inadequate and/or not justified with a documented rationale.

findings.text_ko: 컴퓨터화 시스템을 포함한 설비의 교정, 점검 및 적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 원료 공급업체 인증 없이 원료에 대한 재시험 축소 프로그램을 운영했다.
findings.text_orig: A reduced retesting program for raw materials was in place without the raw material vendor certification.

findings.text_ko: 원료, 포장재, 표시기재, 완제품 및 재가공 중인 제품에 대한 품질관리부서의 승인이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department's approval was inadequate for raw materials, packaging materials, labelling, finished products, and/or products being reprocessed.

findings.text_ko: 제조공정, 설비 및 자재에 대한 평가가 미흡했다. 기록된 정보 또는 세부내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Evaluation of production processes, equipment, and/or materials was inadequate. The recorded information or details were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 위생관리 프로그램이 오염 위험을 파악하고 저감하도록 적절히 설계되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The sanitation programs were not adequately designed to identify and/or reduce the risks of contamination.

findings.text_ko: 직원에 대한 GMP 교육 및 그 기록의 관리가 미흡했다. 직원의 직무기술서, 직원에게 부여된 권한 및 업무 위임이 미흡하거나 문서화되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The training of personnel in good manufacturing practices and/or the maintenance of records was inadequate. The job descriptions for personnel, the authority given to personnel, and/or the delegation of duties was inadequate and/or undocumented.

findings.text_ko: 시험실 데이터의 생성·유지·처리·검토가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The creation, maintenance, processing, and/or review of laboratory data was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 위생관리 프로그램의 세척 절차, 세척 주기, 폐기물 처리 절차 및 방충·방서 조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The sanitation program was inadequate in its cleaning procedures, frequency of cleaning, procedures for waste disposal, and/or pest control measures.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 추적성·가독성·문서화·서식·정확성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 무균구역 또는 청정구역의 미립자 또는 미생물 오염을 최소화하기 위한 환경 기준이 미흡했다. 무균조작이 수행되는 구역에서 모니터링 주기와 방법이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The environmental standards were inadequate in order to minimise particular or microbial contamination of aseptic or clean areas. In areas where aseptic operations were performed, the frequency and the methods of monitoring were inadequate.

findings.text_orig: The investigation, handling, and/or reporting of test results that were out-of-specification was inadequate. Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.
