findings.text_ko: 불만 및 결함 가능성이 있는 제품에 관한 그 밖의 정보에 대한 평가·기록·후속조치·조사가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment, recording, follow-up, and/or investigation of complaints and/or other information about potentially defective products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 설비가 다른 의약품 및/또는 이물에 의한 의약품 오염 가능성을 방지하도록 설치·설계·운영·보관 및/또는 유지관리되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The equipment was not set-up, designed, operated, stored, and/or maintained to prevent potential contamination of drugs by other drugs and/or by foreign material.

findings.text_ko: 컴퓨터화 시스템을 포함한 설비의 교정, 점검 및/또는 적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 주요 제조공정 및/또는 시험 작업에 사용되는 설비에 대한 예방정비 프로그램이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The preventative maintenance program was inadequate for the equipment used in significant processing and/or testing operations.

findings.text_ko: 주요 제조공정 및/또는 시험 작업에 사용되는 설비의 사용기록(usage log)이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The usage logs for the equipment used for significant processing and/or testing operations were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 격리(quarantine) 구역에 대한 통제가 미흡했다. 품질관리부서(quality control department) 책임자의 업무가 자격을 갖추지 못한 인원에게 위임됐다.
findings.text_orig: The control of quarantine areas was inadequate. The duties of the individual in charge of the quality control department were delegated to an unqualified individual.

findings.text_ko: 전자시스템이 의도된 용도에 대해 밸리데이션(validation)되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The electronic system was not validated for its intended use.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control department) 책임자가 시행 전에 제조·포장·표시·시험·보관 및/또는 운송 방법과 절차를 검토·승인하는 것이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The examination and/or approval of fabrication, packaging, labelling, testing, storage, and/or the transportation method and procedures by the person in charge of the quality control department before implementation was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 미생물 및/또는 환경 조건에 대한 모니터링 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The monitoring procedures for microbial and/or environmental conditions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 비위생적 상태를 방지하기 위한 위생관리 프로그램(sanitation program)의 실행 및/또는 유효성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation and/or the effectiveness of the sanitation program in preventing unsanitary conditions was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control unit)가 요구되는 활동을 모두 수행하지 않았다. 시험방법의 밸리데이션(validation) 및/또는 문서화가 미흡했다. 기록의 추적성, 가독성, 문서화, 서식 및/또는 정확성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department did not undertake all of the required activities. The validation and/or the documentation of test methods was inadequate. The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 보관 및/또는 운송 조건이 의약품의 품질과 안전한 유통을 유지하도록 보장하는 지침 및/또는 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The guidelines and/or procedures were inadequate in ensuring storage and/or transportation conditions would maintain the quality and safe distribution of the drug.

findings.text_ko: 기준일탈(OOS) 시험결과의 조사·처리·보고가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The investigation, handling, and/or reporting of test results that were out-of-specification was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 작업자에 대한 지속적인 교육훈련이 미흡했다. 업체가 교육훈련의 유효성을 평가하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The ongoing training of personnel was inadequate. The effectiveness of the training was not assessed by the firm.

findings.text_ko: 업체의 용수 시험 모니터링이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The company's monitoring of water testing was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 시험방법의 밸리데이션(validation) 및/또는 문서화가 미흡했다. 변경이 적절히 문서화·평가·승인되도록 보장하는 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The validation and/or the documentation of test methods was inadequate. The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 원자재 각 로트에서 채취한 검체를 규격에 대해 전항목 시험하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: A sample from each lot of raw materials was not fully tested against the specifications.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control unit)가 요구되는 활동을 모두 수행하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department did not undertake all of the required activities.

findings.text_ko: 건물·시설의 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The maintenance of the premises was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 시험실 데이터의 생성, 유지, 처리 및/또는 검토가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The creation, maintenance, processing, and/or review of laboratory data was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록된 정보 또는 세부 내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The recorded information or details were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 추적성, 가독성, 문서화, 서식 및/또는 정확성이 미흡했다. 기록의 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate. The maintenance of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질경영시스템의 유효성을 실행·유지 및/또는 개선하기 위해 충분하고 적절한 자원을 결정 및/또는 제공하는 최고경영진의 역량이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Senior management's ability to determine and/or provide adequate and/or appropriate resources to implement, maintain and/or improve the effectiveness of the quality management system was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 온도 및/또는 습도 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The temperature and/or humidity control was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 건물·시설이 오염을 방지하도록 설계, 시공, 운영 및/또는 유지관리되지 않았다. 건물·시설의 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The premises were not designed, constructed, operated, and/or maintained to prevent contamination. The maintenance of the premises was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 변경이 적절히 문서화·평가·승인되도록 보장하는 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 기록된 정보 또는 세부 내용이 미흡했다. 완제품 출하 판정을 위한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The recorded information or details were inadequate. The assessment to release finished products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 시험실 데이터의 생성, 유지, 처리 및/또는 검토가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The creation, maintenance, processing, and/or review of laboratory data was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조공정, 설비 및/또는 원자재에 대한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Evaluation of production processes, equipment, and/or materials was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 해당 의약품에 대한 지속적 안정성시험 프로그램(ongoing stability)이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The ongoing stability program for a drug was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 문서화된 위생관리 프로그램의 구비, 실행 및/또는 수준이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, implementation, and/or quality of the written sanitation program was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 적격한 인력이 의약품의 제조, 포장, 표시, 시험 및/또는 보관을 적절히 감독하지 않았다. 필요한 자격 및/또는 현장 경험을 갖춘 인력의 수가 부족했다. 품질관리부서(quality control unit) 책임자의 업무가 자격을 갖추지 못한 자에게 위임됐다. 품질관리부서 책임자의 학력, 경력 및/또는 감독이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Qualified personnel did not adequately supervise the fabrication, packaging, labelling, testing, and/or storage of drugs. The number of personnel with the necessary qualifications and/or on-site experience was inadequate. The duties of the individual in charge of the quality control department were delegated to an unqualified individual. The education, experience, and/or oversight of the individual in charge of the quality control department was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 컴퓨터화시스템을 포함한 설비의 교정, 점검 및/또는 적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질경영시스템의 실행 및/또는 유지관리가 미흡했다. 품질관리부서(quality control unit)가 GMP 문서 및/또는 표준작업지침서(SOP)를 승인, 서명 및/또는 일자 기재하지 않았다. 기록의 생성·수정·검토·보관·검색에 대한 통제가 미흡했다. 우수의약품 제조·품질관리기준(GMP) 관련 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다. 시행 전 품질관리부서 책임자에 의한 제조, 포장, 표시, 시험, 보관 및/또는 운송 방법·절차의 검토 및/또는 승인이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation and/or maintenance of the quality management system was inadequate. The quality control department did not approve, sign, and/or date the good manufacturing practices documents and/or the standard operating procedures. The controls were inadequate for creating, modifying, reviewing, storing, and/or retrieving records. The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate. The examination and/or approval of fabrication, packaging, labelling, testing, storage, and/or the transportation method and procedures by the person in charge of the quality control department before implementation was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 보관 및/또는 운송 조건이 의약품의 품질과 안전한 유통을 유지하도록 보장하는 지침 및/또는 절차가 미흡했다. 온도 및/또는 습도 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The guidelines and/or procedures were inadequate in ensuring storage and/or transportation conditions would maintain the quality and safe distribution of the drug. The temperature and/or humidity control was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: "The maintenance of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 연간 제품품질평가(annual product quality review) 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The annual product quality review procedure was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 건물·시설이 제조구역을 적절히 격리·구획하도록 배치 및/또는 설계되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The premises were not laid out and/or designed to ensure that production areas were adequately isolated and segregated.

findings.text_ko: 필요한 자격 및/또는 현장 경험을 갖춘 인력의 수가 부족했다. 품질관리부서(quality control unit) 책임자의 업무가 자격을 갖추지 못한 자에게 위임됐다. 작업자에 대한 GMP 교육훈련 및/또는 그 기록의 유지관리가 미흡했다. 인사기록의 유지관리가 미흡했다. 업체가 교육훈련의 유효성을 평가하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The number of personnel with the necessary qualifications and/or on-site experience was inadequate. The duties of the individual in charge of the quality control department were delegated to an unqualified individual. The training of personnel in good manufacturing practices and/or the maintenance of records was inadequate. The maintenance of personnel records was inadequate. The effectiveness of the training was not assessed by the firm.

findings.text_ko: 공급자, 제조자, 시험자, 포장자, 표시자, 유통업자, 수입자 및/또는 도매상 간 품질계약서(quality agreement)의 구비, 내용 및/또는 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 온도 및/또는 습도 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The temperature and/or humidity control was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 의약품에 대한 지속적 안정성시험(ongoing stability) 프로그램이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The ongoing stability program for a drug was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: GMP 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control unit)가 독립적으로 기능하고 다른 어떤 부서와도 독립적으로 경영진에 보고하는 별도의 조직이 아니었다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department was not a distinct unit that functioned independently and reported to management independent of any other unit.

findings.text_ko: 시험실 데이터의 생성, 유지관리, 처리 및/또는 검토가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The creation, maintenance, processing, and/or review of laboratory data was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 변경사항의 적절한 문서화·평가·승인을 보장하기에 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 시험실 데이터의 생성, 유지관리, 처리 및/또는 검토가 미흡했다. 기록의 추적성, 가독성, 문서화, 서식 및/또는 정확성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The creation, maintenance, processing, and/or review of laboratory data was inadequate. The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 시약 및 배지의 입고, 조제 및/또는 취급이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The receipt, preparation, and/or handling of reagents and culture media was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 컴퓨터화 시스템을 포함한 설비의 교정, 점검 및/또는 적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 의약품 각 로트 또는 배치의 운송 및/또는 보관 조건을 입증하는 데 사용된 증빙이 미흡했다. 컴퓨터화시스템을 포함한 설비의 교정, 점검 및/또는 적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다. 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사, 보고 및/또는 후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The evidence used to demonstrate the transportation and/or storage conditions of each lot or batch of the drug was inadequate. The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate. Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 추적성, 가독성, 문서화, 서식 및/또는 정확성이 미흡했다. 문서가 현장에 비치되어 있지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate. Documents were not available on the premises.

findings.text_ko: 원자재, 포장재, 중간제품, 벌크의약품 및/또는 완제품의 구획 보관, 재고 순환(rotation of stock) 및/또는 운송이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The segregation, rotation of stock, and/or the transportation of raw materials, packaging materials, intermediates, bulk drugs, and/or finished products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 회수(recall)에 관한 문서화된 절차가 미흡했다. 회수 지원을 위해 제품 재고 및 유통기록을 관리하는 데 사용되는 컴퓨터화시스템이 밸리데이션(validation)되지 않았다. 회수에 관한 수입자, 유통업자 및/또는 도매상 각각의 책임을 규정한 서면 계약이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The written procedures for recalls were inadequate. The computerized system used to manage product inventory and distribution records to support recalls was not validated. The written agreement outlining the respective responsibilities of the importer, distributor, and/or wholesaler for recalls was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 업체의 가열멸균(heat sterilization) 사이클 모니터링 및 문서화가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The company's monitoring and documentation of heat sterilization cycles was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사, 보고 및/또는 후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록된 정보 또는 세부 내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The recorded information or details were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조구역 또는 무균구역(aseptic area)의 미생물 모니터링을 위한 검체채취 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The sampling procedure was inadequate for microbiological monitoring in processing areas or aseptic areas.

findings.text_ko: 제조공정, 시스템, 설비, 원자재 및/또는 공급업체의 변경을 시행 전에 밸리데이션(validation)하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: Changes to production processes, systems, equipment, materials, and/or suppliers were not validated before they were implemented.

findings.text_ko: 인쇄된 포장재를 출입이 제한된 구역에 보관하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: Printed packaging materials were not stored in an area with restricted access.

findings.text_ko: 기준에서 벗어난 일탈(deviation)이 있었던 경우 및/또는 제품이 허용범위 경계에 있었던 경우에 대한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The evaluation was inadequate for cases where there was a deviation from the norm and/or where products were on the borderline of the acceptable range.

findings.text_ko: 업체가 무균구역(aseptic area)과 인접 구역 간 차압을 지속적으로 모니터링하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The company did not continually monitor the differences in air pressure between aseptic areas and adjacent areas.

findings.text_ko: 해당 의약품에 대한 지속적 안정성시험 프로그램(ongoing stability)이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The ongoing stability program for a drug was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 부유입자 모니터링 시스템이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The airborne particle monitoring system was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 완제품 출하 판정을 위한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment to release finished products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 위생관리 프로그램의 청소 절차, 청소 주기, 폐기물 처리 절차 및/또는 방충·방서 대책이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The sanitation program was inadequate in its cleaning procedures, frequency of cleaning, procedures for waste disposal, and/or pest control measures.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 추적성, 가독성, 문서화, 서식 및/또는 정확성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 변경사항의 적절한 문서화·평가·승인을 보장하기에 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 위생관리 프로그램이 오염 위험을 파악하거나 감소시키도록 적절히 설계되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The sanitation programs were not adequately designed to identify and/or reduce the risks of contamination.

findings.text_ko: 문서화된 위생관리 프로그램의 구비, 실행 및/또는 수준이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, implementation, and/or quality of the written sanitation program was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 시약 및 배지의 입고, 조제 및/또는 취급이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The receipt, preparation, and/or handling of reagents and culture media was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 시험실 데이터의 생성, 유지관리, 처리 및/또는 검토가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The creation, maintenance, processing, and/or review of laboratory data was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 추적성, 가독성, 문서화, 서식 및/또는 정확성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 회사는 의약품의 유효기간을 확인하기 위해 모든 함량 및 승인된 포장재에 대하여 상업용 규모 배치를 3개 이상 사용하지 않았다. 또한 안정성시험 프로그램에 사용된 분석시험법을 적절히 밸리데이션(validation)하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: To confirm the shelf life of the drug, the company did not use at least three commercial-scale batches of the drug for every strength of the drug and the approved packaging material. The company did not adequately validate the analytical test procedures used in the stability program.

findings.text_ko: 의약품에 대한 진행 중 안정성시험(ongoing stability) 프로그램이 미흡했다. 회사는 기준일탈(OOS)·경계값(borderline)·경향일탈(out-of-trend)에 해당하는 안정성시험 결과에 대해 결과를 평가하거나 시정조치를 취하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The ongoing stability program for a drug was inadequate. The company did not assess the results and/or take corrective actions for stability testing results that were out-of-specification, borderline, or out-of-trend .

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사, 보고 및/또는 후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 요구사항에 따른 완전한 시험이 수행되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: Complete testing was not performed according to the requirements.

findings.text_ko: 공급자, 제조자, 시험자, 포장자, 표시자, 유통자, 수입자 및/또는 도매상 간 품질계약서(quality agreement)의 구비, 내용 및/또는 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 온도 및/또는 습도 관리가 미흡했다. 보관 및/또는 운송 조건이 의약품의 품질과 안전한 유통을 유지하도록 보장하는 지침 및/또는 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The temperature and/or humidity control was inadequate. The guidelines and/or procedures were inadequate in ensuring storage and/or transportation conditions would maintain the quality and safe distribution of the drug.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 추적성, 가독성, 문서화, 서식 및/또는 정확성이 미흡했다. 기록의 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate. The maintenance of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 신규 또는 개정된 표준작업지침서(SOP) 시행 전 작업자 교육훈련이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The training of personnel before new or revised standard operating procedures were implemented was inadequate.

findings.text_orig: The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate. The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate. The recorded information or details were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 변경이 적절히 문서화·평가·승인되도록 보장하는 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 공급자, 제조자, 시험자, 포장자, 표시자, 유통업자, 수입자 및/또는 도매상 간 품질계약서(quality agreement)의 구비, 내용 및/또는 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 온도 및/또는 습도 관리가 미흡했다. 기록의 생성·수정·검토·보관·검색에 대한 통제가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The temperature and/or humidity control was inadequate. The controls were inadequate for creating, modifying, reviewing, storing, and/or retrieving records.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The maintenance of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 공급자, 제조자, 시험자, 포장자, 표시자, 유통자, 수입자 및/또는 도매상 간 품질계약서(quality agreement)의 구비, 내용 및/또는 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.

documents.firm_name: Omega Laboratories Ltd. (now Juno Pharma Canada Inc.)

findings.text_ko: 무균(aseptic) 구역 또는 청정구역(clean area)의 환경 등급 분류 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The process was inadequate for the environmental classification of aseptic or clean areas.

findings.text_ko: 건물·시설(premises)이 오염을 방지하도록 설계·시공·운영 및/또는 유지관리되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The premises were not designed, constructed, operated, and/or maintained to prevent contamination.

findings.text_ko: 회사는 청정구역의 미생물 오염과 부유입자 수를 최소화하도록 건물·시설 및 설비를 설계하거나 유지관리하지 않았다. 또한 멸균 후 재오염을 방지하기 위해 멸균된 자재를 적절히 보호하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The company did not design or maintain the premises and equipment to minimize microbial contamination and the number of airborne particles in clean areas. The company did not adequately protect sterilized material to prevent re-contamination after sterilization.

findings.text_ko: 기록된 정보 또는 세부 사항이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The recorded information or details were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 회사는 청정구역의 미생물 오염과 부유입자 수를 최소화하도록 건물·시설 및 설비를 설계하거나 유지관리하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The company did not design or maintain the premises and equipment to minimize microbial contamination and the number of airborne particles in clean areas.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사, 보고 및/또는 후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 보관 및/또는 운송 조건이 의약품의 품질과 안전한 유통을 유지하도록 보장하는 지침 및/또는 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The guidelines and/or procedures were inadequate in ensuring storage and/or transportation conditions would maintain the quality and safe distribution of the drug.

findings.text_ko: 우수의약품 제조·품질관리기준(GMP) 관련 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 연간 제품품질평가(annual product quality review) 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The annual product quality review procedure was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 설비의 예방정비 및 수리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The preventative maintenance and repair of the equipment was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록된 정보 또는 세부내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The recorded information or details were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 건물·시설의 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The maintenance of the premises was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 불만 및 결함 가능성이 있는 제품에 관한 기타 정보의 평가·기록·후속조치·조사가 미흡했다. 일탈(deviation)·보고 및 후속조치에 대한 조사가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment, recording, follow-up, and/or investigation of complaints and/or other information about potentially defective products was inadequate. Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 새로운 제조작업을 시작하기 전에 라인클리어런스(line clearance)를 실시하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: Line clearance was not performed before starting new processing operations.

findings.text_ko: 시험실 데이터의 생성·유지·처리·검토가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The creation, maintenance, processing, and/or review of laboratory data was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control department)가 요구되는 모든 업무를 수행하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department did not undertake all of the required activities.

findings.text_ko: 의약품 오염 방지를 위한 설비의 설계·제작·운전·배치가 미흡했다. 설비의 예방정비 및 수리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The design, construction, operation, and/or location of the equipment was inadequate for preventing contamination of the drug. The preventative maintenance and repair of the equipment was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기준일탈(OOS) 시험결과의 조사·처리·보고가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The investigation, handling, and/or reporting of test results that were out-of-specification was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 업체가 교육의 효과성을 평가하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The effectiveness of the training was not assessed by the firm.

findings.text_ko: 비위생적 상태를 방지하기 위한 위생관리(sanitation) 프로그램의 실행 및 효과성이 미흡했다. 미생물 및 환경 조건에 대한 모니터링 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation and/or the effectiveness of the sanitation program in preventing unsanitary conditions was inadequate. The monitoring procedures for microbial and/or environmental conditions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 검토·개정·승인 체계가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The system for reviewing, revising, and approving standard operating procedures was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 원료, 공정 중 의약품, 벌크 의약품 및/또는 완제품에 대한 검체의 취급 및/또는 보관이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The handling and/or storage of samples was inadequate for raw materials, drugs being processed, bulk drugs, and/or finished products.

findings.text_ko: 포장 제품에 대한 마스터 포뮬러(master formula)에 요구되는 정보가 포함되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The master formula for packaged products did not include the required information.

findings.text_ko: 의약품을 포장하는 자가 사업장에 입고한 1차 포장자재에 대한 확인시험(identity testing)이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The identity testing of primary packaging materials once they were received on the premises by a person that packages the drugs was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 보관용 검체(retaining samples)에 대한 문서화된 절차와 기록이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The written procedures and records for retaining samples were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조공정·설비·자재에 대한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Evaluation of production processes, equipment, and/or materials was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고·후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 설비의 설계·구조·설치 위치가 설비의 적절한 세척·소독·점검을 허용하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The design, construction, and/or location of the equipment did not allow adequate cleaning, sanitizing, and/or inspection of the equipment.

findings.text_ko: 시설이 제조구역을 적절히 격리·구획하도록 배치·설계되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The premises were not laid out and/or designed to ensure that production areas were adequately isolated and segregated.

findings.text_ko: 시설이 오염을 방지하도록 설계·시공·운영·유지관리되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The premises were not designed, constructed, operated, and/or maintained to prevent contamination.

findings.text_ko: 해당 업체는 멸균 후 재오염을 방지하기 위해 멸균된 자재를 충분히 보호하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The company did not adequately protect sterilized material to prevent re-contamination after sterilization.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고·후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 설비의 설계·구조·설치 위치가 설비의 적절한 세척·소독·점검을 허용하지 않았다. 설비의 설계·구조·운전·설치 위치가 의약품의 오염을 방지하기에 미흡했다. 컴퓨터화시스템을 포함한 설비의 교정·점검·적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The design, construction, and/or location of the equipment did not allow adequate cleaning, sanitizing, and/or inspection of the equipment. The design, construction, operation, and/or location of the equipment was inadequate for preventing contamination of the drug. The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 비위생적 상태를 방지하기 위한 세척 절차의 실행·효과성·밸리데이션(validation)이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation, effectiveness, and/or validation of the cleaning procedures was inadequate for preventing unsanitary conditions.

findings.text_ko: 제조공정·설비·자재에 대한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Evaluation of production processes, equipment, and/or materials was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 무균조작이 수행되는 구역에서 모니터링 주기와 방법이 미흡했다. 제조구역 또는 무균구역의 미생물 모니터링을 위한 검체채취 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: In areas where aseptic operations were performed, the frequency and the methods of monitoring were inadequate. The sampling procedure was inadequate for microbiological monitoring in processing areas or aseptic areas.

findings.text_ko: 기록된 정보 또는 세부내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The recorded information or details were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 무균공정(aseptic)이 수행되는 구역에서 모니터링 주기와 방법이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: In areas where aseptic operations were performed, the frequency and the methods of monitoring were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조공정·설비·원자재에 대한 평가가 미흡했다. 작업자의 무균조작(aseptic practice)이 무균성을 유지하기에 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Evaluation of production processes, equipment, and/or materials was inadequate. The operators'aseptic practices were inadequate to maintain sterility.

findings.text_ko: 기류 패턴(air-flow pattern)이 오염 위험을 초래하지 않는다는 점을 업체가 충분히 입증하지 못했다.
findings.text_orig: The company did not adequately demonstrate that air-flow patterns did not pose a risk of contamination.

findings.text_ko: 기록된 정보 또는 세부내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The recorded information or details were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 부유입자(airborne particle) 모니터링 시스템이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The airborne particle monitoring system was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 무균공정(aseptic processing)의 밸리데이션이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The validation of aseptic processing was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조구역 또는 무균구역의 미생물 모니터링을 위한 검체채취 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The sampling procedure was inadequate for microbiological monitoring in processing areas or aseptic areas.

findings.text_ko: 데이터 거버넌스(data governance) 계획의 수립 및 유지가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The establishment and/or the maintenance of a data governance plan was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 각 환경 등급(grade)별 문서화된 복장 기준이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The written clothing standards for each environmental grade were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 시험을 승인된 기준(specification)에 따라 수행하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: Tests were not performed according to approved specifications.

findings.text_ko: 품질경영시스템의 실행·유지 및 효과성 개선에 필요한 적절한 자원을 결정하고 제공하는 최고경영진의 역량이 미흡했다. 기록의 추적성·가독성·문서화·서식·정확성이 미흡했다. 품질관리부서(quality control unit)가 요구되는 활동을 모두 수행하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: Senior management's ability to determine and/or provide adequate and/or appropriate resources to implement, maintain and/or improve the effectiveness of the quality management system was inadequate. The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate. The quality control department did not undertake all of the required activities.

findings.text_ko: 보관 및 운송 조건이 의약품의 품질과 안전한 유통을 유지하도록 보장하는 지침·절차가 미흡했다. 컴퓨터화시스템을 포함한 설비의 교정·점검·적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The guidelines and/or procedures were inadequate in ensuring storage and/or transportation conditions would maintain the quality and safe distribution of the drug. The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: GMP 관련 표준작업절차(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 격리보관(quarantine) 구역의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The control of quarantine areas was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고·후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 컴퓨터화시스템을 포함한 설비의 교정·점검·적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 시험실 데이터의 생성·유지·처리·검토가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The creation, maintenance, processing, and/or review of laboratory data was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 신규 또는 개정된 표준작업절차(SOP) 시행 전 작업자 교육훈련이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The training of personnel before new or revised standard operating procedures were implemented was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 의약품의 지속적 안정성시험(ongoing stability) 프로그램이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The ongoing stability program for a drug was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 연간 제품품질평가(annual product quality review) 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The annual product quality review procedure was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고·후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 유지관리가 미흡했다. 전자시스템이 의도된 사용 목적에 대해 밸리데이션되지 않았다. 전자서명에 대해 마련된 통제가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The maintenance of records was inadequate. The electronic system was not validated for its intended use. The controls put in place for electronic signatures were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 공급자·제조자·시험자·포장자·표시자·유통업자·수입자·도매상 간 품질계약서(quality agreement)의 구비·내용·유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 캐나다 반입 전 또는 반입 후 검체에 대해 수행한 확인시험이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The confirmatory tests conducted on samples before or after they were received in Canada were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 완제품 출하 판정을 위한 평가가 미흡했다. 수입자 및 유통업자의 최신 제조기준서(master production document) 및 품목허가 준수가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment to release finished products was inadequate. The importer and/or the distributor's compliance with the current master production documents and/or the marketing authorization was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 변경이 적절히 문서화·평가·승인되도록 보장하는 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 보관 및 운송 조건이 의약품의 품질과 안전한 유통을 유지하도록 보장하는 지침·절차가 미흡했다. 온도 및 습도 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The guidelines and/or procedures were inadequate in ensuring storage and/or transportation conditions would maintain the quality and safe distribution of the drug. The temperature and/or humidity control was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 자체점검(self-inspection) 프로그램의 실행이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation of a self-inspection program was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 완제품 출하 판정을 위한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment to release finished products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control unit)가 독립적으로 기능하고 다른 부서와 독립적으로 경영진에 보고하는 별도의 조직이 아니었다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department was not a distinct unit that functioned independently and reported to management independent of any other unit.

findings.text_ko: 공급자·제조자·시험자·포장자·표시자·유통업자·수입자·도매상 간 품질계약서(quality agreement)의 구비·내용·유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 온도 및 습도 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The temperature and/or humidity control was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 의약품의 지속적 안정성시험(ongoing stability) 프로그램이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The ongoing stability program for a drug was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 회수(recall)에 관한 문서화된 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The written procedures for recalls were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 컴퓨터화시스템을 포함한 설비의 교정·점검·적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기준일탈(OOS) 시험결과의 조사·처리·보고가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The investigation, handling, and/or reporting of test results that were out-of-specification was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 비위생적 상태를 방지하기 위한 위생관리(sanitation) 프로그램의 실행 및 효과성이 미흡했다. 위생관리 프로그램이 오염 위험을 식별하거나 저감하도록 적절히 설계되지 않았다. 설비가 다른 의약품 또는 이물에 의한 의약품 오염 가능성을 방지하도록 설치·설계·운전·보관·유지관리되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation and/or the effectiveness of the sanitation program in preventing unsanitary conditions was inadequate. The sanitation programs were not adequately designed to identify and/or reduce the risks of contamination. The equipment was not set-up, designed, operated, stored, and/or maintained to prevent potential contamination of drugs by other drugs and/or by foreign material.

findings.text_ko: 수율 및 수불 대조 수량을 적절한 단계에서 확인하지 않았다. 제조공정·설비·자재에 대한 평가가 미흡했다. 새로운 제조작업을 시작하기 전에 라인 클리어런스(line clearance)를 수행하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: Yields and/or the reconciled quantities were not checked at appropriate stages. Evaluation of production processes, equipment, and/or materials was inadequate. Line clearance was not performed before starting new processing operations.

findings.text_ko: 컴퓨터화시스템을 포함한 설비의 교정·점검·적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 연간 제품품질평가(annual product quality review) 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The annual product quality review procedure was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 시설이 제품 간 교차오염 및 혼동을 방지하기 위한 최적의 인원·자재 동선이 되도록 배치·설계되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The premises were not laid out and/or designed for an optimal flow of personnel and/or materials to prevent cross-contamination and/or mix-ups between products.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고·후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 작업자의 직무기술서, 작업자에게 부여된 권한, 업무 위임이 미흡하거나 문서화되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The job descriptions for personnel, the authority given to personnel, and/or the delegation of duties was inadequate and/or undocumented.

findings.text_ko: 위생관리(sanitation) 프로그램이 오염 위험을 식별하거나 저감하도록 적절히 설계되지 않았다. 비위생적 상태를 방지하기 위한 세척 절차의 실행·효과성·밸리데이션(validation)이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The sanitation programs were not adequately designed to identify and/or reduce the risks of contamination. The implementation, effectiveness, and/or validation of the cleaning procedures was inadequate for preventing unsanitary conditions.

findings.text_ko: 시약 및 배지(culture media)의 입고·조제·취급이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The receipt, preparation, and/or handling of reagents and culture media was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 시험실 데이터의 생성·유지·처리·검토가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The creation, maintenance, processing, and/or review of laboratory data was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 인쇄된 포장재를 출입이 제한된 구역에 보관하지 않았다. 포장 작업을 문서화된 작업 절차 또는 기준서에 따라 수행하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: Printed packaging materials were not stored in an area with restricted access. Packaging operations were not performed in keeping with the written operating procedures or specifications.

findings.text_ko: 환기시스템 공기질의 유지관리 및 모니터링이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The maintenance and/or monitoring of the ventilation system's air quality was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)·보고 및 후속조치에 대한 조사가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 생성·수정·검토·보관·검색에 대한 통제가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The controls were inadequate for creating, modifying, reviewing, storing, and/or retrieving records.

findings.text_ko: 변경사항이 적절히 문서화·평가·승인되도록 보장하는 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 신규 또는 개정된 표준작업지침서(SOP) 시행 전 작업자 교육이 미흡했다. 작업자의 직무기술서, 작업자에게 부여된 권한, 업무 위임이 미흡하거나 문서화되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The training of personnel before new or revised standard operating procedures were implemented was inadequate. The job descriptions for personnel, the authority given to personnel, and/or the delegation of duties was inadequate and/or undocumented.

findings.text_ko: 작업자의 직무기술서, 작업자에게 부여된 권한, 업무 위임이 미흡하거나 문서화되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The job descriptions for personnel, the authority given to personnel, and/or the delegation of duties was inadequate and/or undocumented.

findings.text_ko: 원료·포장재·중간제품·벌크 의약품·완제품의 구획 분리, 재고 순환(선입선출), 운송이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The segregation, rotation of stock, and/or the transportation of raw materials, packaging materials, intermediates, bulk drugs, and/or finished products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 문서화된 회수(recall) 체계에 각 의약품을 추적할 수 있는 유통기록이 포함되어 있지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The written recall system did not include distribution records that allowed each drug to be traced.

findings.text_ko: 의약품의 품질과 안전한 유통이 유지되도록 보관 및/또는 운송 조건을 보장하기 위한 지침·절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The guidelines and/or procedures were inadequate in ensuring storage and/or transportation conditions would maintain the quality and safe distribution of the drug.

findings.text_ko: GMP 관련 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 포장지시서에 요구되는 정보가 포함되어 있지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: Packaging orders did not include the required information.

findings.text_ko: 품질경영시스템의 효과성을 실행·유지·개선하기 위해 적절하고 적합한 자원을 파악하고 제공하는 경영진의 역량이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Senior management's ability to determine and/or provide adequate and/or appropriate resources to implement, maintain and/or improve the effectiveness of the quality management system was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 온도 및/또는 습도 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The temperature and/or humidity control was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 추적성·가독성·문서화·서식 및 정확성이 미흡했다. 회수(recall) 지원을 위해 제품 재고 및 유통기록을 관리하는 데 사용되는 컴퓨터화시스템이 밸리데이션(validation)되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate. The computerized system used to manage product inventory and distribution records to support recalls was not validated.

findings.text_ko: 작업자에 대한 지속 교육이 미흡했다. 신규 또는 개정된 표준작업지침서(SOP) 시행 전 작업자 교육이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The ongoing training of personnel was inadequate. The training of personnel before new or revised standard operating procedures were implemented was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 전자서명에 대해 마련된 통제가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The controls put in place for electronic signatures were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조·포장 또는 표시·시험에 대한 책임을 규정한 품질계약서(quality agreement)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The quality agreement outlining the responsibilities for fabricating, packaging or labelling, and/or testing was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)·보고 및 후속조치에 대한 조사가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control department)의 승인 없이 제품이 판매 가능한 상태로 제공되었다. 사용 전 원료 및 포장재의 격리보관·검체채취·시험·출고 승인이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The product was made available for sale without the approval of the quality control department. The quarantine, sampling, testing, release of raw material, and/or the packaging materials prior to use were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 의약품에 대한 지속 안정성시험(ongoing stability) 프로그램이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The ongoing stability program for a drug was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 자체점검(self-inspection) 프로그램의 실행이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation of a self-inspection program was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 연간 제품품질평가(annual product quality review) 절차가 미흡했다. 품질관리부서(quality control department)가 연간 제품품질평가 결과를 평가하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The annual product quality review procedure was inadequate. The quality control department did not evaluate the results of the annual product quality review.

findings.text_ko: 작업자에 대한 GMP 교육 및/또는 관련 기록의 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The training of personnel in good manufacturing practices and/or the maintenance of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 전자시스템이 의도한 용도에 대해 밸리데이션(validation)되지 않았다. 전자서명에 대해 마련된 통제가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The electronic system was not validated for its intended use. The controls put in place for electronic signatures were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)·보고 및 후속조치에 대한 조사가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 자체점검(self-inspection) 프로그램의 실행이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation of a self-inspection program was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 공급자·제조원·시험기관·포장업체·표시업체·유통업체·수입업체·도매상 간 품질계약서(quality agreement)의 구비·내용·유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.

findings.text_orig: The assessment, recording, follow-up, and/or investigation of complaints and/or other information about potentially defective products was inadequate.

findings.text_orig: The guidelines and/or procedures were inadequate in ensuring storage and/or transportation conditions would maintain the quality and safe distribution of the drug. The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate.

findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 비위생적 상태를 방지하기 위한 위생관리(sanitation) 프로그램의 실행과 실효성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation and/or the effectiveness of the sanitation program in preventing unsanitary conditions was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 컴퓨터화시스템을 포함한 장비의 교정, 점검, 적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 의약품 유통기록의 유지관리가 미흡했다. 인사기록의 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The maintenance of distribution records for drugs was inadequate. The maintenance of personnel records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 회수(recall)에 대한 문서화된 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The written procedures for recalls were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 반품된 의약품의 재판매 검토에 대한 평가, 문서화, 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment, documentation, and/or procedures for considering the resale of returned drugs were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 컴퓨터화시스템을 포함한 장비의 교정, 점검, 적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 보관 및 운송 조건이 의약품의 품질과 안전한 유통을 유지하도록 보장하는 지침과 절차가 미흡했다. 의약품 각 로트 또는 배치의 운송 및 보관 조건을 입증하는 데 사용된 증빙이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The guidelines and/or procedures were inadequate in ensuring storage and/or transportation conditions would maintain the quality and safe distribution of the drug. The evidence used to demonstrate the transportation and/or storage conditions of each lot or batch of the drug was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 불만 및 결함 가능성이 있는 제품에 관한 정보의 평가, 기록, 후속조치, 조사가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment, recording, follow-up, and/or investigation of complaints and/or other information about potentially defective products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 공급자, 제조업자, 시험자, 포장업자, 표시업자, 유통업자, 수입업자, 도매업자 간 품질계약서(quality agreement)의 구비, 내용, 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조, 포장, 표시, 요구되는 시험, 보관, 유통 및 각각의 조건에 대한 증빙의 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The maintenance of evidence was inadequate for manufacturing, packaging, labelling, required testing, storage, and/or distribution, including the respective conditions.

findings.text_ko: 캐나다 반입 전 또는 후에 검체에 대해 수행한 확인시험이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The confirmatory tests conducted on samples before or after they were received in Canada were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 보관 및 운송 조건이 의약품의 품질과 안전한 유통을 유지하도록 보장하는 지침과 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The guidelines and/or procedures were inadequate in ensuring storage and/or transportation conditions would maintain the quality and safe distribution of the drug.

findings.text_ko: 품질경영시스템의 실효성을 실행·유지·개선하기 위해 적절하고 적합한 자원을 결정하고 제공하는 경영진의 역량이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Senior management's ability to determine and/or provide adequate and/or appropriate resources to implement, maintain and/or improve the effectiveness of the quality management system was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록된 정보 또는 세부 내용이 미흡했다. 기록의 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The recorded information or details were inadequate. The maintenance of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 의약품 유통기록의 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The maintenance of distribution records for drugs was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 공급자, 제조업자, 시험자, 포장업자, 표시업자, 유통업자, 수입업자, 도매업자 간 품질계약서(quality agreement)의 구비, 내용, 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 오염 위험을 파악하고 저감하도록 위생관리(sanitation) 프로그램이 적절히 설계되지 않았다. 설비가 다른 의약품 또는 이물에 의한 의약품 오염 가능성을 방지하도록 설치·설계·운전·보관·유지관리되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The sanitation programs were not adequately designed to identify and/or reduce the risks of contamination. The equipment was not set-up, designed, operated, stored, and/or maintained to prevent potential contamination of drugs by other drugs and/or by foreign material.

findings.text_ko: 컴퓨터화시스템을 포함한 설비의 교정·점검·적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다. 주요 제조 및 시험 작업에 사용되는 설비에 대한 예방정비 프로그램이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate. The preventative maintenance program was inadequate for the equipment used in significant processing and/or testing operations.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)·보고 및 후속조치에 대한 조사가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 시험실 데이터의 생성·유지·처리·검토가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The creation, maintenance, processing, and/or review of laboratory data was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 의약품의 품질과 안전한 유통이 유지되도록 보관 및/또는 운송 조건을 보장하기 위한 지침·절차가 미흡했다. 온도 및/또는 습도 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The guidelines and/or procedures were inadequate in ensuring storage and/or transportation conditions would maintain the quality and safe distribution of the drug. The temperature and/or humidity control was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기준일탈(OOS) 시험결과의 조사·처리·보고가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The investigation, handling, and/or reporting of test results that were out-of-specification was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 생성·수정·검토·보관·검색에 대한 통제가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The controls were inadequate for creating, modifying, reviewing, storing, and/or retrieving records.

findings.text_ko: 환경 시료채취 방법이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The environmental sampling methods were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 컴퓨터화시스템을 포함한 설비의 교정·점검·적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 중요 제조공정에 대한 밸리데이션(validation)을 수행하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: Critical production processes were not validated.

findings.text_ko: 변경사항이 적절히 문서화·평가·승인되도록 보장하기에 변경관리(change control) 체계가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 제조, 포장 또는 표시, 시험에 대한 책임을 규정한 품질계약서(quality agreement)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The quality agreement outlining the responsibilities for fabricating, packaging or labelling, and/or testing was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 위생관리 프로그램이 오염 위험을 파악하고 저감하도록 적절히 설계되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The sanitation programs were not adequately designed to identify and/or reduce the risks of contamination.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control unit)가 요구되는 업무를 모두 수행하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department did not undertake all of the required activities.

findings.text_ko: 무균성을 유지하기에 작업자의 무균조작(aseptic practice)이 미흡했다. 제조공정·설비·원자재에 대한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The operators'aseptic practices were inadequate to maintain sterility. Evaluation of production processes, equipment, and/or materials was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기준일탈(OOS) 시험결과의 조사, 처리 및/또는 보고가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The investigation, handling, and/or reporting of test results that were out-of-specification was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사, 보고 및/또는 후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 문서화된 위생관리 프로그램의 구비, 실행 및/또는 수준이 미흡했다. 세척 절차의 실행, 효과 및/또는 밸리데이션이 비위생적 상태를 방지하기에 미흡했다. 장비가 다른 의약품 및/또는 이물에 의한 의약품 오염 가능성을 방지하도록 설치·설계·운영·보관 및/또는 유지관리되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, implementation, and/or quality of the written sanitation program was inadequate. The implementation, effectiveness, and/or validation of the cleaning procedures was inadequate for preventing unsanitary conditions. The equipment was not set-up, designed, operated, stored, and/or maintained to prevent potential contamination of drugs by other drugs and/or by foreign material.

findings.text_ko: 진정한 시험성적서(certificate of analysis)의 구비 또는 그 내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability or the content of the authentic certificate of analysis was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 완제품 출하 판정을 위한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment to release finished products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조공정, 장비 및/또는 원자재에 대한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Evaluation of production processes, equipment, and/or materials was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 시험법 이전(test method transfer)에 대한 문서화된 프로토콜 및/또는 평가가 미흡했다. 시험법의 밸리데이션 및/또는 문서화가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The written protocol and/or the assessment of the test method transfer was inadequate. The validation and/or the documentation of test methods was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 컴퓨터화시스템을 포함한 장비의 교정, 점검 및/또는 적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 생성, 수정, 검토, 보관 및/또는 검색에 대한 통제가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The controls were inadequate for creating, modifying, reviewing, storing, and/or retrieving records.

findings.text_ko: 재작업 또는 재가공된 의약품 로트가 지속 안정성시험 프로그램에 포함되지 않았다.
