findings.text_ko: 기록된 정보 또는 세부 내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The recorded information or details were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고·후속조치가 미흡했다. 기준일탈(OOS) 시험결과의 조사·처리·보고가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate. The investigation, handling, and/or reporting of test results that were out-of-specification was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 무균공정(aseptic processing)에 대한 밸리데이션(validation)이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The validation of aseptic processing was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 건물·시설의 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The maintenance of the premises was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 무균조작(aseptic)이 수행되는 구역에서 모니터링의 주기와 방법이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: In areas where aseptic operations were performed, the frequency and the methods of monitoring were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 작업자의 무균조작(aseptic) 수행이 무균성을 유지하기에 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The operators'aseptic practices were inadequate to maintain sterility.

findings.text_ko: 충전된 용기에 대한 회사의 외관 검사(visual inspection)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The company's visual inspection of filled containers was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 시약 및 배지의 입고·조제·취급이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The receipt, preparation, and/or handling of reagents and culture media was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 보관 및 운송 조건이 의약품의 품질과 안전한 유통을 유지하도록 보장하는 지침·절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The guidelines and/or procedures were inadequate in ensuring storage and/or transportation conditions would maintain the quality and safe distribution of the drug.

findings.text_ko: 위생관리 프로그램이 오염 위험을 파악하거나 저감하도록 적절히 설계되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The sanitation programs were not adequately designed to identify and/or reduce the risks of contamination.

findings.text_ko: 용기가 이물에 의해 오염되지 않도록 하는 예방조치가 취해지지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: Precautions were not taken to ensure that containers were free from contamination by foreign material.

findings.text_ko: 배지의 적합성을 검증하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The suitability of the culture media was not verified.

findings.text_ko: 기록된 정보 또는 세부내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The recorded information or details were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: GMP 관련 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고·후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 해당 의약품의 사용기한이 제조일 또는 품목허가에 근거하여 설정되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The shelf life of a drug was not based on the date of fabrication and/or the market authorization.

findings.text_ko: 작업자에 대한 GMP 교육훈련 및 관련 기록의 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The training of personnel in good manufacturing practices and/or the maintenance of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 원자재 로트의 각 용기에 대해 내용물을 확인하기 위한 특이적이고 식별력 있는 확인시험을 수행하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: Each container of a lot of raw materials was not tested to identify its contents with a specific, discriminating test.

findings.text_ko: 설비가 다른 의약품 또는 이물에 의한 의약품 오염 가능성을 방지하도록 설치·설계·운전·보관·유지관리되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The equipment was not set-up, designed, operated, stored, and/or maintained to prevent potential contamination of drugs by other drugs and/or by foreign material.

findings.text_ko: 위생관리 프로그램이 오염 위험을 파악하고 저감하도록 적절히 설계되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The sanitation programs were not adequately designed to identify and/or reduce the risks of contamination.

findings.text_ko: 해당 의약품에 대한 지속적 안정성시험 프로그램이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The ongoing stability program for a drug was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 원료, 공정 중 의약품, 벌크 의약품, 완제품에 대한 검체의 취급과 보관이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The handling and/or storage of samples was inadequate for raw materials, drugs being processed, bulk drugs, and/or finished products.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 생성·수정·검토·보관·검색에 대한 통제가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The controls were inadequate for creating, modifying, reviewing, storing, and/or retrieving records.

findings.text_ko: 제조, 포장, 표시, 요구되는 시험, 보관, 유통 및 각각의 조건에 대한 증빙의 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The maintenance of evidence was inadequate for manufacturing, packaging, labelling, required testing, storage, and/or distribution, including the respective conditions.

findings.text_ko: 제품 및 원자재의 오염 방지가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The protection of products and/or materials from contamination was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 유틸리티 및 지원설비에 대한 적격성평가(qualification)와 검증이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The qualification and/or verification of utilities and/or support systems was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사, 보고, 후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 추적성, 가독성, 문서화, 서식, 정확성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 비위생적 상태를 방지하기 위한 위생관리(sanitation) 프로그램의 실행과 실효성이 미흡했다. 위생관리(sanitation) 프로그램이 오염 위험을 파악하거나 저감하도록 적절히 설계되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation and/or the effectiveness of the sanitation program in preventing unsanitary conditions was inadequate. The sanitation programs were not adequately designed to identify and/or reduce the risks of contamination.

findings.text_ko: 작업자에 대한 지속 교육이 미흡했다. 작업자에 대한 GMP 교육 및/또는 관련 기록의 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The ongoing training of personnel was inadequate. The training of personnel in good manufacturing practices and/or the maintenance of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control department)가 제품 품질에 관한 모든 의사결정에 관여하지 않았다. 완제품 출하 판정을 위한 평가가 미흡했다. 문서가 사업장 내에 비치되어 있지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department was not involved in all decisions for the quality of the product. The assessment to release finished products was inadequate. Documents were not available on the premises.

findings.text_ko: 의약품에 대한 지속 안정성시험(ongoing stability) 프로그램이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The ongoing stability program for a drug was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 추적성·가독성·문서화·서식 및 정확성이 미흡했다. 유통기록으로 각 의약품을 개별적으로 추적할 수 없었다.
findings.text_orig: The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate. The distribution records did not allow each drug to be traced individually.

findings.text_ko: 온도 및/또는 습도 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The temperature and/or humidity control was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: GMP 관련 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질경영시스템의 효과성을 실행·유지·개선하기 위해 적절하고 적합한 자원을 파악하고 제공하는 경영진의 역량이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Senior management's ability to determine and/or provide adequate and/or appropriate resources to implement, maintain and/or improve the effectiveness of the quality management system was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 진본 시험성적서(authentic certificate of analysis)의 구비 또는 내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability or the content of the authentic certificate of analysis was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)·보고 및 후속조치에 대한 조사가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 캐나다 반입 전 또는 후에 검체에 대해 실시한 확인시험이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The confirmatory tests conducted on samples before or after they were received in Canada were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 완제품 출하 판정을 위한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment to release finished products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 컴퓨터화시스템을 포함한 장비의 교정, 점검 및/또는 적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 포장재에 대한 기준규격이 불완전하거나 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The specifications for any packaging materials were incomplete or inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조공정을 관리하기 위한 마스터 포뮬러(master formula)가 미흡했다. 새로운 공정 작업을 시작하기 전에 라인클리어런스(line clearance)를 수행하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The master formulas to control the manufacturing process were inadequate. Line clearance was not performed before starting new processing operations.

findings.text_ko: 위생관리(sanitation) 프로그램이 오염 위험을 파악하거나 저감하도록 적절히 설계되지 않았다. 위생관리(sanitation) 프로그램의 세척 절차, 세척 주기, 폐기물 처리 절차, 방충·방서 조치가 미흡했다. 문서화된 위생관리(sanitation) 프로그램의 구비, 실행, 수준이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The sanitation programs were not adequately designed to identify and/or reduce the risks of contamination. The sanitation program was inadequate in its cleaning procedures, frequency of cleaning, procedures for waste disposal, and/or pest control measures. The availability, implementation, and/or quality of the written sanitation program was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 의약품 안정성시험의 설계가 미흡했고 문서화된 근거로 타당성이 입증되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The design of the drug stability study was inadequate and/or not justified with a documented rationale.

findings.text_ko: 포장재에 대한 규격이 불완전하거나 미흡했다. 사전 승인된 문서화된 절차 또는 지시에 따른 원료, 제품, 포장재의 취급이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The specifications for any packaging materials were incomplete or inadequate. The handling of raw materials, products, or packaging materials in keeping with pre-approved written procedures or instructions was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 핵심 제조공정에 대한 밸리데이션(validation)이 수행되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: Critical production processes were not validated.

findings.text_ko: 불만(complaint) 및/또는 결함 가능성이 있는 제품에 관한 기타 정보의 평가·기록·후속조치 및/또는 조사가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment, recording, follow-up, and/or investigation of complaints and/or other information about potentially defective products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사, 보고 및/또는 후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 변경관리(change control) 체계가 변경사항이 적절히 문서화·평가 및/또는 승인되도록 보장하기에 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: GMP 표준작업절차서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 문서화된 개인위생 프로그램이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The written hygiene program was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 시험실의 설계, 장비, 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The design, equipment, and/or maintenance of the testing laboratory was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 건물·시설이 오염을 방지하도록 설계·시공·운영·유지관리되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The premises were not designed, constructed, operated, and/or maintained to prevent contamination.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control unit)가 요구되는 활동을 모두 수행하지 않았다. 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사, 보고, 후속조치가 미흡했다. 변경이 적절히 문서화·평가·승인되도록 보장하는 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department did not undertake all of the required activities. Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate. The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 문서화된 위생관리(sanitation) 프로그램의 구비, 실행, 수준이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, implementation, and/or quality of the written sanitation program was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 수입업자는 의약품의 제조, 포장/표시, 시험에 사용되는 해외 제조소가 Guidance on Evidence to Demonstrate Drug GMP Compliance of Foreign Sites (GUI-0080)에 기술된 요건을 충족하는지 확인하지 않았다. 수탁 시험기관의 규정 준수를 보증하기 위한 조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The importer did not ensure that the foreign sites use to fabricate, package/label, or test drug products met the requirements described in Guidance on Evidence to Demonstrate Drug GMP Compliance of Foreign Sites (GUI-0080). Measures to ensure the compliance of the contracted test laboratories were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 온도 및 습도 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The temperature and/or humidity control was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사, 보고, 후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 반품된 의약품의 재판매 검토에 대한 평가, 문서화, 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment, documentation, and/or procedures for considering the resale of returned drugs were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 회수(recall)에 대한 문서화된 절차가 미흡했다. 기록의 추적성, 가독성, 문서화, 서식, 정확성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The written procedures for recalls were inadequate. The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 위생관리(sanitation) 프로그램이 오염 위험을 파악하거나 저감하도록 적절히 설계되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The sanitation programs were not adequately designed to identify and/or reduce the risks of contamination.

findings.text_ko: 컴퓨터화시스템을 포함한 장비의 교정, 점검, 적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 추적성, 가독성, 문서화, 서식, 정확성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기준에서 벗어난 경우 또는 제품이 허용범위 경계에 있는 경우에 대한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The evaluation was inadequate for cases where there was a deviation from the norm and/or where products were on the borderline of the acceptable range.

findings.text_ko: 총균수에 대한 검체채취, 시험, 규격이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The sampling, testing, and/or specifications for total microbial count were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사, 보고 및/또는 후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 컴퓨터화시스템을 포함한 장비의 교정, 점검 및/또는 적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 회사는 청정구역의 미생물 오염과 부유입자 수를 최소화하도록 작업소와 장비를 설계하거나 유지관리하지 않았다. 위생관리 프로그램이 오염 위험을 파악 및/또는 저감하도록 적절히 설계되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The company did not design or maintain the premises and equipment to minimize microbial contamination and the number of airborne particles in clean areas. The sanitation programs were not adequately designed to identify and/or reduce the risks of contamination.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 생성, 수정, 검토, 보관 및/또는 검색에 대한 통제가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The controls were inadequate for creating, modifying, reviewing, storing, and/or retrieving records.

findings.text_ko: 환경 검체채취(environmental sampling) 방법이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The environmental sampling methods were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 회사는 기류 패턴(air-flow pattern)이 오염 위험을 초래하지 않음을 적절히 입증하지 못했다.
findings.text_orig: The company did not adequately demonstrate that air-flow patterns did not pose a risk of contamination.

findings.text_ko: 불만 및 결함 가능성이 있는 제품에 관한 정보의 평가, 기록, 후속조치, 조사가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment, recording, follow-up, and/or investigation of complaints and/or other information about potentially defective products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 반품된 의약품의 재판매 검토에 대한 평가, 문서화, 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment, documentation, and/or procedures for considering the resale of returned drugs were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 회수(recall)에 대한 문서화된 절차가 미흡했다. 문서화된 회수(recall) 체계에 각 의약품을 추적할 수 있는 유통기록이 포함되어 있지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The written procedures for recalls were inadequate. The written recall system did not include distribution records that allowed each drug to be traced.

findings.text_ko: 문서가 사업장 내에 비치되어 있지 않았다. 전자시스템이 의도된 용도에 대해 밸리데이션(validation)되지 않았다. 기록의 추적성, 가독성, 문서화, 서식, 정확성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Documents were not available on the premises. The electronic system was not validated for its intended use. The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 공급자, 제조업자, 시험자, 포장업자, 표시업자, 유통업자, 수입업자, 도매업자 간 품질계약서(quality agreement)의 구비, 내용, 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사, 보고, 후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 전자서명에 대해 마련된 통제가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The controls put in place for electronic signatures were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기준일탈(OOS) 시험결과의 조사, 처리 및/또는 보고가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The investigation, handling, and/or reporting of test results that were out-of-specification was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조공정, 장비 및/또는 원자재에 대한 평가가 미흡했다. 제조기준서(master production document)가 미흡했다. 연간 제품품질평가(annual product quality review) 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Evaluation of production processes, equipment, and/or materials was inadequate. The master production documents were inadequate. The annual product quality review procedure was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 작업소에 입고된 모든 원자재 로트에 대해 특이적 확인시험을 실시하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: Specific identity testing was not conducted on all lots of raw materials received on the premises.

findings.text_ko: 작업 공간이 미흡했다. 작업소가 청결하고 정돈된 상태를 유지하도록 설계·시공·운영 및/또는 유지관리되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The working spaces were inadequate. The premises were not designed, constructed, operated, and/or maintained to allow clean and orderly conditions.

findings.text_ko: 정제수 설비의 운전이 신뢰할 수 있는 용수 공급을 보장하기에 미흡했다. 정제수 시스템이 미흡하여 용수가 화학적·미생물학적 순도에 대한 적절한 요건을 충족하지 못할 우려가 있었다.
findings.text_orig: The operation of the water purification equipment was inadequate for ensuring a reliable source of water. The purified water system was inadequate with the potential for water not meeting the appropriate requirements for chemical and microbial purity.

findings.text_ko: 보관 및/또는 운송 조건이 의약품의 품질과 안전한 유통을 유지하도록 보장하기에 지침 및/또는 절차가 미흡했다. 온도 및/또는 습도 관리가 미흡했다. 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사, 보고 및/또는 후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The guidelines and/or procedures were inadequate in ensuring storage and/or transportation conditions would maintain the quality and safe distribution of the drug. The temperature and/or humidity control was inadequate. Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 변경이 적절히 문서화·평가 및/또는 승인되도록 보장하기에 변경관리 시스템이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 종업원에 대한 GMP 교육 및/또는 그 기록의 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The training of personnel in good manufacturing practices and/or the maintenance of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 위생관리 프로그램이 오염 위험을 파악하고 저감하도록 적절히 설계되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The sanitation programs were not adequately designed to identify and/or reduce the risks of contamination.

findings.text_ko: 제조용수 시험에 대한 회사의 모니터링이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The company's monitoring of water testing was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 충전된 용기에 대한 회사의 외관검사(visual inspection)가 미흡했다. 무균구역 또는 청정구역의 미립자 또는 미생물 오염을 최소화하기 위한 환경 기준이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The company's visual inspection of filled containers was inadequate. The environmental standards were inadequate in order to minimise particular or microbial contamination of aseptic or clean areas.

findings.text_ko: 비위생적 상태를 방지하기에 세척절차의 시행·유효성·밸리데이션(validation)이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation, effectiveness, and/or validation of the cleaning procedures was inadequate for preventing unsanitary conditions.

findings.text_ko: 신뢰할 수 있는 용수 공급을 보장하기에 정제수 설비의 운전이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The operation of the water purification equipment was inadequate for ensuring a reliable source of water.

findings.text_ko: 환경모니터링을 위해 채취한 시료 수가 부족했다.
findings.text_orig: The number of samples taken for environmental monitoring was insufficient.

findings.text_ko: 제조공정·설비·원자재에 대한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Evaluation of production processes, equipment, and/or materials was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 시험실 데이터의 생성·유지·처리·검토가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The creation, maintenance, processing, and/or review of laboratory data was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 무균구역 또는 청정구역의 미립자 또는 미생물 오염을 최소화하기 위한 환경 기준이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The environmental standards were inadequate in order to minimise particular or microbial contamination of aseptic or clean areas.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control unit)가 요구되는 업무를 모두 수행하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department did not undertake all of the required activities.

findings.text_ko: 습열멸균(moist heat sterilization)에 대한 회사의 밸리데이션(validation)이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The company's validation of moist heat sterilization was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 용기가 이물에 의해 오염되지 않도록 하는 예방조치를 취하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: Precautions were not taken to ensure that containers were free from contamination by foreign material.

findings.text_ko: 청정구역(critical area)의 미생물 오염에 대한 회사의 조사가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The company's investigations of microbial contamination in critical areas were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 추적성·가독성·문서화·서식·정확성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조공정·설비·자재에 대한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Evaluation of production processes, equipment, and/or materials was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조·포장 또는 표시·시험에 대한 책임을 규정한 품질계약서(quality agreement)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The quality agreement outlining the responsibilities for fabricating, packaging or labelling, and/or testing was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 멸균필터 완전성시험(integrity test)에 대한 문서화가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The documentation for the integrity testing of sterilizing filters was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 비위생적 상태를 방지하기 위한 위생관리 프로그램(sanitation program)의 실행 및 실효성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation and/or the effectiveness of the sanitation program in preventing unsanitary conditions was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 멸균공정이 품목허가 및 제조허가 내용과 일치하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The sterilization process did not align with the marketing and manufacturing authorization.

findings.text_ko: 변경이 적절히 문서화·평가·승인되도록 보장하는 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 자재, 벌크 용기, 주요 장비 및/또는 작업실이 적절히 식별 표시되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: Materials, bulk containers, major items of equipment, and/or the rooms were not properly identified.

findings.text_ko: 전자시스템이 의도된 용도에 대해 밸리데이션(validation)되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The electronic system was not validated for its intended use.

findings.text_ko: 컴퓨터화시스템을 포함한 장비의 교정, 점검 및/또는 적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 불만 및/또는 결함 가능성이 있는 제품에 관한 기타 정보의 평가, 기록, 후속조치 및/또는 조사가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment, recording, follow-up, and/or investigation of complaints and/or other information about potentially defective products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기준일탈(OOS) 시험결과의 조사, 처리 및/또는 보고가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The investigation, handling, and/or reporting of test results that were out-of-specification was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사, 보고 및/또는 후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 종업원에 대한 GMP 교육 및/또는 그 기록의 유지관리가 미흡했다. 종업원의 직무기술서, 부여된 권한 및/또는 업무 위임이 미흡하거나 문서화되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The training of personnel in good manufacturing practices and/or the maintenance of records was inadequate. The job descriptions for personnel, the authority given to personnel, and/or the delegation of duties was inadequate and/or undocumented.

findings.text_ko: GMP 관련 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다. 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 검토·개정·승인 체계가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate. The system for reviewing, revising, and approving standard operating procedures was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 온도 및/또는 습도 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The temperature and/or humidity control was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 변경이 적절히 문서화·평가 및/또는 승인되도록 보장하기에 변경관리 시스템이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사, 보고 및/또는 후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 추적성, 가독성, 문서화, 서식 및/또는 정확성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control department)가 요구되는 업무를 모두 수행하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department did not undertake all of the required activities.

findings.text_ko: 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 검토·개정·승인 체계가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The system for reviewing, revising, and approving standard operating procedures was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 전산화 시스템(computerized system)을 포함한 설비의 교정(calibration)·점검 및/또는 적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 설비의 예방정비(preventative maintenance) 및 수리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The preventative maintenance and repair of the equipment was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 추적성·판독성·문서화·서식 및/또는 정확성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 정본 시험성적서(certificate of analysis)의 구비 또는 내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability or the content of the authentic certificate of analysis was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 설비의 설계·제작·운전 및/또는 배치가 의약품의 오염을 방지하기에 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The design, construction, operation, and/or location of the equipment was inadequate for preventing contamination of the drug.

findings.text_ko: 건물·시설(premises)이 오염을 방지하도록 설계·건축·운영 및/또는 유지관리되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The premises were not designed, constructed, operated, and/or maintained to prevent contamination.

findings.text_ko: 문서화된 규격(specification)이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The written specifications were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 설비의 설계·제작 및/또는 배치가 설비의 적절한 세척·소독 및/또는 점검을 가능하게 하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The design, construction, and/or location of the equipment did not allow adequate cleaning, sanitizing, and/or inspection of the equipment.

findings.text_ko: 완제품 출하판정(release)을 위한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment to release finished products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 회수(recall)에 관한 문서화된 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The written procedures for recalls were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 변경관리(change control) 체계가 변경사항이 적절히 문서화·평가 및/또는 승인되도록 보장하기에 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 기록된 정보 또는 세부 내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The recorded information or details were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 원료 공급업체와 제조업자(fabricator) 간 문서화된 계약의 구비 및/또는 내용이 미흡했다. 원료 공급업체 인증 프로그램에 따른 감사보고서가 구비되지 않았거나 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability and/or the content of the written agreement between the raw material vendor and the drug fabricator was inadequate. An audit report was not available or was inadequate under the raw material vendor certification program.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서의 불만 및/또는 의약품 품질에 관해 접수된 정보의 처리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department's handling of complaints and/or information received about drug quality was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The maintenance of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 변경이 적절히 문서화·평가 및/또는 승인되도록 보장하기에 변경관리 시스템이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사, 보고 및/또는 후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 포장지시서에 요구되는 정보가 포함되지 않았다. 포장 작업이 문서화된 작업절차 또는 기준규격에 따라 수행되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: Packaging orders did not include the required information. Packaging operations were not performed in keeping with the written operating procedures or specifications.

findings.text_ko: 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 변경사항의 적절한 문서화·평가 및/또는 승인을 보장하기에 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고 및/또는 후속조치가 미흡했다. 잠재적 결함제품에 관한 불만(complaint) 및/또는 기타 정보의 평가·기록·후속조치 및/또는 조사가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate. The assessment, recording, follow-up, and/or investigation of complaints and/or other information about potentially defective products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 마스터 제조문서(master production document)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The master production documents were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 완제품 출하판정을 위한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment to release finished products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 의약품의 지속적 안정성시험(ongoing stability) 프로그램이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The ongoing stability program for a drug was inadequate.

findings.text_orig: The guidelines and/or procedures were inadequate in ensuring storage and/or transportation conditions would maintain the quality and safe distribution of the drug.

findings.text_ko: 의약품의 지속적 안정성시험(ongoing stability) 프로그램이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The ongoing stability program for a drug was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 공급자·제조자(fabricator)·시험자·포장자·표시자(labeller)·유통자·수입자 및/또는 도매상 간 품질계약(quality agreement)의 구비·내용 및/또는 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 회수(recall) 대응을 위해 제품 재고 및 유통 기록을 관리하는 데 사용된 전산화 시스템이 밸리데이션(validation)되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The computerized system used to manage product inventory and distribution records to support recalls was not validated.

findings.text_ko: 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 변경사항의 적절한 문서화·평가 및/또는 승인을 보장하기에 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 건물·시설이 해충 및/또는 이물의 건물 내 유입을 방지하도록 설계·시공 및/또는 유지관리되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The premises were not designed, constructed, and/or maintained to prevent the entry of pests and/or foreign material into the building.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 생성·수정·검토·보관 및/또는 검색에 대한 통제가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The controls were inadequate for creating, modifying, reviewing, storing, and/or retrieving records.

findings.text_ko: 제조소에 입고된 모든 로트의 원료에 대해 확인시험(identity testing)을 실시하지 않았다. 각 공급업체의 원료에 대해 전항목 확인시험(confirmatory testing)을 실시하지 않았다. 의약품 제조에 사용된 모든 원료에 대해 품질관리부서(quality control unit)가 승인한 기준(specification)이 구비되어 있지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: Specific identity testing was not conducted on all lots of raw materials received on the premises. Complete confirmatory testing was not conducted on raw materials from each vendor. The specifications approved by the quality control department were not available for all raw materials used to produce drugs.

findings.text_ko: 문서화된 기준(specification)이 미흡했다. 시험방법이 밸리데이션(validation)되지 않았거나 시험법 이관(method transfer) 시험을 실시하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The written specifications were inadequate. Test methods were not validated or the method transfer studies were not conducted.

findings.text_ko: 위생관리 프로그램이 오염 위험을 파악 및/또는 감소시키도록 적절히 설계되지 않았다. 비위생적 상태를 방지하기 위한 위생관리 프로그램의 실행 및/또는 효과성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The sanitation programs were not adequately designed to identify and/or reduce the risks of contamination. The implementation and/or the effectiveness of the sanitation program in preventing unsanitary conditions was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 전산화 시스템을 포함한 장비의 교정·점검 및/또는 적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다. 장비의 예방적 유지보수 및 수리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate. The preventative maintenance and repair of the equipment was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 장비가 타 의약품 및/또는 이물에 의한 의약품 오염 가능성을 방지하도록 설치·설계·운영·보관 및/또는 유지관리되지 않았다. 장비의 예방적 유지보수 및 수리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The equipment was not set-up, designed, operated, stored, and/or maintained to prevent potential contamination of drugs by other drugs and/or by foreign material. The preventative maintenance and repair of the equipment was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 중요 제조공정이 밸리데이션(validation)되지 않았다. 제조공정·장비 및/또는 자재에 대한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Critical production processes were not validated. Evaluation of production processes, equipment, and/or materials was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 완제품 출하판정을 위한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment to release finished products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 회사는 기준일탈(OOS)·경계값(borderline) 또는 경향일탈(out-of-trend)에 해당하는 안정성시험 결과에 대해 결과를 평가하지 않았거나 시정조치를 취하지 않았다. 기록의 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The company did not assess the results and/or take corrective actions for stability testing results that were out-of-specification, borderline, or out-of-trend . "The maintenance of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조공정을 관리하기 위한 마스터 제조처방(master formula)이 미흡했다. 마스터 제조문서(master production document)가 미흡했다. 제조 단계가 완료되었음에도 해당 정보가 제조기록서(batch record)에 기재되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The master formulas to control the manufacturing process were inadequate. The master production documents were inadequate. As the manufacturing steps were completed, the information was not recorded in the manufacturing batch record.

findings.text_ko: 잠재적 결함제품에 관한 불만(complaint) 및/또는 기타 정보의 평가·기록·후속조치 및/또는 조사가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment, recording, follow-up, and/or investigation of complaints and/or other information about potentially defective products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 건물·시설이 오염을 방지하도록 설계·시공·운영 및/또는 유지관리되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The premises were not designed, constructed, operated, and/or maintained to prevent contamination.

findings.text_ko: 변경이 적절히 문서화·평가 및/또는 승인되도록 보장하기에 변경관리 시스템이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 포장 작업이 문서화된 작업절차 또는 규격에 따라 수행되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: Packaging operations were not performed in keeping with the written operating procedures or specifications.

findings.text_ko: 문서화된 위생관리(sanitation) 프로그램의 구비, 실행, 수준이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, implementation, and/or quality of the written sanitation program was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control unit) 책임자의 품질관리 결정사항을 문서화하는 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The procedure was inadequate for documenting quality control decisions by the person in charge of the quality control department.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사, 보고, 후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조공정을 관리하기 위한 마스터 포뮬러(master formula)가 미흡했다. 사전 승인된 문서화된 절차 또는 지시에 따른 원료, 제품, 포장재의 취급이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The master formulas to control the manufacturing process were inadequate. The handling of raw materials, products, or packaging materials in keeping with pre-approved written procedures or instructions was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 수탁업체에 대한 회사의 관리·감독이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The company's oversight of the contracted party was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록된 정보 또는 세부 내용이 미흡했다. 기록의 생성·수정·검토·보관 및/또는 검색에 대한 통제가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The recorded information or details were inadequate. The controls were inadequate for creating, modifying, reviewing, storing, and/or retrieving records.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고 및/또는 후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 수입자는 의약품의 제조, 포장/표시 또는 시험에 사용한 해외 제조소가 Guidance on Evidence to Demonstrate Drug GMP Compliance of Foreign Sites (GUI-0080)에 기술된 요건을 충족하는지 확인하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The importer did not ensure that the foreign sites use to fabricate, package/label, or test drug products met the requirements described in Guidance on Evidence to Demonstrate Drug GMP Compliance of Foreign Sites (GUI-0080).

findings.text_ko: 공급자·제조자(fabricator)·시험자·포장자·표시자(labeller)·유통자·수입자 및/또는 도매상 간 품질계약(quality agreement)의 구비·내용 및/또는 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 직원의 직무기술서, 직원에게 부여된 권한 및/또는 업무 위임이 미흡했거나 문서화되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The job descriptions for personnel, the authority given to personnel, and/or the delegation of duties was inadequate and/or undocumented.

findings.text_ko: 온도 및/또는 습도 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The temperature and/or humidity control was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 연간 제품품질평가(annual product quality review) 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The annual product quality review procedure was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: GMP 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다. 기록의 추적성·판독성·문서화·서식 및/또는 정확성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate. The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 반품된 의약품의 재판매 검토에 대한 평가·문서화 및/또는 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment, documentation, and/or procedures for considering the resale of returned drugs were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고 및/또는 후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 변경사항의 적절한 문서화·평가 및/또는 승인을 보장하기에 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 원료의 출하 및 입고에 대한 표준작업지침서(SOP) 또는 기록이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The standard operating procedures or records for shipping and receiving raw materials were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 시험실 데이터의 생성·유지·처리 및/또는 검토가 미흡했다. 시험방법의 밸리데이션(validation) 및/또는 문서화가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The creation, maintenance, processing, and/or review of laboratory data was inadequate. The validation and/or the documentation of test methods was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 시험실의 설계·설비 및/또는 유지관리가 미흡했다. 비위생적 상태를 방지하기 위한 위생관리 프로그램의 실행 및/또는 효과성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The design, equipment, and/or maintenance of the testing laboratory was inadequate. The implementation and/or the effectiveness of the sanitation program in preventing unsanitary conditions was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고 및/또는 후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The maintenance of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 원료·공정 중 의약품·벌크 의약품 및/또는 완제품에 대한 검체의 취급 및/또는 보관이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The handling and/or storage of samples was inadequate for raw materials, drugs being processed, bulk drugs, and/or finished products.

findings.text_ko: 반품된 의약품의 재판매 검토에 관한 평가·문서화 및/또는 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment, documentation, and/or procedures for considering the resale of returned drugs were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 공급자, 제조업자(fabricator), 시험자, 포장자, 표시자(labeller), 유통업자, 수입업자 및/또는 도매상 간 품질계약서(quality agreement)의 구비·내용 및/또는 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: GMP 관련 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control department)가 연간 제품품질평가(annual product quality review) 결과를 평가하지 않았다. 연간 제품품질평가 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department did not evaluate the results of the annual product quality review. The annual product quality review procedure was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 완제품 출하판정(release)을 위한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment to release finished products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 검토·개정·승인 체계가 미흡했다. 품질관리부서(quality control unit)가 GMP 문서 및/또는 표준작업지침서(SOP)를 승인·서명 및/또는 일자 기재하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The system for reviewing, revising, and approving standard operating procedures was inadequate. The quality control department did not approve, sign, and/or date the good manufacturing practices documents and/or the standard operating procedures.

findings.text_ko: 회수(recall)에 관한 문서화된 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The written procedures for recalls were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 잠재적 결함제품에 관한 불만(complaint) 및/또는 기타 정보의 평가·기록·후속조치 및/또는 조사가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment, recording, follow-up, and/or investigation of complaints and/or other information about potentially defective products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 온도 및/또는 습도 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The temperature and/or humidity control was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 무균(aseptic) 또는 청정구역의 환경 등급 분류 절차가 미흡했다. 무균공정(aseptic)이 수행되는 구역에서 모니터링 주기와 방법이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The process was inadequate for the environmental classification of aseptic or clean areas. In areas where aseptic operations were performed, the frequency and the methods of monitoring were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 데이터 거버넌스 계획의 수립 및/또는 유지관리가 미흡했다. 전자시스템이 의도된 용도에 대해 밸리데이션(validation)되지 않았다. 시험실 데이터의 생성·유지·처리 및/또는 검토가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The establishment and/or the maintenance of a data governance plan was inadequate. The electronic system was not validated for its intended use. The creation, maintenance, processing, and/or review of laboratory data was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 변경사항의 적절한 문서화·평가 및/또는 승인을 보장하기에 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 직원에 대한 GMP 교육훈련 및/또는 그 기록의 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The training of personnel in good manufacturing practices and/or the maintenance of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 검토·개정·승인 체계가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The system for reviewing, revising, and approving standard operating procedures was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: Grade A 및 B 구역에서 멸균된 소독제를 사용하지 않았다. 각 환경 등급별 문서화된 복장 기준이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Sterile disinfectants were not used in Grade A and B areas. The written clothing standards for each environmental grade were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 시약 및 배지의 입고·조제 및/또는 취급이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The receipt, preparation, and/or handling of reagents and culture media was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 건물·시설이 청결하고 정돈된 상태를 유지할 수 있도록 설계·시공·운영 및/또는 유지관리되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The premises were not designed, constructed, operated, and/or maintained to allow clean and orderly conditions.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 생성·수정·검토·보관 및/또는 검색에 대한 통제가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The controls were inadequate for creating, modifying, reviewing, storing, and/or retrieving records.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사, 보고 및/또는 후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 건물·시설(premises)이 오염을 방지하도록 설계·건축·운영 및/또는 유지관리되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The premises were not designed, constructed, operated, and/or maintained to prevent contamination.

findings.text_ko: 전산화 시스템(computerized system)을 포함한 설비의 교정(calibration)·점검 및/또는 적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제품 및/또는 원자재의 오염 방지 조치가 미흡했다.

findings.text_ko: 문서화된 위생관리 프로그램의 구비, 이행 및/또는 수준이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, implementation, and/or quality of the written sanitation program was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 위생관리 프로그램이 오염 위험을 파악 및/또는 감소시키도록 적절히 설계되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The sanitation programs were not adequately designed to identify and/or reduce the risks of contamination.

findings.text_ko: 전산화 시스템을 포함한 장비의 교정·점검 및/또는 적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다. 정제수 설비의 운영이 신뢰할 수 있는 용수 공급을 보장하기에 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate. The operation of the water purification equipment was inadequate for ensuring a reliable source of water.

findings.text_ko: GMP 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 시험실 데이터의 생성·유지·처리 및/또는 검토가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The creation, maintenance, processing, and/or review of laboratory data was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조공정·장비 및/또는 자재에 대한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Evaluation of production processes, equipment, and/or materials was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기준일탈(OOS) 시험결과의 조사·처리·보고가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The investigation, handling, and/or reporting of test results that were out-of-specification was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록된 정보 또는 세부내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The recorded information or details were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 공급자·제조자·시험자·포장자·표시자·유통업자·수입자·도매상 간 품질계약서(quality agreement)의 구비·내용·유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 연간 제품품질평가(annual product quality review) 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The annual product quality review procedure was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 확인시험(confirmatory testing)을 별도의 다른 시험기관에서 수행하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: Confirmatory testing was not performed by an alternate laboratory.

findings.text_ko: 문서화된 회수(recall) 체계에 각 의약품을 추적할 수 있는 유통기록이 포함되어 있지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The written recall system did not include distribution records that allowed each drug to be traced.

findings.text_ko: 작업자에 대한 GMP 교육훈련 및 관련 기록의 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The training of personnel in good manufacturing practices and/or the maintenance of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고·후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조기준서(master production document)가 미흡했다. 기록된 정보 또는 세부내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The master production documents were inadequate. The recorded information or details were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 온도 및 습도 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The temperature and/or humidity control was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 변경사항이 적절히 문서화·평가·승인되도록 보장하기에 변경관리(change control) 체계가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 기준일탈(OOS) 시험결과의 조사·처리·보고가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The investigation, handling, and/or reporting of test results that were out-of-specification was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고·후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 공급자·제조자·시험자·포장자·표시자·유통업자·수입자·도매상 간 품질계약서(quality agreement)의 구비·내용·유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 주요 제조공정 및/또는 시험 작업에 사용되는 설비에 대한 예방정비(preventative maintenance) 프로그램이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The preventative maintenance program was inadequate for the equipment used in significant processing and/or testing operations.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 유지관리가 미흡했다. 데이터 거버넌스(data governance) 계획의 수립 및/또는 유지가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The maintenance of records was inadequate. The establishment and/or the maintenance of a data governance plan was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 비위생적 상태를 방지하기 위한 세척 절차의 실행·효과성 및/또는 밸리데이션(validation)이 미흡했다. 문서화된 위생관리(sanitation) 프로그램의 구비·실행 및/또는 품질이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation, effectiveness, and/or validation of the cleaning procedures was inadequate for preventing unsanitary conditions. The availability, implementation, and/or quality of the written sanitation program was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 해당 의약품에 대한 지속적 안정성시험 프로그램이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The ongoing stability program for a drug was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 주요 제조공정 및 시험 작업에 사용되는 설비에 대한 예방정비 프로그램이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The preventative maintenance program was inadequate for the equipment used in significant processing and/or testing operations.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The maintenance of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사, 보고 및/또는 후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 전산화 시스템(computerized system)을 포함한 설비의 교정(calibration)·점검 및/또는 적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 비위생적 상태를 방지하기 위한 위생관리 프로그램(sanitation program)의 실행 및 실효성이 미흡했다. 비위생적 상태를 방지하기 위한 세척절차의 실행·실효성·밸리데이션(validation)이 미흡했다. 오염을 방지하도록 제조소 시설을 설계·건축·운영·유지관리하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation and/or the effectiveness of the sanitation program in preventing unsanitary conditions was inadequate. The implementation, effectiveness, and/or validation of the cleaning procedures was inadequate for preventing unsanitary conditions. The premises were not designed, constructed, operated, and/or maintained to prevent contamination.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 생성·수정·검토·보관·검색에 대한 통제가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The controls were inadequate for creating, modifying, reviewing, storing, and/or retrieving records.

findings.text_ko: 비위생적 상태를 방지하기 위한 위생관리 프로그램(sanitation program)의 실행 및 실효성이 미흡했다. 오염을 방지하도록 제조소 시설을 설계·건축·운영·유지관리하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation and/or the effectiveness of the sanitation program in preventing unsanitary conditions was inadequate. The premises were not designed, constructed, operated, and/or maintained to prevent contamination.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 추적성·가독성·문서화·서식·정확성이 미흡했다. 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고·후속조치가 미흡했다. 기록의 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate. Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate. The maintenance of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 다른 의약품 또는 이물에 의한 의약품 오염 가능성을 방지하도록 설비를 설치·설계·운전·보관·유지관리하지 않았다. 주요 제조공정 및 시험 작업에 사용되는 설비에 대한 예방정비(preventative maintenance) 프로그램이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The equipment was not set-up, designed, operated, stored, and/or maintained to prevent potential contamination of drugs by other drugs and/or by foreign material. The preventative maintenance program was inadequate for the equipment used in significant processing and/or testing operations.

findings.text_ko: 시험실의 설계·장비·유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The design, equipment, and/or maintenance of the testing laboratory was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 원자재에 대한 검체채취 계획(sampling plan)이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The sampling plan for raw materials was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조소 시설의 유지관리가 미흡했다. 청결하고 정돈된 상태가 유지되도록 제조소 시설을 설계·건축·운영·유지관리하지 않았다. 원자재·포장재·중간제품·벌크 의약품·완제품의 구획 분리, 재고 순환(rotation of stock), 운송이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The maintenance of the premises was inadequate. The premises were not designed, constructed, operated, and/or maintained to allow clean and orderly conditions. The segregation, rotation of stock, and/or the transportation of raw materials, packaging materials, intermediates, bulk drugs, and/or finished products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 변경이 적절히 문서화·평가·승인되도록 보장하는 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 공급자·제조원·시험기관·포장자·표시자·유통업체·수입업체·도매업체 간 품질계약서(quality agreement)의 보유·내용·유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록된 정보 또는 세부사항이 미흡했다. 기록의 생성·수정·검토·보관·검색에 대한 통제가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The recorded information or details were inadequate. The controls were inadequate for creating, modifying, reviewing, storing, and/or retrieving records.

findings.text_ko: 의약품의 품질 유지 및 안전한 유통을 보장하기 위한 보관 및/또는 운송 조건에 관한 지침 및/또는 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The guidelines and/or procedures were inadequate in ensuring storage and/or transportation conditions would maintain the quality and safe distribution of the drug.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 생성·수정·검토·보관·검색에 대한 통제가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The controls were inadequate for creating, modifying, reviewing, storing, and/or retrieving records.

findings.text_ko: 비위생적 상태를 예방하기 위한 위생관리 프로그램의 이행 및/또는 실효성이 미흡했다. 오염 위험을 파악 및/또는 저감하도록 위생관리 프로그램이 적절히 설계되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation and/or the effectiveness of the sanitation program in preventing unsanitary conditions was inadequate. The sanitation programs were not adequately designed to identify and/or reduce the risks of contamination.

findings.text_ko: 전산화시스템을 포함한 설비의 교정·점검 및/또는 적격성평가가 미흡했다. 주요 제조 및/또는 시험 작업에 사용되는 설비에 대한 예방적 유지보수 프로그램이 미흡했다. 측정기기의 정확도와 정밀도가 정기적으로 점검되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate. The preventative maintenance program was inadequate for the equipment used in significant processing and/or testing operations. Measuring devices were not regularly checked for accuracy and precision.

findings.text_ko: 일탈에 대한 조사·보고 및/또는 후속조치가 미흡했다. 불량 가능성이 있는 제품에 대한 불만(컴플레인) 및/또는 기타 정보의 평가·기록·후속조치 및/또는 조사가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate. The assessment, recording, follow-up, and/or investigation of complaints and/or other information about potentially defective products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조공정·설비 및/또는 원자재에 대한 평가가 미흡했다. 제조지시서(마스터 제조문서)가 미흡했다. 제조 단계가 완료됨에 따라 해당 정보가 제조기록서(batch record)에 기록되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: Evaluation of production processes, equipment, and/or materials was inadequate. The master production documents were inadequate. As the manufacturing steps were completed, the information was not recorded in the manufacturing batch record.

findings.text_ko: 완제품 출하 판정을 위한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment to release finished products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 포장업자가 1차 포장재를 현장에서 입고받은 후 실시하는 확인시험이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The identity testing of primary packaging materials once they were received on the premises by a person that packages the drugs was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 습열멸균(moist heat sterilization) 사이클에 대한 회사의 모니터링과 문서화가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The company's monitoring and documentation of moist heat sterilization cycles was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 충전된 용기에 대한 회사의 외관검사(visual inspection)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The company's visual inspection of filled containers was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 멸균 후 재오염을 방지하기 위해 멸균물을 적절히 보호하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The company did not adequately protect sterilized material to prevent re-contamination after sterilization.

findings.text_ko: 무균공정(aseptic processing)의 밸리데이션이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The validation of aseptic processing was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 생성·수정·검토·보관·검색에 대한 통제가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The controls were inadequate for creating, modifying, reviewing, storing, and/or retrieving records.

findings.text_ko: 비위생적 상태를 방지하기 위한 위생관리 프로그램의 실행 및/또는 효과성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation and/or the effectiveness of the sanitation program in preventing unsanitary conditions was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고·후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 변경이 적절히 문서화·평가·승인되도록 보장하는 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 보관 및 운송 조건이 해당 의약품의 품질과 안전한 유통을 유지하도록 보장하기에 지침 및 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The guidelines and/or procedures were inadequate in ensuring storage and/or transportation conditions would maintain the quality and safe distribution of the drug.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 추적성·가독성·문서화·서식·정확성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록된 정보 또는 세부내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The recorded information or details were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기준(specification)이 문서화되지 않았거나 품질관리부서(quality control unit) 책임자 또는 지정 대리인의 승인을 받지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The specifications were not in writing and/or approved by the person in charge of the quality control department or the designated alternative.

findings.text_ko: 공급업체, 제조업체, 시험기관, 포장업체, 표시업체, 유통업체, 수입업체 및/또는 도매업체 간 품질협약서(quality agreement)의 보유, 내용 및/또는 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 비위생적 상태를 방지하기 위한 위생관리 프로그램(sanitation program)의 실행 및 실효성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The implementation and/or the effectiveness of the sanitation program in preventing unsanitary conditions was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제품 및 자재의 오염 방지가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The protection of products and/or materials from contamination was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고·후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 정본 시험성적서(certificate of analysis)의 보유 또는 내용이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability or the content of the authentic certificate of analysis was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조·포장·표시·필수 시험·보관·유통 및 각 조건에 대한 근거자료의 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The maintenance of evidence was inadequate for manufacturing, packaging, labelling, required testing, storage, and/or distribution, including the respective conditions.

findings.text_orig: The sampling plan for packaging materials was inadequate. The quality control department's release of packaging materials for use in packaging or labelling was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 설비의 예방정비 및 수리가 미흡했다.

findings.text_orig: The maintenance of records was inadequate. The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 완제품 출하판정을 위한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment to release finished products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 시험실 데이터의 생성·유지·처리·검토가 미흡했다. 데이터 거버넌스 계획(data governance plan)의 수립·유지가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The creation, maintenance, processing, and/or review of laboratory data was inadequate. The establishment and/or the maintenance of a data governance plan was inadequate.

findings.text_orig: The design of the drug stability study was inadequate and/or not justified with a documented rationale.

findings.text_orig: The education, experience, and/or oversight of the individual in charge of the quality control department was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록된 정보 또는 세부사항이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The recorded information or details were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 불만 및 결함 가능성이 있는 제품에 관한 기타 정보의 평가·기록·후속조치·조사가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment, recording, follow-up, and/or investigation of complaints and/or other information about potentially defective products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control unit)가 독립적으로 기능하고 타 부서와 독립적으로 경영진에 보고하는 별도의 조직이 아니었다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department was not a distinct unit that functioned independently and reported to management independent of any other unit.

findings.text_ko: 변경이 적절히 문서화·평가·승인되도록 보장하는 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_orig: The quality control department did not undertake all of the required activities.

findings.text_orig: Evaluation of production processes, equipment, and/or materials was inadequate.

findings.text_orig: The electronic system was not validated for its intended use.

findings.text_ko: 온도 및 습도 관리가 미흡했다. 의약품 각 로트 또는 배치의 운송·보관 조건을 입증하는 데 사용된 근거자료가 미흡했다. 보관·운송 조건이 의약품의 품질과 안전한 유통을 유지하도록 보장하는 지침 및 절차가 미흡했다. 컴퓨터화시스템을 포함한 설비의 교정·점검·적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The temperature and/or humidity control was inadequate. The evidence used to demonstrate the transportation and/or storage conditions of each lot or batch of the drug was inadequate. The guidelines and/or procedures were inadequate in ensuring storage and/or transportation conditions would maintain the quality and safe distribution of the drug. The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 회수(recall)에 대한 문서화된 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The written procedures for recalls were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 변경사항의 적절한 문서화·평가·승인을 보장하기에 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 의약품에 대한 지속적 안정성시험 프로그램이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The ongoing stability program for a drug was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 온도 및/또는 습도 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The temperature and/or humidity control was inadequate.

findings.text_orig: The handling of raw materials, products, or packaging materials in keeping with pre-approved written procedures or instructions was inadequate.

findings.text_orig: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.

findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate. The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_orig: The handling of raw materials, products, or packaging materials in keeping with pre-approved written procedures or instructions was inadequate.

findings.text_orig: The sanitation programs were not adequately designed to identify and/or reduce the risks of contamination.

findings.text_orig: The investigation, handling, and/or reporting of test results that were out-of-specification was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 오염으로부터 제품 및/또는 자재를 보호하는 조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The protection of products and/or materials from contamination was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 위생관리 프로그램의 세척 절차, 세척 주기, 폐기물 처리 절차 및/또는 방충·방서 대책이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The sanitation program was inadequate in its cleaning procedures, frequency of cleaning, procedures for waste disposal, and/or pest control measures.

findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 시험방법의 밸리데이션(validation) 및/또는 문서화가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The validation and/or the documentation of test methods was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 의약품 품질에 관해 접수된 불만 및/또는 정보에 대한 품질관리부서(quality control department)의 처리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department's handling of complaints and/or information received about drug quality was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 컴퓨터화시스템을 포함한 설비의 교정·점검·적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 직원에 대한 건강진단(채용 전 및/또는 정기)이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The health examinations of personnel (pre-employment and/or ongoing) were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 시약 및 배지의 입고·조제 및/또는 취급이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The receipt, preparation, and/or handling of reagents and culture media was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 주기적 확인시험을 실시하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: Periodic confirmatory testing was not conducted.

findings.text_ko: GMP 관련 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 핵심 제조공정이 밸리데이션되지 않았다. 포장 제품에 대한 마스터제조지시서(master formula)가 요구되는 정보를 포함하지 않았다. 포장 작업이 문서화된 운영절차서 또는 규격에 따라 수행되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: Critical production processes were not validated. The master formula for packaged products did not include the required information. Packaging operations were not performed in keeping with the written operating procedures or specifications.

findings.text_ko: 의약품 안정성 프로그램(stability program)이 해당 의약품이 제조된 매년마다 모든 함량(strength)별 최소 1개 배치를 포함하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The stability program for a drug did not include a minimum of one batch of every strength of the drug for every year the drug was fabricated.

findings.text_ko: 전산화 시스템(computerized system)을 포함한 설비의 교정, 점검 및/또는 적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다. 설비가 다른 의약품 및/또는 이물에 의한 의약품 오염 가능성을 방지하도록 설치, 설계, 운전, 보관 및/또는 유지관리되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate. The equipment was not set-up, designed, operated, stored, and/or maintained to prevent potential contamination of drugs by other drugs and/or by foreign material.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서가 요구되는 활동을 모두 수행하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The quality control department did not undertake all of the required activities.

findings.text_ko: 데이터 거버넌스(data governance) 계획의 수립 및/또는 유지가 미흡했다. 해당 전자시스템은 의도된 용도에 대해 밸리데이션되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The establishment and/or the maintenance of a data governance plan was inadequate. The electronic system was not validated for its intended use.

findings.text_ko: 문서화된 위생(hygiene) 프로그램이 직원 및/또는 방문자에 대한 복장 요건 및/또는 위생 절차를 명확히 규정하지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The written hygiene program did not clearly define clothing requirements and/or hygiene procedures for personnel and/or visitors.

findings.text_ko: 문서화된 위생관리 프로그램(sanitation program)의 구비, 실행 및/또는 그 수준이 미흡했다. 비위생적 상태를 방지하기 위한 세척절차의 실행, 효과성 및/또는 밸리데이션이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The availability, implementation, and/or quality of the written sanitation program was inadequate. The implementation, effectiveness, and/or validation of the cleaning procedures was inadequate for preventing unsanitary conditions.

findings.text_ko: 비위생적 상태를 방지하기 위한 위생관리 프로그램의 실행 및/또는 효과성이 미흡했다. 설비가 다른 의약품 및/또는 이물에 의한 의약품 오염 가능성을 방지하도록 설치·설계·운전·보관·유지관리되지 않았다.

findings.text_ko: 보관 및/또는 운송 조건이 의약품의 품질과 안전한 유통을 유지하도록 보장하는 지침 및/또는 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The guidelines and/or procedures were inadequate in ensuring storage and/or transportation conditions would maintain the quality and safe distribution of the drug.

findings.text_ko: GMP에 대한 직원 교육 및/또는 그 기록의 관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The training of personnel in good manufacturing practices and/or the maintenance of records was inadequate.

documents.firm_name: Lawton's Drug Stores Ltd., Wholesale Division

findings.text_ko: 작업자의 직무기술서, 부여된 권한 및/또는 업무 위임이 미흡했거나 문서화되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The job descriptions for personnel, the authority given to personnel, and/or the delegation of duties was inadequate and/or undocumented.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 생성·수정·검토·보관·검색에 대한 통제가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The controls were inadequate for creating, modifying, reviewing, storing, and/or retrieving records.

findings.text_ko: 온도 및/또는 습도 관리가 미흡했다. 컴퓨터화시스템을 포함한 설비의 교정, 점검 및/또는 적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The temperature and/or humidity control was inadequate. The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: GMP 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다. 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 검토·개정·승인 체계가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate. The system for reviewing, revising, and approving standard operating procedures was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 완제품 출하를 위한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment to release finished products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 제조·포장 또는 표시 및/또는 시험에 대한 책임을 규정한 품질계약서(quality agreement)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The quality agreement outlining the responsibilities for fabricating, packaging or labelling, and/or testing was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 시험방법의 밸리데이션(validation) 및/또는 문서화가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The validation and/or the documentation of test methods was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 캐나다 반입 전 또는 반입 후 검체에 대해 실시한 확인시험이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The confirmatory tests conducted on samples before or after they were received in Canada were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 기록의 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The maintenance of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 반품 의약품의 재판매 검토를 위한 평가·문서화 및/또는 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment, documentation, and/or procedures for considering the resale of returned drugs were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control unit) 책임자가 시행 전에 수행하는 제조·포장·표시·시험·보관 및/또는 운송 방법 및 절차에 대한 검토 및/또는 승인이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The examination and/or approval of fabrication, packaging, labelling, testing, storage, and/or the transportation method and procedures by the person in charge of the quality control department before implementation was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 전자시스템이 의도된 용도에 대해 밸리데이션(validation)되지 않았다. 기록의 생성·수정·검토·보관·검색에 대한 통제가 미흡했다. 기록의 추적성·가독성·문서화·서식 및/또는 정확성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The electronic system was not validated for its intended use. The controls were inadequate for creating, modifying, reviewing, storing, and/or retrieving records. The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 데이터 거버넌스 계획의 수립 및/또는 유지가 미흡했다. 전자시스템이 의도된 용도에 대해 밸리데이션(validation)되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: The establishment and/or the maintenance of a data governance plan was inadequate. The electronic system was not validated for its intended use.

findings.text_ko: 회수(recall)에 대한 문서화된 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The written procedures for recalls were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 변경이 적절히 문서화·평가 및/또는 승인되도록 보장하는 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.

findings.text_ko: 제조, 포장, 표시, 시험, 보관 및/또는 운송 방법과 절차에 대해 품질관리부서(quality control unit) 책임자가 시행 전에 실시하는 검토 및/또는 승인이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The examination and/or approval of fabrication, packaging, labelling, testing, storage, and/or the transportation method and procedures by the person in charge of the quality control department before implementation was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 위생관리 프로그램이 오염 위험을 파악 및/또는 감소시키도록 적절히 설계되지 않았다. 세척 절차의 실행·효과성 및/또는 밸리데이션(validation)이 비위생적 상태를 방지하기에 미흡했다. 설비가 다른 의약품 및/또는 이물에 의한 의약품 오염 가능성을 방지하도록 설치·설계·운영·보관 및/또는 유지관리되지 않았다. 미생물 및/또는 환경 조건에 대한 모니터링 절차가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The sanitation programs were not adequately designed to identify and/or reduce the risks of contamination. The implementation, effectiveness, and/or validation of the cleaning procedures was inadequate for preventing unsanitary conditions. The equipment was not set-up, designed, operated, stored, and/or maintained to prevent potential contamination of drugs by other drugs and/or by foreign material. The monitoring procedures for microbial and/or environmental conditions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사·보고 및/또는 후속조치가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 컴퓨터화시스템을 포함한 설비의 교정·점검 및/또는 적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 완제품 출하를 위한 평가가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The assessment to release finished products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 시험실 데이터의 생성·유지관리·처리 및/또는 검토가 미흡했다. 기록의 추적성·가독성·문서화·서식 및/또는 정확성이 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The creation, maintenance, processing, and/or review of laboratory data was inadequate. The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 재작업 또는 재처리된 의약품 로트가 지속 안정성시험 프로그램에 포함되지 않았다.
findings.text_orig: Reworked or reprocessed drug lots were not included in the ongoing stability program.

findings.text_orig: The investigation, handling, and/or reporting of test results that were out-of-specification was inadequate.

findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_orig: The creation, maintenance, processing, and/or review of laboratory data was inadequate. The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate.

findings.text_orig: The investigation, handling, and/or reporting of test results that were out-of-specification was inadequate.

findings.text_orig: The assessment to release finished products was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 위생관리 프로그램이 오염 위험을 파악하거나 저감하도록 적절히 설계되지 않았다. 세척 절차의 실행·효과성·밸리데이션(validation)이 비위생적 상태를 방지하기에 미흡했다. 설비가 다른 의약품 또는 이물에 의한 의약품 오염 가능성을 방지하도록 설치·설계·운전·보관·유지관리되지 않았다. 미생물 및 환경 조건에 대한 모니터링 절차가 미흡했다.

The implementation, effectiveness, and/or validation of the cleaning procedures was inadequate for preventing unsanitary conditions. The equipment was not set-up, designed, operated, stored, and/or maintained to prevent potential contamination of drugs by other drugs and/or by foreign material. The monitoring procedures for microbial and/or environmental conditions were inadequate.

findings.text_orig: Reworked or reprocessed drug lots were not included in the ongoing stability program.

findings.text_orig: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.

findings.text_orig: The creation, maintenance, processing, and/or review of laboratory data was inadequate.

findings.text_ko: 시험실의 설계, 설비 및/또는 유지관리가 미흡했다.
findings.text_orig: The design, equipment, and/or maintenance of the testing laboratory was inadequate.
